A structured evaluation framework that judges LLM agent outputs against original source-rule text to measure joint compliance under intra-policy rule conflicts.
A method for classifying within-policy clause-pair comparisons and ranking them based on collision severity to prioritize diagnostic testing.
idea_ch: 一种从长周期自然语言提示策略中自动提取源规则并编码为可执行逻辑子句（如PyRule）以进行冲突分析的方法。
一种基于可满足性检查的系统，用于识别单个提示策略内可共同治理真实状态的硬冲突候选规则对。
一种将抽象规则冲突实现为具体共治见证的管道，支持在冲突规则压力下对LLM Agent行为进行实证测试。
一种结构化评估框架，根据原始源规则文本评判LLM Agent输出，以衡量策略内规则冲突下的联合合规性。
一种对策略内子句对进行分类并根据冲突严重性排序以优先诊断测试的方法。

title: A Query Engine for the Agents
summary: The fastest-growing data in production today is unstructured text: agent traces, chat logs, reasoning chains, model outputs. People want to analyze it, and the questions worth asking ("show me where the agent got confused") cannot be answered by SQL alone, since text is not queryable without a model in the query path. The natural place this analysis is happening is the new class of AI applications (Claude Code, Cursor, Claude Desktop, in-browser agents) that run client-side and host both a human user and an LLM agent in the same process. These applications increasingly want to work with data, but the lakehouse read path has been hard to use from a JS runtime: Spark, Trino, and managed warehouses do not fit there. To build this new kind of AI data application, three properties of the engine become first-order: a JS-native distribution that drops into the runtime the application already runs in, a bundle small enough to ship inside a cold tab or per-turn agent sandbox, and a way to interleave analytic operators with model-based interpretation of text. We present Hyperparam, three open-source JavaScript libraries (Hyparquet, Squirreling, Icebird) totaling under 70 KB, that read Parquet and Apache Iceberg directly from object storage and meet the third property with per-cell, async-native SQL execution, so expensive cells fire only when downstream operators demand them. Squirreling runs LLM-shaped async UDFs over 300x faster than DuckDB-WASM on filter-bounded queries (and 192x on sort-bounded queries) and completes a ten-task agent analyst suite at two-thirds lower cost. We argue that data engineering as a discipline needs to update for the AI-native client applications now in production and the agents that work alongside their users.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Hyperparam，三个总计不到70KB的开源JavaScript库（Hyparquet、Squirreling、Icebird），用于在JS运行时中直接读取对象存储中的Parquet和Iceberg格式数据，并支持按需异步执行SQL和LLM驱动的UDF，实现高效AI数据分析。
AI.motivation: 现代AI应用（如Claude Code、Cursor等）产生大量非结构化文本数据（代理轨迹、聊天日志、推理链等），传统SQL无法直接查询文本内容，而现有的湖仓读取方案（Spark、Trino等）无法在JS运行时中运行。需要一种轻量级、JS原生、支持模型驱动分析的引擎。
AI.method: Hyperparam包含三个库：Hyparquet解析Parquet文件，Icebird管理Iceberg表元数据，Squirreling提供按需异步SQL执行引擎。核心创新是per-cell异步执行机制——只有当下游操作符需要时才触发计算代价高昂的cell，支持LLM形状的异步UDF，将模型推理嵌入分析查询路径。
AI.result: Squirreling在filter-bounded查询上比DuckDB-WASM快300倍以上，sort-bounded查询快192倍，完成十项代理分析任务套件成本降低三分之二。
AI.conclusion: 数据工程需要为AI原生客户端应用和与用户协同工作的智能代理更新架构，Hyperparam展示了轻量级JS原生分析引擎如何满足这一需求。
idea_en: A JS-native data analysis engine (Hyperparam) comprising three sub-70KB libraries that reads Parquet and Apache Iceberg directly from object storage without requiring Spark/Trino/managed warehouses.
Per-cell async-native SQL execution mechanism that only fires expensive cells when downstream operators demand them, enabling lazy evaluation in analytic pipelines.

LLM-shaped async UDF (User-Defined Function) execution integrated into analytic query engine, allowing model-based text interpretation (e.g., 'find where the agent got confused') as first-class operators.
Lightweight data analysis library bundle small enough to ship inside a cold browser tab or per-turn agent sandbox for client-side AI applications.
Inefficient cell detection and lazy materialization strategy for structured data querying over unstructured text in AI agent contexts.
idea_ch: 一种JS原生的数据分析引擎（Hyperparam），包含三个总计小于70KB的库，可直接从对象存储读取Parquet和Apache Iceberg数据，无需Spark/Trino/托管仓库。
基于逐cell异步原生SQL执行机制，仅在当下游操作符需要时才触发计算代价高昂的cell，实现分析管道的惰性求值。
将LLM驱动的异步UDF集成到分析查询引擎中，使基于模型的文本解释（如'找到代理在哪一步感到困惑'）成为一等操作符。
轻量级数据分析库包，体积足够小，可部署在冷启动浏览器标签页或每轮代理沙箱中，适用于客户端AI应用。
针对AI代理上下文中非结构化文本的结构化数据查询的低效cell检测与延迟物化策略。

title: A Fixed-Budget, Cluster-Aware Standard for LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluation: A Multi-Hop RAG Stress Test
summary:
Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems are often compared by asking a large language model (LLM) judge which answer is better. For multi-hop RAG, this has become a measurement problem as much as a modeling problem: the same score can reflect retrieval quality, answer length, lexical overlap, or a statistical test that ignores clustered data. We ask what happens when these choices are made explicit.
  We propose a minimum measurement standard for LLM-as-a-judge comparisons in RAG. The standard fixes the top-100 candidate pool, evidence budget, answer cap, generator, and prompt; it also requires pre-registered hypotheses, cluster-aware inference, an exact cluster sign-flip check when feasible, and second-judge replication. Clustered benchmarks can overstate progress; the field should adopt this standard. We stress-test it with Genetic Algorithm Decoder for Multi-hop Evidence Composition (GADMEC), an evolutionary evidence selector, on 400 multi-hop questions in computer science/machine learning (CS/ML) and Materials Science. The protocol changes the empirical story. A binomial test makes all four semantic-baseline comparisons look significant; cluster-aware inference leaves only one Bonferroni-significant result. BM25 beats pure semantic GADMEC under the same budget, while a lexical-semantic hybrid recovers in CS/ML and narrows the Materials Science gap.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用于RAG系统的LLM-as-a-judge比较的最小度量标准，并通过GADMEC进化证据选择器在400个多跳问题上进行压力测试，发现聚类感知推理会改变实证结论。
AI.motivation: 多跳RAG系统的评估存在测量问题：同一分数可能反映检索质量、答案长度、词汇重叠或忽略聚类数据的统计检验，需要明确这些选择带来的影响。
AI.method: 提出最小度量标准：固定top-100候选池、证据预算、答案上限、生成器和提示词；要求预注册假设、聚类感知推理、精确聚类符号翻转检验及第二裁判重复。并用GADMEC（遗传算法解码器用于多跳证据组合）进行压力测试。
AI.result: 二项式检验使四个语义基线比较都显著；聚类感知推理仅留下一个Bonferroni显著结果。BM25在相同预算下优于纯语义GADMEC，而词汇-语义混合在CS/ML中恢复效果，在材料科学中缩小差距。
AI.conclusion: 聚类基准可能夸大进展；该领域应采用此标准。评估协议的选择会从根本上改变实证结论。
idea_en: A minimum measurement standard for LLM-as-a-judge comparisons in RAG systems that fixes top-100 candidate pool, evidence budget, answer cap, generator, and prompt, while requiring pre-registered hypotheses and cluster-aware inference.
Genetic Algorithm Decoder for Multi-hop Evidence Composition (GADMEC): an evolutionary evidence selector for multi-hop RAG systems.
Exact cluster sign-flip check method for statistical testing in clustered RAG benchmarks.
Lexical-semantic hybrid evidence selection approach that combines BM25 with semantic retrieval for multi-hop RAG.
Cluster-aware inference method that accounts for data clustering in RAG evaluation to avoid overstating progress.
idea_ch: 一种RAG系统中LLM-as-a-judge比较的最小度量标准，固定top-100候选池、证据预算、答案上限、生成器和提示词，并要求预注册假设和聚类感知推理。
用于多跳证据组合的遗传算法解码器（GADMEC）：一种用于多跳RAG系统的进化证据选择器。
聚类基准测试中用于统计检验的精确聚类符号翻转检验方法。
词汇-语义混合证据选择方法：结合BM25与语义检索用于多跳RAG系统。
聚类感知推理方法：在RAG评估中考虑数据聚类，避免夸大进展。

title: GraD-IBD: Graph Representation Learning from Diagnosis Trajectories for Early Detection of Inflammatory Bowel Disease
summary: International Classification of Diseases (ICD) is a globally recognized coding system that records diagnostic events during each patient encounter, providing a standardized data foundation for various clinical tasks. However, the irregular and hierarchical nature of ICD code sequences poses challenges for N-D lattice-based sequential modeling methods, leading to overly complex model designs. In this paper, we propose GraD-IBD, a graph diagnosis model that reformulates longitudinal ICD trajectories as visit-bucketized, temporally directed graphs to detect the risk of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). A novel context-aware, time-decay message passing mechanism was developed to capture temporal dependencies while reducing model complexity. The experimental results using a real-world clinical dataset demonstrated consistent and robust improvements in IBD detection over state-of-the-art methods, with significant reductions in computational complexity compared to sequential models. These findings highlight the potential of graph representation learning to enable efficient, scalable, and accurate disease risk prediction from longitudinal ICD diagnosis codes.

AI.tldr: 提出GraD-IBD图诊断模型，将纵向ICD编码轨迹重构为按就诊时间分桶的有向图，利用上下文感知的时间衰减消息传递机制检测炎症性肠病（IBD）风险，在降低计算复杂度的同时提升了检测性能。
AI.motivation: ICD编码序列具有不规则性和层次性，传统的N维格点序列建模方法设计过于复杂，难以高效处理纵向就诊数据。
AI.method: 提出GraD-IBD模型：将纵向ICD轨迹建模为按就诊时间分桶的时序有向图，设计上下文感知的时间衰减消息传递机制来捕获时间依赖关系。
AI.result: 在真实临床数据集上，IBD检测效果持续优于现有方法，计算复杂度相比序列模型显著降低。
AI.conclusion: 图表示学习能够实现基于纵向ICD编码的高效、可扩展且准确的疾病风险预测。
idea_en: A visit-bucketized temporally directed graph construction method for longitudinal ICD code sequences, where patient encounters are grouped into time windows and structured as directed edges with temporal ordering.
A context-aware time-decay message passing mechanism for graph neural networks that attenuates information propagation based on temporal distance between clinical visits.
GraD-IBD: a graph-based diagnosis model that reformulates irregular hierarchical ICD trajectories into graph structures for inflammatory bowel disease risk detection.
A graph representation learning framework for disease risk prediction from longitudinal ICD codes that reduces computational complexity compared to N-D lattice sequential models.
idea_ch: 一种针对纵向ICD编码序列的按就诊时间分桶的时序有向图构建方法，将患者就诊按时间窗口分组并以有向边表示时序关系。
一种上下文感知的时间衰减消息传递机制，根据临床就诊之间的时间距离衰减信息传播权重，用于图神经网络。
GraD-IBD图诊断模型：将不规则层次化的ICD纵向轨迹重构为图结构，用于炎症性肠病风险检测。
一种基于纵向ICD编码的图表示学习疾病风险预测框架，相比N维格点序列模型显著降低计算复杂度。

title: Constrained Auto-Bidding via Generative Response Modeling
summary: Auto-bidding systems aim to maximize advertiser value over long horizons under budget constraints and ratio targets such as cost-per-acquisition, yet future traffic and auction dynamics are non-stationary and uncertain. Existing approaches face distinct limitations: control-based pacing reacts to deviations but cannot anticipate future conditions, while RL and generative methods fold constraints into reward signals, obscuring violations and degrading under distribution shift. We shift the learning target from actions to responses with the Generative Response Model (GRM), a history-conditioned sequence model that jointly predicts future traffic volume and horizon-aggregate cost/value curves as functions of a single bid multiplier. We show that under mild monotonicity conditions, the optimality gap relative to full per-tick control is bounded by the dispersion of per-tick marginal value-per-cost. Given predicted responses, a lightweight analytic controller enforces each active constraint via a 1D root-finding step. We prove this controller is exact for the single-multiplier problem and bound constraint violations under receding-horizon replanning in terms of prediction error. Experiments on AuctionNet show that GRM improves constraint stability and overall score compared to existing baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出生成式响应模型（GRM），通过预测未来流量和成本/价值曲线，结合轻量级解析控制器，在非平稳拍卖环境中实现稳定的预算和比率约束优化。
AI.motivation: 现有自动出价系统面临非平稳和不确定的未来流量与拍卖动态，基于控制的节奏方法无法预测未来，RL和生成方法将约束折叠进奖励信号导致违规和分布偏移下性能退化。
AI.method: 提出GRM：一个历史条件序列模型，联合预测未来流量和水平聚合成本/价值曲线作为单个出价乘数的函数。在温和单调性条件下，最优性差距受限于每tick边际价值-成本比的离散度。轻量级解析控制器通过一维寻根步骤强制执行每个活动约束，并证明在滚动时域重规划下约束违规受限于预测误差。
AI.result: 在 AuctionNet 上的实验表明，GRM相比现有基线改善了约束稳定性和总体得分。
AI.conclusion: 通过将学习目标从动作转向响应预测，GRM实现了更好的约束稳定性和性能，理论保证了最优性差距和约束违规界限。
idea_en: A Generative Response Model that jointly predicts future traffic volume and horizon-aggregate cost/value curves as functions of a single bid multiplier for auto-bidding systems.
A lightweight analytic controller that enforces active constraints via a 1D root-finding step, proven exact for the single-multiplier problem.
A receding-horizon replanning framework with bounded constraint violations in terms of prediction error under non-stationary auction dynamics.
A method shifting learning target from actions to market responses, enabling constraint-stable optimization under distribution shift.
idea_ch: 一种生成式响应模型（GRM），将未来流量和水平聚合成本/价值曲线作为单个出价乘数的函数进行联合预测，用于自动出价系统
一种轻量级解析控制器，通过一维寻根步骤强制执行每个活动约束，并证明对单乘数问题具有精确性
一种在非平稳拍卖动态下，以预测误差为界限约束违规的滚动时域重规划框架
一种将学习目标从动作转向市场响应的方法，在分布偏移下实现约束稳定的优化

title: EgoBench: An Interactive Egocentric Multimodal Benchmark for Tool-Using Agents
summary: As AI agents increasingly operate in open, real-world environments, they require a deep synergy of multimodal perception, tool invocation with multi-hop reasoning, and dynamic interaction with users. However, existing benchmarks fail to jointly evaluate these capabilities due to challenges in designing strictly coupled multi-capability tasks, simulating natural and task-constrained user feedback, and ensuring objective evaluation of dynamic interaction. To bridge this gap, we introduce EgoBench, the first interactive multimodal benchmark for tool-using agents. EgoBench comprises 1,045 egocentric-video-grounded tasks covering four daily scenarios, along with a user-agent-tool interactive environment for evaluation. We implement a three-stage synergistic pipeline through which each task is designed to enforce the joint application of visual perception and tool-augmented multi-hop reasoning. We additionally develop a multi-agent simulated user within EgoBench to evaluate agents' interaction capabilities, which generates high-fidelity, task-aligned responses to agents. Furthermore, we establish a deterministic joint validation framework that guarantees objective assessment through process-based and result-based equivalence. Benchmarking eight SOTA video-MLLM agents on EgoBench reveals a severe performance ceiling: the best model achieves only 30.62% accuracy in the best-performing scenario, averaging 19.43% across all four scenarios. Finally, we conduct a multi-dimensional error analysis to disentangle failure modes, exposing capability bottlenecks for advancing future AI agents.

AI.tldr: EgoBench是首个交互式多模态基准测试，用于评估工具使用型AI代理在开放环境中的视觉感知、工具调用多跳推理和动态交互能力，包含1045个以自我中心视频为基础的任务和多代理模拟用户环境。测试8个SOTA视频MLLM代理，最佳模型准确率仅30.62%，平均19.43%。
AI.motivation: 现有基准无法联合评估AI代理的多模态感知、工具调用多跳推理和用户动态交互能力，因为设计严格耦合的多能力任务、模拟自然且受任务约束的用户反馈以及确保动态交互的客观评估存在挑战。
AI.method: 构建EgoBench基准，包含1045个以自我中心视频为基础的任务、用户-代理-工具交互环境；采用三阶段协同流水线设计任务，强制联合视觉感知和工具增强的多跳推理；开发多代理模拟用户生成高保真任务对齐响应；建立确定性联合验证框架，通过基于过程和基于结果的等价性进行客观评估。
AI.result: 对8个SOTA视频MLLM代理进行测试，最佳模型在最佳场景中仅达30.62%准确率，四个场景平均19.43%。
AI.conclusion: 现有AI代理在联合多模态感知、工具推理和用户交互方面存在严重能力瓶颈，EgoBench可有效暴露失败模式并指导未来AI代理发展。
idea_en: A three-stage synergistic pipeline for designing tasks that jointly enforce visual perception and tool-augmented multi-hop reasoning in agent evaluation
A multi-agent simulated user system that generates high-fidelity, task-aligned responses for evaluating agent interaction capabilities
A deterministic joint validation framework combining process-based and result-based equivalence for objective assessment of dynamic agent interactions
An egocentric-video-grounded interactive environment integrating user-agent-tool interactions for comprehensive agent benchmarking
A multi-dimensional error analysis methodology for disentangling failure modes and identifying capability bottlenecks in multimodal tool-using agents

一种多代理模拟用户系统，生成高保真、任务对齐的响应以评估代理的交互能力

title: Revealing Algorithmic Deductive Circuits for Logical Reasoning
summary: Recent studies have shown that Large Language Models (LLMs) can achieve strong reasoning performance by incorporating functional symbolic representations that abstractly describe graph traversal algorithms and step-by-step reasoning in few-shot learning settings. However, it remains unclear how LLMs genuinely understand the abstract meaning of each reasoning step and the overall algorithm from only a limited number of demonstrations. This work aims to localize the attention heads responsible for individual reasoning steps and characterize the types of information transferred among them. We first align constituent reasoning steps with their corresponding token logits under a symbolic-aided Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting framework. Our analysis shows that token positions that steer the reasoning process are associated with low confidence scores caused by constraints on satisfying reasoning behavior patterns in demonstrations. We then adopt causal mediation analysis techniques to identify the attention heads responsible for these patterns. In addition, our findings indicate that LLMs retrieve factual and rule-based information for individual sub-reasoning tasks through specialized attention heads (approximately 3% total heads), whereas higher layers predominantly facilitate information integration and the emergence of global reasoning strategies (e.g., graph traversal algorithms) that coordinate multiple intermediate reasoning steps to solve the overall task.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大语言模型在符号辅助的思维链提示框架下，如何通过注意力头实现逐步推理，发现约3%的专门注意力头负责检索事实和规则信息，而高层注意力头主要促进信息整合和全局推理策略的形成。
AI.motivation: 现有研究虽表明LLM通过符号化函数表示可实现强推理能力，但对于模型如何从少量示例中理解每个推理步骤的抽象含义及整体算法机制尚不明确，因此需要定位负责各推理步骤的注意力头并刻画信息传递类型。
AI.method: 首先将推理步骤与对应token logits对齐，利用因果中介分析技术识别负责推理模式的注意力头，分析不同层注意力头在事实检索、规则推理与全局策略协调中的角色分工。
AI.result: 引导推理过程的token位置与低置信度分数相关；约3%的专门注意力头负责子推理任务的事实和规则信息检索；高层注意力头主要负责信息整合和全局推理策略（如图遍历算法）的涌现。
AI.conclusion: LLM中的推理能力依赖于低层专门注意力头与高层全局协调注意力头的分工协作，这一发现有助于理解模型的可解释性和推理机制。
idea_en: A method for localizing attention heads responsible for individual reasoning steps in LLMs using causal mediation analysis under symbolic-aided CoT prompting
A technique for aligning constituent reasoning steps with token logits to identify low-confidence token positions that steer reasoning processes
A system that distinguishes between specialized attention heads (approx. 3%) for factual/rule retrieval and higher-layer heads for global reasoning strategy integration
A mechanism for characterizing information transfer patterns among attention heads during multi-step graph traversal reasoning
A framework for detecting reasoning behavior pattern constraints through confidence score analysis in few-shot demonstrations
idea_ch: 一种在符号辅助思维链提示框架下，利用因果中介分析定位LLM中负责各推理步骤的注意力头的方法

title: Operational AI Deployment Assurance: Governance-State Orchestration Under Threshold-Sensitive Deployment Conditions -- A Governance Framework for High-Stakes AI Systems
comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, governance-oriented framework for operational AI deployment assurance in high-stakes systems
summary: AI governance frameworks increasingly emphasize fairness, transparency, accountability, and lifecycle risk management in high-stakes domains. However, many current approaches remain observational, relying on static metric reporting, post-hoc auditing, and monitoring dashboards without directly governing deployment readiness, remediation progression, escalation states, or assurance-driven deployment control. This paper introduces Operational AI Deployment Assurance (OADA), a governance framework for translating fairness disagreement, subgroup instability, threshold sensitivity, remediation outcomes, and operational uncertainty into deployment-oriented assurance decisions. Building on prior work on the Fairness Disagreement Index (FDI) and FairRisk-FDI, OADA reframes governance uncertainty as an operational concern within AI deployment pipelines rather than a byproduct of metric disagreement. The framework introduces Deployment Assurance Scores, Deployment Readiness Classifications, Threshold Stability Zones, Governance Escalation States, and remediation-aware assurance progression. These constructs support lifecycle-oriented governance decisions across high-stakes settings by connecting evaluation outputs to deployment-state interpretation, reassessment, escalation, and operational control. Through deployment-oriented evaluation across facial recognition systems, with discussion extended to healthcare AI as a representative high-stakes domain, the paper demonstrates how systems may appear acceptable under isolated fairness or performance metrics while still exhibiting instability that affects deployment readiness. The proposed framework positions operational deployment assurance as a governance layer between evaluation and real-world AI deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OADA框架，将AI治理中的公平性、稳定性等评估指标转化为部署就绪决策和运维控制信号，构建从评估到真实部署的保障层。
AI.motivation: 现有AI治理框架多停留于静态指标报告和事后审计，缺乏将公平性分歧、阈值敏感性等不确定性直接转化为部署就绪性、补救进展、升级状态等运维决策的能力。
AI.method: OADA引入部署保障分数、部署就绪分类、阈值稳定区、治理升级状态和补救感知保障进展等构建模块，将治理不确定性重构为部署管道中的运维问题。
AI.result: 在人脸识别和医疗AI场景中证明，系统在孤立公平性/性能指标下看似可接受，但仍可能存在影响部署就绪的不稳定性，OADA能捕捉并转化此类信号。
AI.conclusion: OADA可作为评估与真实部署之间的运维保障层，实现面向生命周期的治理决策，弥补现有框架在部署控制方面的空白。
idea_en: Operational AI Deployment Assurance (OADA) framework that converts fairness disagreement, subgroup instability, and threshold sensitivity into deployment-oriented assurance decisions
Deployment Assurance Scores and Deployment Readiness Classifications for lifecycle governance in high-stakes AI systems
Threshold Stability Zones to evaluate deployment readiness based on metric stability rather than isolated performance values
Governance Escalation States that trigger remediation and reassessment workflows based on assurance progression
Remediation-aware assurance progression mechanism connecting evaluation outputs to deployment-state interpretation and operational control
idea_ch: 将公平性分歧、子群体不稳定性、阈值敏感性转化为部署导向保障决策的OADA运维框架
面向高风险AI系统生命周期治理的部署保障分数与部署就绪分类方法
基于指标稳定性而非孤立性能值评估部署就绪的阈值稳定区机制
根据保障进展触发补救与重新评估工作流的治理升级状态系统
将评估输出连接到部署状态解释与运维控制的补救感知保障进展机制

title: EAPO: Entropy-Driven Adaptive Positive-Negative Sample Weighting for Policy Optimization in Open-Ended QA
summary: Large Reasoning Models are typically trained via reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR). However, existing approaches adopt fixed weights for positive and negative samples, and the conclusions hardly generalize to open-ended question answering (QA). In this paper, we systematically investigate the roles of positive and negative samples in reinforcement learning for open-ended QA. We propose a reward-mean-based strategy for distinguishing positive from negative samples, and observe that negative samples predominantly govern response diversity and the performance upper bound, whereas positive samples primarily determine response quality and convergence stability. Building on these observations, we propose EAPO, an Entropy-driven Adaptive Policy Optimization method that adaptively computes the weighting coefficients of positive samples based on the ratio of the current policy entropy to the initial entropy. During the entropy-decreasing phase, the weight assigned to positive samples is reduced to preserve exploration, whereas during the entropy-increasing phase it is amplified to reinforce stability, thereby mitigating entropy collapse. Experiments on two publicly available open-ended medical QA datasets demonstrate that EAPO consistently and substantially outperforms fixed-weight baselines in both response diversity and stability.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了开放域问答中RLVR的正负样本作用，提出基于熵驱动自适应策略优化（EAPO）方法，动态调整正样本权重以平衡探索与稳定性，在医疗QA数据集上优于固定权重基线。
AI.motivation: 现有RLVR方法对正负样本采用固定权重，且结论难以泛化到开放域问答场景，缺乏对正负样本角色差异的系统研究。
AI.method: 提出奖励均值策略区分正负样本；提出EAPO方法，基于当前策略熵与初始熵的比值自适应计算正样本权重系数：熵减阶段降低正样本权重以保持探索，熵增阶段放大正样本权重以增强稳定性。
AI.result: 在两个开放域医疗QA数据集上，EAPO在响应多样性和稳定性方面 consistently and substantially 优于固定权重基线。
AI.conclusion: 负样本主导响应多样性和性能上限，正样本主导响应质量和收敛稳定性；EAPO通过自适应权重有效缓解熵坍缩问题。
idea_en: A reward-mean-based strategy for distinguishing positive and negative samples in reinforcement learning for open-ended QA
An entropy-driven adaptive policy optimization method that dynamically adjusts positive sample weights based on the ratio of current policy entropy to initial entropy
A mechanism to mitigate entropy collapse by reducing positive sample weight during entropy-decreasing phase and amplifying it during entropy-increasing phase
idea_ch: 一种基于奖励均值的开放域问答强化学习正负样本区分策略
一种基于当前策略熵与初始熵比值的熵驱动自适应策略优化方法，动态调整正样本权重系数
一种通过熵减阶段降低正样本权重、熵增阶段放大正样本权重来缓解熵坍缩的机制

title: TCP-MCP: Landscape-Guided Co-Evolution of Prompts and Communication Topologies for Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Effective multi-agent systems cannot be designed by selecting prompts or communication graphs in isolation. Agent behavior depends on the information an agent receives, while the usefulness of a communication edge depends on how the receiving agent interprets and uses that information. We propose \textbf{TCP-MCP} (Topology-Coupled Prompting for Multi-Agent Collaborative Problem-Solving), a co-evolution framework that searches agent prompts and communication topologies as a unified genome. TCP-MCP uses an initialization-time landscape probe to calibrate early search behavior, and then relies on Pareto-front diagnostics to adapt exploration under three objectives: task performance, token cost, and structural complexity. Using the same DeepSeek-V3.2 backbone across all methods, TCP-MCP achieves 82.66\%, 89.96\%, and 96.61\% accuracy on MMLU-Pro, MMLU, and GSM8K, respectively. Across the three benchmarks, it consistently outperforms automated graph-generation baselines and achieves competitive accuracy relative to debate-style systems, while using up to 5.69$\times$ fewer tokens than those systems at the reported operating points. These results show that jointly evolving prompts and communication structure provides a practical route to cost-aware and task-adaptive multi-agent system design in controlled evaluations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TCP-MCP框架，将智能体提示词与通信拓扑结构作为统一基因组进行协同进化搜索，在保持高精度的同时大幅降低token消耗，实现了多智能体系统的成本感知与任务自适应设计。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统的性能不能孤立地设计提示词或通信图，两者相互依赖：智能体行为取决于接收到的信息，而通信边的有用性取决于接收智能体如何解释和利用该信息。现有方法将两者分离设计，无法实现最优协同。
AI.method: TCP-MCP采用协同进化框架，将智能体提示词和通信拓扑结构编码为统一基因组进行联合搜索。包含两个关键技术：1) 初始化时通过景观探测(landscape probe)校准早期搜索行为；2) 使用帕累托前沿诊断(Pareto-front diagnostics)在三个目标（任务性能、token成本、结构复杂度）下自适应调整探索策略。
AI.result: 基于DeepSeek-V3.2骨干网络，TCP-MCP在MMLU-Pro、MMLU和GSM8K上分别达到82.66%、89.96%和96.61%的准确率。相比辩论式系统，在保持竞争性精度的同时，token使用量减少最多5.69倍。
AI.conclusion: 联合进化提示词与通信结构为成本感知和任务自适应的多智能体系统设计提供了一条实用路径，在受控评估中超越了自动图生成基线，并与辩论式系统精度相当但成本显著降低。
idea_en: A co-evolution framework for multi-agent systems that encodes agent prompts and communication topology as a unified genome for joint evolutionary search
An initialization-time landscape probe method that calibrates early search behavior in multi-agent system optimization
A Pareto-front diagnostic mechanism that adapts exploration under three objectives: task performance, token cost, and structural complexity
A method for automated discovery of cost-effective communication topologies that reduce token consumption by up to 5.69x while maintaining competitive accuracy
A multi-objective optimization approach for multi-agent system design that jointly considers task accuracy, computational cost, and system complexity
idea_ch: 一种将智能体提示词与通信拓扑结构编码为统一基因组进行联合进化搜索的多智能体系统协同进化框架
一种初始化阶段景观探测方法，用于校准多智能体系统优化中的早期搜索行为
一种帕累托前沿诊断机制，在任务性能、token成本和结构复杂度三个目标下自适应调整探索策略

title: When Context Flips, Safety Breaks: Diagnosing Brittle Safety in Aligned Language Models
summary: Safety benchmark scores provide incomplete evidence of deployment readiness: aligned language models often adhere to rigid rules even when a situational update flips which action is safe. We term this failure brittle safety. To diagnose it, we introduce context-flip evaluation, testing 12 models across a safety benchmark (PacifAIst) and two commonsense controls using paired variants where the nominally safe action produces harm. Three findings emerge. First, brittle safety is safety-specific: all 12 models exhibit a safety-commonsense gap (mean +17.4 pp). Baseline accuracy fails to predict brittleness: among models above 90% baseline accuracy, brittleness rates range from 13.7% to 90.0%. Second, failures stem from policy override rather than miscomprehension: despite acknowledging the context change in every case, models persist via three distinct mechanisms that vary by update type and model family. Third, on a hand-audited probe of catastrophic consequence-flip scenarios, standard action-level guardrails catch none, while a state-aware validator catches all without false alarms on correct interventions. This indicates that action-level content moderation is systematically blind to consequence-flips, motivating state-aware architectural alternatives. We release our protocol, perturbed benchmarks, and deployment probe.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"脆弱安全性"概念，指对齐语言模型在情境变化导致安全行为翻转时仍僵化遵守规则的现象。通过上下文翻转评估，发现12个模型均存在安全-常识差距，失败源于策略覆盖而非理解错误，并提出状态感知验证器作为解决方案。
AI.motivation: 现有安全基准无法充分评估模型在动态情境下的部署就绪性，模型可能在情境变化后仍僵化执行原本安全但当前有害的行为。
AI.method: 设计上下文翻转评估方法，在PacifAIst安全基准和两个常识控制任务上，构建配对变体使名义安全行为产生实际危害，测试12个模型。
AI.result: 所有12个模型均表现出安全-常识差距（平均+17.4个百分点）；基线准确率>90%的模型中脆弱性率范围为13.7%-90.0%；模型虽能感知情境变化但通过三种机制持续犯错；标准动作级护栏无法检测后果翻转，而状态感知验证器可100%检测且无误报。
AI.conclusion: 动作级内容审核系统性地对后果翻转视而不见，建议采用状态感知架构替代方案。
idea_en: Context-flip evaluation protocol for diagnosing brittle safety in aligned language models by testing paired variants where the nominally safe action produces harm after a situational update
State-aware validator that detects consequence-flip scenarios without false alarms, serving as an alternative to standard action-level guardrails
Three distinct failure mechanisms of policy override in persistent harmful behavior despite context change acknowledgment
idea_ch: 上下文翻转评估协议：通过构建配对测试变体，使名义安全行为在情境更新后产生实际危害，用于诊断对齐语言模型的脆弱安全性
状态感知验证器：可检测后果翻转场景且无错误报警，作为标准动作级护栏的替代架构
三种策略覆盖失败机制：识别模型在感知情境变化后仍持续有害行为的三种不同机制，因更新类型和模型家族而异

title: MolLingo: Molecule-Native Representations for LLM-Powered Scientific Agents
summary: We present MolLingo, a multi-agent system that emulates the reasoning process of a chemist to automate molecular design. Existing LLM-based approaches either operate as standalone generative models without access to external tools or lack the multi-agent coordination and shared memory needed for iterative, evidence-driven reasoning across the molecular design pipeline. MolLingo addresses this by coordinating a Literature Agent, a Chemist Agent, and an Orchestrator through a shared memory module, with each agent equipped with domain-specific tools. To enable effective molecular reasoning, we introduce BRICS-based Fragment Enumeration (BFE), a synthesis-aware molecular fragmentation method that decomposes molecules into chemically meaningful building blocks represented as block-based SMILES paired with common chemical names. This representation bridges molecular structure and LLM semantic space, enabling block-level reasoning and editing that is difficult with raw SMILES alone. As a case study in early-stage therapeutic design, MolLingo further grounds the Chemist Agent's reasoning in binding site geometry and residue-level protein context derived from molecular docking to optimize molecules for stronger target binding. Across four benchmarks, MolLingo consistently outperforms frontier LLMs and specialized baselines, including a fourfold docking score improvement over GPT-5.4 despite using the same underlying model, consistent drug property optimization gains across multiple LLM backbones, and state-of-the-art results on TOMG-Bench, surpassing both frontier LLMs and the RL-based optimization method RePO. Our results suggest that LLMs are already capable molecular design assistants when guided through chemically meaningful representations and biologically grounded structural context. Code is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/status/MolLingo-7450.

AI.tldr: MolLingo是一个多智能体系统，通过模拟化学家推理过程来自动化分子设计，在多个基准测试中显著优于GPT-5.4等前沿模型。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的分子设计方法要么是独立的生成模型无法使用外部工具，要么缺乏多智能体协调和共享记忆机制，无法进行迭代的、证据驱动的分子设计推理。
AI.method: MolLingo通过协调文献智能体(Literature Agent)、化学家智能体(Chemist Agent)和编排器(Orchestrator)三个智能体，并共享记忆模块来实现分子设计。核心创新包括BRICS片段枚举(BFE)方法，将分子分解为化学意义上的构建块，以块级SMILES和通用化学名称表示，实现LLM可理解的分子推理编辑。
AI.result: 在四个基准测试中，MolLingo持续优于前沿LLM和专门基线，包括使用相同基础模型时对接分数比GPT-5.4提升4倍，在多个LLM骨干上实现一致的药物性质优化，在TOMG-Bench上取得最先进结果。
AI.conclusion: LLMs在化学上有意义的表示和生物学结构上下文的引导下，已经能够成为有效的分子设计助手。
idea_en: A multi-agent molecular design system (Literature Agent, Chemist Agent, Orchestrator) with shared memory for iterative, evidence-driven molecular reasoning.

BRICS-based Fragment Enumeration (BFE): a synthesis-aware molecular fragmentation method that decomposes molecules into chemically meaningful building blocks represented as block-based SMILES paired with common chemical names.
Block-level molecular reasoning and editing method that bridges molecular structure and LLM semantic space, enabling LLMs to perform molecular design at the fragment level rather than raw SMILES.
A method for grounding Chemist Agent's reasoning in binding site geometry and residue-level protein context derived from molecular docking to optimize molecules for target binding.
idea_ch: 一种多智能体分子设计系统（文献智能体、化学家智能体、编排器）与共享记忆模块，用于迭代的、证据驱动的分子推理。
基于BRICS的片段枚举(BFE)方法：一种合成感知的分子碎片化方法，将分子分解为化学上有意义的构建块，并以块级SMILES搭配通用化学名称进行表示。
块级分子推理与编辑方法：连接分子结构与LLM语义空间，使LLM能够在片段级别而非原始SMILES级别进行分子设计。
基于分子对接的结合位点几何和残基级蛋白质上下文引导化学家智能体推理的方法，以优化分子与靶标的结合能力。

title: C-MIG: Multi-view Information Gain-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Clinical Diagnosis Reasoning
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation combined with reinforcement learning has shown promise for grounding large language models in trustworthy medical evidence. However, existing methods rely on exact-match binary rewards, which in clinical diagnosis cause two issues: (i) semantically relevant but non-verbatim steps receive zero signal, discarding valuable learning signals; and (ii) uni-dimensional rewards cannot effectively supervise heterogeneous reasoning capabilities. To address these issues, we propose C-MIG, a Multi-view Information Gain-based retrieval-augmented generation framework for Clinical diagnosis. C-MIG estimates information gain under a frozen reference model from two complementary views, retrieved-document and document-refinement, to jointly guide what to retrieve and how to refine, alleviating the issues of valuable reward signal loss and credit assignment. We further design a multi-subquery retrieval augmentation strategy that improves knowledge recall coverage in clinical diagnostic scenarios. Comprehensive experiments on four medical benchmarks demonstrate that C-MIG achieves the best performance among all RAG-RL methods on both in-domain and out-of-domain sets, and outperforms state-of-the-art general-purpose LLMs for clinical diagnosis.

AI.tldr: 提出C-MIG框架，通过多视角信息增益估计和多元子查询检索增强，解决临床诊断中基于精确匹配二元奖励导致有价值信号丢失和信用分配问题，在医疗基准测试中取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有检索增强生成结合强化学习的方法在临床诊断中依赖精确匹配的二元奖励，导致语义相关但非逐字匹配的步骤得不到学习信号，且单一维度奖励无法有效监督异构推理能力。
AI.method: 提出C-MIG框架：(1) 在冻结参考模型下从检索文档和文档精炼两个互补视角估计信息增益，联合指导检索内容和精炼方式；(2) 设计多元子查询检索增强策略，提高临床诊断场景中的知识回忆覆盖。
AI.result: 在四个医学基准测试中，C-MIG在所有RAG-RL方法中取得最佳性能，包括领域内和领域外数据集；并优于用于临床诊断的最先进通用大语言模型。
AI.conclusion: 多视角信息增益框架有效解决了临床诊断RAG-RL中的奖励信号丢失和信用分配问题，为医疗AI提供更可靠的推理路径。
idea_en: Multi-view information gain estimation method for RAG-RL that uses two complementary views (retrieved-document and document-refinement) to jointly guide retrieval and refinement decisions.
Multi-subquery retrieval augmentation strategy that improves knowledge recall coverage in clinical diagnostic scenarios.
Frozen reference model-based information gain estimation for providing dense rewards in place of binary exact-match rewards in clinical diagnosis.
idea_ch: 一种多视角信息增益估计方法，通过检索文档和文档精炼两个互补视角联合指导检索内容和精炼方式，替代传统精确匹配二元奖励。
一种多元子查询检索增强策略，通过生成多个子查询扩大知识召回覆盖范围，提升临床诊断场景中的信息检索完整性。
基于冻结参考模型的信息增益计算方法，为强化学习提供密集奖励信号，解决临床诊断中语义相关但非逐字匹配步骤的奖励信号丢失问题。

title: FundaPod: A Multi-Persona Agent Pod Platform with Knowledge Graph Memory for AI-Assisted Fundamental Investment Research
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied in finance, yet most existing work emphasizes trading signals or financial NLP tasks centered on prediction. Institutional fundamental research, by contrast, requires human analysts or AI agents to gather evidence, identify business drivers, compare competing viewpoints, and generate investment memos. Its broader goal is not merely to predict outcomes, but to produce investment plans that are transparent, reusable, and verifiable, while contributing to the cumulative development of investment knowledge. We present FundaPod, a multi-persona agent platform for AI-assisted fundamental investment research. We argue that fundamental research is a human-centric decision-support task that is qualitatively distinct from trading-signal generation, and is therefore better served by an independence-preserving architecture. In FundaPod, AI agents with different personas, such as value investors or macro strategists, conduct research independently under a shared provenance contract. Their disagreements are then surfaced post hoc for adjudication by the human portfolio manager (PM) through a knowledge-graph memory system. This paper contributes five design principles for human-AI hybrid systems supporting fundamental research, grounded in design-science practice and theories of cognitive isolation and human-machine coordination. It also describes four architectural mechanisms: a persona distillation pipeline that turns public investor materials into deployable agents; a declarative skill registry that lets the planner derive typed task graphs; a grounded evidence model that links memo claims to verifiable sources; and a knowledge-graph "second brain" that connects tickers, memos, analysts, and themes. We demonstrate the architecture through a complete case study and a persona-based memo comparison.

AI.tldr: FundaPod是一个面向基础投资研究的多角色AI代理平台，通过独立性保持架构、知识图谱记忆系统和人工裁决机制，支持人类分析师进行证据收集、观点比较和投资备忘录生成，而非简单的预测或交易信号生成。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在金融领域的应用多集中于交易信号或预测型NLP任务，但基础研究需要人类分析师进行证据收集、业务驱动因素识别、竞争观点比较和投资备忘录生成，其目标是产生透明、可复用、可验证的投资计划，而现有系统未能良好支持这一人类主导的决策支持任务。
AI.method: 提出五项设计原则（基于设计科学实践及认知隔离与人机协调理论）；构建四种架构机制：(1)角色蒸馏管道——将公开投资者材料转化为可部署的AI代理；(2)声明式技能注册表——让规划器推导类型化任务图；(3)基于证据的模型——将备忘录声明链接到可验证来源；(4)知识图谱"第二大脑"——连接股票代码、备忘录、分析师和主题。通过完整案例研究和基于角色的备忘录比较进行验证。
AI.result: 通过案例研究和角色备忘录比较展示了FundaPod架构的有效性，证明多角色独立研究+事后裁决的架构能产生透明、可验证的投资分析结果。
AI.conclusion: 基础投资研究是人机协作的决策支持任务，应采用独立性保持架构而非传统预测模型，FundaPod的五项设计原则和四种架构机制为构建此类系统提供了可行方案。
idea_en: Multi-persona AI agent platform for fundamental investment research where agents with different investment personas (e.g., value investors, macro strategists) conduct independent research under a shared provenance contract
Persona distillation pipeline that converts publicly available investor materials (letters, interviews, transcripts) into deployable AI agents with specific investment philosophies
Declarative skill registry system enabling a planner to derive typed task graphs for organizing research workflows
Grounded evidence model that links investment memo claims to verifiable, traceable source documents
Knowledge-graph memory system ('second brain') connecting tickers, memos, analysts, and investment themes for cumulative knowledge development
Independence-preserving architecture for human-AI hybrid decision support where AI agents research independently and disagreements are surfaced post hoc for human adjudication
Provenance contract mechanism for tracking and verifying the research contributions of multiple AI agents with different personas
Cognitive isolation theory applied to multi-agent financial research systems to prevent premature consensus formation
idea_ch: 面向基础投资研究的多角色AI代理平台，不同投资角色（如价值投资者、宏观策略师）的AI代理在共享溯源合约下独立开展研究
角色蒸馏管道：将公开投资者材料（信件、访谈、转录稿）转化为可部署的、具有特定投资哲学的AI代理
声明式技能注册表系统：使规划器能够推导类型化任务图，用于组织研究工作流
基于证据的模型：将投资备忘录中的声明链接到可验证、可追溯的源文档
知识图谱'第二大脑'：连接股票代码、备忘录、分析师和投资主题，支持知识的累积发展
人机混合决策支持的独立性保持架构：AI代理独立研究，事后将分歧呈现给人类进行裁决
溯源合约机制：跟踪和验证多个不同角色AI代理的研究贡献
基于认知隔离理论的多代理金融研究系统设计，防止过早形成共识

title: AIBuildAI-2: A Knowledge-Enhanced Agent for Automatically Building AI Models
summary: AI models underpin data-centric applications from image and text processing to scientific discovery in biology, physics, and chemistry. Yet developing them remains heavily manual, requiring practitioners to design architectures, build training pipelines, and iteratively refine solutions, making it challenging for natural scientists without specialized AI engineering expertise to build the high-performing models their research demands. To reduce this burden and broaden access to AI for scientific discovery, agents that automatically build AI models have been proposed. However, the performance of these agents is largely limited by the parametric knowledge of their underlying large language models, which is static, often outdated, and sparse on practical AI model engineering know-how. To address this limitation, we introduce AIBuildAI-2, a knowledge-enhanced agent with an external, evolving knowledge system for automatically building AI models. The knowledge system of AIBuildAI-2 is hierarchical, organizing curated AI development knowledge into high-level knowledge instructions over topical categories and low-level knowledge documents under each category, from which the agent dynamically loads only the context relevant to its current state and the AI task being solved, grounding each design and implementation decision in concrete, externally verifiable expertise. The system is initialized by collecting and cleaning AI-development-related documents from the web and organizing them into the corresponding categories, and continually evolves from the agent's own experience by distilling each completed run on an AI task into structured takeaways that are written back into the knowledge system. AIBuildAI-2 achieves state-of-the-art results, ranking first on MLE-Bench with a 70.7% medal rate and placing in the top 6.6% among 4,370 human-expert teams in a heart disease prediction competition.

AI.tldr: 提出AIBuildAI-2，一个具备外部进化知识系统的智能体，用于自动构建高性能AI模型，在MLE-Bench和心脏病预测竞赛中取得顶尖成绩。
AI.motivation: 现有AI模型开发高度依赖人工，自然科学家难以构建高性能模型；已有的自动构建智能体受限于大语言模型的静态、过时且稀疏的参数化知识。
AI.method: 构建分层知识系统：高层知识指令（主题类别）+ 低层知识文档（具体类别）；根据当前状态和AI任务动态加载相关上下文；初始从网页收集整理文档，持续通过蒸馏自身经验更新知识库。
AI.result: MLE-Bench排名第一，奖牌率70.7%；在4370个人类专家团队参与的心脏病预测竞赛中位列前6.6%。
AI.conclusion: 外部进化知识系统能显著提升AI自动建模智能体的性能，通过将经验蒸馏为结构化知识回写知识库实现持续进化。
idea_en: A hierarchical knowledge system for AI model-building agents that dynamically loads only context-relevant knowledge instructions and documents based on the agent's current state and task
A continual learning mechanism that distills completed AI development runs into structured takeaways and writes them back into an external knowledge system
An automated pipeline for collecting, cleaning, and organizing web-sourced AI development documents into a topical category hierarchy for agent usage
A knowledge-enhanced agent architecture that grounds each design and implementation decision in externally verifiable expertise rather than relying on static LLM parametric knowledge
idea_ch: 一种为AI建模智能体设计的分层知识系统，根据智能体当前状态和AI任务动态加载上下文相关的知识指令和文档
一种持续学习机制，将完成的AI开发运行经验蒸馏为结构化要点并回写到外部知识系统中
一种自动化流水线，从网页收集、清洗AI开发文档，并按主题类别层次化组织供智能体使用
一种知识增强型智能体架构，将每个设计和实现决策建立在外部可验证的专业知识之上，而非依赖静态的大语言模型参数化知识

title: Towards Faithful Agentic XAI: A Verification Method and an Open-World Benchmark for Better Model Faithfulness
summary: Explainable AI (XAI) helps users interpret model behavior and identify potential faults. Agentic XAI systems use Large Language Models (LLMs) to make explanations more accessible through natural-language interaction, but they can also produce plausible yet unfaithful explanations. This risk arises because unreliable XAI outputs for complex models can be amplified by LLMs and mislead users. We propose Faithful Agentic XAI (FAX), a framework that improves explanation faithfulness through explicit verification. FAX decomposes draft explanations into claims and cross-checks them against inherently faithful tools, filtering unsupported or contradictory claims before final generation. We also introduce CRAFTER-XAI-Bench, an open-world reinforcement learning benchmark with complex policies, diverse goals, and challenging scenarios for assessing model-specific faithfulness. On CRAFTER-XAI-Bench, FAX improves simulation faithfulness from 0.20 for the strongest baseline to 0.46 while maintaining high informativeness, relevance, and fluency. On three tabular benchmarks, FAX performs competitively with prior Agentic XAI baselines, but our analysis shows that these settings can conflate task accuracy with model-specific faithfulness. These findings show that explicit verification is essential for faithful Agentic XAI and that that faithfulness benchmarks must be designed to test explanations against the behavior of the target model itself.

AI.tldr: 提出FAX框架，通过将解释分解为声明并利用可信工具交叉验证，提升可解释AI的忠实性；同时构建CRAFTER-XAI-Bench基准评估忠实性。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的Agentic XAI系统可能生成看似合理但不忠实的解释，误导用户。现有方法缺乏对解释忠实性的显式验证机制。
AI.method: FAX框架将草稿解释分解为声明，利用内在可信的工具（如特征归因方法）进行交叉验证，过滤不支持或矛盾的声明，最终生成忠实解释。
AI.result: 在CRAFTER-XAI-Bench上，FAX将模拟忠实性从0.20提升至0.46；在三个表格基准上表现与先前方法相当。
AI.conclusion: 显式验证对于忠实Agentic XAI至关重要，忠实性基准测试必须针对目标模型行为设计。
idea_en: A framework for improving explanation faithfulness in agentic XAI systems by decomposing draft explanations into atomic claims and cross-verifying each claim against inherently faithful tools (e.g., feature attribution methods) to filter unsupported or contradictory content before final generation.

An open-world reinforcement learning benchmark (CRAFTER-XAI-Bench) with complex policies, diverse goals, and challenging scenarios specifically designed for assessing model-specific faithfulness of explanations.

A claim-level verification mechanism that systematically checks each decomposed claim against multiple faithful tools, enabling fine-grained filtering of unreliable content in LLM-generated explanations.
A method for maintaining high informativeness, relevance, and fluency while explicitly verifying explanation faithfulness through tool-based cross-checking.
idea_ch: 一种通过将草稿解释分解为原子声明、并利用内在可信工具（如特征归因方法）逐一交叉验证的Agentic XAI解释忠实性提升框架，在最终生成前过滤掉不支持或矛盾的内容。
一个面向开放世界强化学习的基准测试集（CRAFTER-XAI-Bench），包含复杂策略、多样化目标和挑战性场景，专门用于评估模型特异的解释忠实性。
一种声明级的验证机制，系统性地将每个分解后的声明与多个可信工具进行交叉检查，实现对LLM生成解释中不可靠内容的细粒度过滤。
一种在通过工具交叉检查显式验证解释忠实性的同时，保持高信息量、相关性和流畅性的方法。

title: PortBench: A Correlation-Aware, Full-Pipeline Benchmark for LLM-Driven Portfolio Management
summary: LLMs have shown strong performance across diverse financial tasks, yet portfolio management (PM), a critical financial decision-making task, remains poorly benchmarked. Existing benchmarks exhibit two main gaps: they ignore cross-asset correlation structures, thereby failing to distinguish genuinely diversified portfolios from concentrated ones, and fail to evaluate the complete PM decision pipeline in real-world scenarios. We introduce PortBench, a benchmark spanning six heterogeneous asset classes over ten years. PortBench consists of two complementary layers: a static QA dataset of 6,269 correlation-based questions across seven task templates, and a dynamic five-stage allocation pipeline that mirrors the full PM decision cycle. To evaluate these layers, we introduce two dedicated metrics: a dual-layer correlation score that measures whether proposed portfolios exploit inter-class hedging and avoid intra-class concentration, and CEPS, a metric that quantifies how reasoning errors compound across pipeline stages. We further assess strategy robustness and investor alignment under three historical stress regimes and risk profiles. Evaluating ten frontier LLMs, we find that despite strong performance on static financial QA, 90\% of model-profile combinations fail to outperform a basic equal-weight allocation, and models that satisfy every procedural constraint still suffer catastrophic drawdowns under stress. Our source code is available at \href{https://github.com/AgenticFinLab/portbench}{this https URL}.

AI.tldr: PortBench是一个面向大语言模型的投资组合管理基准测试，包含十年跨六大资产类别的静态QA数据集（6269个问题）和动态五阶段分配管线，评估发现尽管LLM在静态金融QA上表现优异，但90%的模型-配置组合无法超越等权重分配基准，且在压力测试下存在严重回撤。
AI.motivation: 现有金融基准存在两大缺陷：忽略跨资产相关性结构，无法区分真正分散化投资组合与集中投资组合；未能评估完整投资组合管理决策管线在真实场景中的表现。
AI.method: 构建PortBench基准，包含两个互补层级：静态QA数据集（6269个基于相关性的问题，7个任务模板）和动态五阶段分配管线（模拟完整PM决策循环）；引入双重指标：双层相关性分数（衡量跨类对冲与类内集中度）和CEPS（量化推理错误在管线各阶段的累积效应）；在三种历史压力机制和风险画像下评估策略稳健性。
AI.result: 90%的模型-配置组合未能超越简单等权重分配；满足所有程序约束的模型在压力场景下仍遭受灾难性回撤。
AI.conclusion: LLM在静态金融QA上表现优异，但在完整投资组合管理决策流程中存在显著不足，现有模型无法有效处理跨资产相关性及压力情境下的风险管理。
idea_en: A dual-layer correlation scoring metric for evaluating portfolio diversification that separately measures cross-asset class hedging effectiveness and intra-asset class concentration risk
CEPS (Compounding Error Propagation Score) - a metric to quantify how reasoning errors accumulate and compound across sequential stages of portfolio management pipeline
A five-stage dynamic allocation pipeline architecture that mirrors the complete portfolio management decision cycle for evaluating AI systems
A benchmark framework incorporating historical stress regimes (three types) and investor risk profiles to test strategy robustness under adverse conditions
idea_ch: 双层相关性评分指标：分别衡量跨资产类别的对冲有效性和同类资产内部的集中度风险，用于评估投资组合的真正分散化程度
CEPS（复合错误传播评分）指标：量化推理错误在投资组合管理管线各阶段之间如何累积和放大的度量方法
五阶段动态分配管线架构：模拟完整投资组合管理决策循环的评估框架，可用于评测AI系统的全流程决策能力
基于历史压力机制（三种类型）和投资者风险画像的基准测试方法：用于评估策略在不利市场条件下的稳健性

title: A Unified Framework for the Evaluation of LLM Agentic Capabilities
summary: As LLMs are increasingly deployed as agents, reliable assessment of their agentic capabilities has become essential. However, reported benchmark scores often jointly reflect model capability and the implementation choices each benchmark is packaged with, making cross-benchmark results difficult to interpret as clean measurements of the underlying model. In this work, we present a unified framework for the fair evaluation of LLM agentic capabilities. Driven by a unified configuration system, the framework integrates diverse benchmarks into a standardized instruction--tool--environment format, executes agents through a fixed ReAct-style architecture within a controllable sandbox, and provides an optional offline setting that replaces volatile live environments with curated snapshots, so that framework effects and environment effects can be analyzed separately. Building on this, we unify the evaluation methodology under each benchmark's original task-success criteria, while introducing unified metrics for resource consumption and a taxonomy for decision- and execution-level failure attribution. Within this framework, we adapt 7 widely used benchmarks spanning 24 domains across single-agent, multi-agent, and safety-critical scenarios, and conduct a large-scale empirical analysis over 400K rollouts and 5B tokens on 15 models. The results show that scaffold choice and environmental volatility materially shift benchmark outcomes in both directions, allowing our framework to disentangle intrinsic LLM capabilities from framework- and environment-induced artifacts. We further demonstrate its extensibility as a secure testbed for safety-critical domains. Codes and benchmarks at are available at https://github.com/whfeLingYu/A-Unified-Framework-for-the-Evaluation-of-LLM-Agentic-Capabilities, https://huggingface.co/AgentFramework/Unified_Farmework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的LLM智能体能力评估框架，通过标准化配置系统将不同基准测试整合为统一的指令-工具-环境格式，采用固定ReAct架构和可控沙箱执行，并提供离线模式分离框架效应与环境效应。基于该框架对7个基准测试、24个领域、15个模型进行大规模实证分析（40万次运行、50亿token），发现脚手架选择和环境的波动性会显著改变基准测试结果。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM智能体基准测试得分往往混合了模型自身能力与基准测试实现中的各种选择（如脚手架、环境配置等），使得跨基准测试的结果难以解释为对模型底层能力的纯净测量。需要一种能够分离框架效应和环境效应的统一评估方法。
AI.method: 提出统一框架：1) 统一的配置系统将不同基准测试标准化为指令-工具-环境格式；2) 固定ReAct架构的可控沙箱执行；3) 可选的离线模式用快照替代实时环境；4) 统一的任务成功标准评估指标，引入资源消耗指标和决策/执行级失败分类体系。
AI.result: 对7个基准测试、24个领域、15个模型进行超过40万次rollout和50亿token的实证分析，证明了脚手架选择和环境波动性会双向显著改变基准测试结果，该框架能够有效分离LLM内在能力与框架/环境引入的伪影。
AI.conclusion: 该统一框架为LLM智能体能力的公平评估提供了可行方案，能够解耦模型能力与框架/环境因素，并可作为安全关键领域的可信测试平台。
idea_en: A unified configuration system that standardizes diverse LLM agent benchmarks into a consistent instruction-tool-environment format, enabling fair cross-benchmark comparisons.
A controllable sandbox execution environment with fixed ReAct-style architecture that isolates framework-induced artifacts from intrinsic model capabilities.
An optional offline evaluation mode that replaces volatile live environments with curated snapshots, allowing separate analysis of environmental volatility effects.
A unified resource consumption metric and taxonomy for decision-level and execution-level failure attribution in LLM agent evaluation.
A method for disentangling intrinsic LLM capabilities from framework- and environment-induced artifacts through large-scale empirical analysis across standardized benchmarks.
idea_ch: 一种统一配置系统，将不同的LLM智能体基准测试标准化为一致的指令-工具-环境格式，可实现跨基准测试的公平比较。
一种可控沙箱执行环境，采用固定ReAct架构，能够隔离框架引入的伪影与模型内在能力。
一种可选的离线评估模式，用精心策划的快照替代波动的实时环境，可单独分析环境波动性的影响。
一套统一的资源消耗指标和决策级/执行级失败归因分类体系，用于LLM智能体评估。
一种通过大规模实证分析在标准化基准测试上分离LLM内在能力与框架/环境引入伪影的方法。

title: SKILLC: Learning Autonomous Skill Internalization in LLM Agents via Contrastive Credit Assignment
summary: Structured skill prompts improve exploration in long-horizon agentic reinforcement learning (RL). Skill-augmented RL methods retain external skills at inference, while skill-internalization RL methods withdraw them during training to enable autonomous performance. However, existing internalization approaches only use skill-helpfulness contrast for curriculum control, leaving the policy update unchanged and unable to distinguish skill-dependent from autonomous success. We propose SkillC, a framework based on Contrastive Skill Credit Assignment (CSCA) that converts this contrast into a direct learning signal for internalization. \textsc{SkillC} samples paired skill-injected and skill-free rollouts for tasks from active skill types within the same policy update, and injects their task-level contrast into optimization via a dual-stream advantage estimator that preserves global ranking while applying a one-sided correction toward skill-free success. A smoothed validation-level signal further drives an adaptive curriculum over attribution strength, rollout allocation, and monotonic active-set pruning. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebShop show that, without runtime skill access, SkillC surpasses the strongest prior skill-internalization RL baseline by 5.5\% and 4.4\%, respectively, while remaining competitive with skill-augmented RL methods.

AI.tldr: SkillC通过对比性技能信用分配框架，将技能帮助性对比转化为直接学习信号，实现无需推理时技能访问的自主策略学习，在ALFWorld和WebShop上超越现有技能内化强化学习方法。
AI.motivation: 现有技能内化强化学习方法仅利用技能帮助性对比进行课程控制，策略更新本身不变，无法区分依赖技能的成功与自主成功，导致内化效果不佳。
AI.method: 提出SkillC框架，包括：(1) 成对采样技能注入与无技能轨迹，在同一策略更新中对比；(2) 双流优势估计器，保留全局排序同时对无技能成功施加单侧修正；(3) 利用平滑的验证级信号驱动自适应课程，控制归因强度、轨迹分配和单调激活集剪枝。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop上，SkillC超越最强技能内化基线5.5%和4.4%，且与需要推理时技能访问的技能增强方法竞争力相当。
AI.conclusion: 通过将技能帮助性对比转化为直接学习信号，SkillC实现了更有效的技能内化，无需运行时技能访问即可达到接近技能增强方法的性能。
idea_en: Contrastive Skill Credit Assignment (CSCA): A dual-stream advantage estimator that preserves global ranking while applying one-sided correction toward skill-free success, enabling direct learning from skill-helpfulness contrast.
Adaptive curriculum mechanism using smoothed validation-level signals for controlling attribution strength, rollout allocation, and monotonic active-set pruning in skill internalization.
Paired skill-injected and skill-free rollout sampling within the same policy update for task-level contrast in agentic reinforcement learning.
Skill-free autonomous policy training framework that eliminates runtime skill access while maintaining competitiveness with skill-augmented methods.
idea_ch: 对比性技能信用分配（CSCA）方法：提出双流优势估计器，在保留全局排序的同时对无技能成功施加单侧修正，将技能帮助性对比转化为直接学习信号。
基于平滑验证级信号的自适应课程机制：用于控制技能内化过程中的归因强度、轨迹分配和单调激活集剪枝，实现自主学习进度自适应调整。
同一策略更新内的成对技能注入与无技能轨迹采样方法：在强化学习中对任务级对比进行直接优化，提升技能内化效率。
无需运行时技能访问的自主策略训练框架：通过技能内化消除推理时对外部技能的依赖，同时保持与技能增强方法相当的性能。

title: Dr-CiK: A Testbed for Foresight-Driven Agents
summary: Time series forecasting in real-world settings often depends not only on historical observations, but also on external context that must be actively discovered from noisy, heterogeneous information sources. Yet existing context-aided forecasting benchmarks typically assume that the supporting context is already provided, leaving open whether agents can identify it on their own. Therefore, we introduce Dr-CiK, a benchmark for evaluating whether agents can retrieve forecasting-relevant supporting context from a document corpus, filter out distractors, distill the retrieved context into forecast-useful evidence, and generate forecasts supported by that evidence. Through context ablations and evaluations of state-of-the-art deep research and forecasting methods paired together, we show that high-quality context substantially improves forecasting performance in Dr-CiK. However, most existing DR agents recover only a small fraction of the ground-truth supporting evidence (usually <5%), are frequently misled by distractors (>80% distractor citations), and can cause forecasters to perform worse with retrieved context than without context. Our results motivate research on foresight-driven agents that search for the right context to predict the future.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Dr-CiK基准，评估智能体从文档语料库中自主检索与时间序列预测相关的支持性上下文、过滤干扰、蒸馏证据并生成预测的能力。实验表明高质量上下文显著提升预测性能，但现有深度研究方法只能恢复极少真实证据，且常被干扰误导，导致检索上下文反而损害预测效果。
AI.motivation: 现有上下文辅助预测基准通常假设支持性上下文已提供，未评估智能体自主发现相关上下文的能力。现实预测中上下文需从嘈杂异构信息源中主动发现。
AI.method: 构建Dr-CiK基准，包含文档语料库、支持性上下文、干扰项和预测任务。评估智能体在检索、过滤、蒸馏和生成预测四个环节的表现。
AI.result: 高质量上下文显著提升预测性能；现有DR代理仅恢复<5%的真实证据；>80%的引用来自干扰项；检索上下文反而导致预测效果低于无上下文基线。
AI.conclusion: 现有方法在预测驱动型上下文检索方面严重不足，亟需研究能主动搜索正确上下文以预测未来的智能体。
idea_en: A benchmark system (Dr-CiK) for evaluating autonomous retrieval of forecasting-relevant supporting context from document corpora with integrated distractor filtering and evidence distillation.
A method for context ablation analysis to quantify the causal impact of retrieved vs. ground-truth context on time series forecasting performance.
A pipeline integrating deep research agents with forecasting models, coupled with metrics for citation quality (distractor rate) and evidence recovery rate.
A foresight-driven agent architecture that actively searches for predictive context rather than passively relying on provided information.
idea_ch: 一种从文档语料库自主检索预测相关上下文并集成干扰过滤与证据蒸馏的基准评估系统(Dr-CiK)
一种通过上下文消融分析量化检索上下文与真实上下文对时间序列预测性能因果影响的方法
一种将深度研究代理与预测模型相集成的流水线，并配套引用质量（干扰引用率）和证据恢复率等评估指标
一种远见驱动型智能体架构，能够主动搜索有助于预测未来的上下文信息，而非被动依赖已提供的信息

title: Reasoning Matters: Mitigate Hallucination in Multimodal Large Reasoning Models via Reasoning-Conditioned Preference Optimization
summary: Multimodal Large Reasoning Models introduce the reasoning paradigm, demonstrating strong capabilities on complex vision-language tasks. However, they still suffer from severe hallucinations. Existing training-based methods typically mitigate hallucinations through response-level direct preference optimization (DPO), where the Chain-of-Thought (CoT) and the final answer are treated as a monolithic output and optimized jointly. We reveal that this formulation performs similarly to answer-only optimization, suggesting that it primarily learns answer-level preference, while leaving CoT-level supervision insufficiently exploited. To address this issue, we explicitly formulate a CoT-oriented preference term and derive Reasoning-Conditioned Direct Preference Optimization (RC-DPO), which models the CoT as a condition for answer generation and contrasts the preference for the same preferred answer under different CoT conditions, promoting answer-supportive reasoning chain alignment. To further improve optimization, we introduce a reasoning-enhanced preference data generation strategy that employs Monte Carlo Tree Search to discover visually grounded and logically consistent CoTs as positive samples, and attention-guided CoT token pruning to construct negative ones. Extensive experiments across various models and benchmarks show that RC-DPO effectively mitigates hallucinations and improves the reliability of the multimodal reasoning process.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RC-DPO方法，通过将思维链（CoT）作为答案生成的条件进行偏好优化，并引入MCTS和注意力引导的CoT剪枝策略生成正负样本，有效缓解多模态大语言模型中的幻觉问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于训练的方法通常通过响应级直接偏好优化（DPO）来缓解幻觉，但将CoT和最终答案作为整体输出联合优化，导致主要学习答案级偏好，而CoT级监督未被充分利用。
AI.method: 提出推理条件直接偏好优化（RC-DPO）：1) 将CoT显式建模为答案生成的条件，对相同答案在不同CoT条件下的偏好进行对比，促进答案支持性推理链对齐；2) 采用蒙特卡洛树搜索生成视觉基础且逻辑一致的CoT作为正样本；3) 采用注意力引导的CoT Token剪枝构建负样本。
AI.result: 在各种模型和基准上的大量实验表明，RC-DPO有效缓解了幻觉，提高了多模态推理过程的可靠性。
AI.conclusion: RC-DPO通过显式建模CoT偏好，利用MCTS和注意力剪枝策略生成高质量正负样本，有效解决了多模态大推理模型中的幻觉问题。
idea_en: Reasoning-Conditioned Direct Preference Optimization (RC-DPO): A method that explicitly models Chain-of-Thought (CoT) as a condition for answer generation and contrasts preferences for the same preferred answer under different CoT conditions, promoting answer-supportive reasoning chain alignment.
Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) based positive sample generation for CoT: Using MCTS to discover visually grounded and logically consistent CoT reasoning chains as positive training samples.
Attention-guided CoT token pruning for negative sample construction: A method that prunes CoT tokens based on attention mechanisms to generate negative reasoning chain samples.

CoT-oriented preference optimization formulation: Explicitly separating CoT-level supervision from answer-level optimization in DPO, overcoming the limitation of treating CoT and final answer as a monolithic output.
idea_ch: 推理条件直接偏好优化（RC-DPO）：将思维链（CoT）显式建模为答案生成的条件，对比相同首选答案在不同CoT条件下的偏好，促进答案支持性推理链对齐。
基于蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）的CoT正样本生成：利用MCTS探索并发现具有视觉基础和逻辑一致性的CoT推理链作为正训练样本。
注意力引导的CoT Token剪枝负样本构建：基于注意力机制对CoT Token进行剪枝，生成负推理链样本的方法。
面向CoT的偏好优化公式：将CoT级监督与答案级优化在DPO中显式分离，克服了将CoT和最终答案视为整体输出进行优化的局限性。

title: SuiChat-CN: Benchmarking Contextual Suicide Risk Assessment in Chinese Group Chats
summary: Suicide is a critical global public health challenge, causing approximately 720,000 deaths each year and calling for timely, effective prevention strategies. Existing computational studies primarily focus on post-based social media platforms such as Twitter and Weibo, leaving instant messaging environments such as Telegram underexplored. Yet group chats pose distinct challenges: messages are short, fragmented, multi-party, and often rely on implicit or culturally specific expressions, making isolated post-level analysis insufficient. We introduce SuiChat-CN, a Chinese group-chat benchmark for contextual suicide risk assessment. We collect public Telegram group-chat data, construct coherent conversational segments through signal-word extraction and bidirectional context expansion, and annotate user risk levels with an expert-validated, LLM-assisted paradigm. SuiChat-CN contains 13,312 contextual segments from 1,406 users, covering 258,228 raw chat messages. Extensive experiments with PLMs and more than 40 LLMs demonstrate that contextual information is essential for reliable risk assessment, while fine-tuning and partial-context evaluation further reveal the challenges of early detection in multi-party conversations. Due to ethical and sensitivity concerns, the dataset is not publicly released but will be shared with accredited mental health and suicide-prevention research institutions upon reasonable request.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了SuiChat-CN，一个中文群聊自杀风险评估基准数据集，包含13,312个上下文片段和1,406名用户，通过信号词提取和双向上下文扩展构建对话段，并采用专家验证的LLM辅助标注范式。实验表明上下文信息对自杀风险评估至关重要，而微调和部分上下文评估揭示了多方对话早期检测的挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有计算研究主要关注基于帖子的社交媒体平台（如Twitter、微博），而即时通讯环境（如Telegram群聊）被忽视。群聊消息具有短小、碎片化、多方参与的特点，常依赖隐晦或文化特定的表达，使得孤立的消息级分析不足以进行有效的自杀风险评估。
AI.method: 从公开Telegram群聊数据中收集信息，通过信号词提取和双向上下文扩展构建连贯的对话段，采用专家验证的LLM辅助标注范式对用户风险等级进行标注，构建了SuiChat-CN基准数据集。
AI.result: SuiChat-CN包含13,312个上下文段、1,406名用户、258,228条原始聊天消息。实验表明上下文信息对可靠的风险评估至关重要，微调和部分上下文评估揭示了多方对话早期检测的挑战。
AI.conclusion: 上下文信息是群聊场景下自杀风险评估的关键，多方对话的早期检测仍面临挑战。数据集将向经认证的心理健康和自杀预防研究机构开放。
idea_en: A method for constructing coherent conversational segments from fragmented group chat messages using signal-word extraction and bidirectional context expansion, enabling contextual analysis of suicide risk in multi-party chat environments.

An LLM-assisted annotation paradigm with expert validation for labeling user suicide risk levels in group chat conversations, improving annotation quality and efficiency for sensitive mental health data.

A contextual suicide risk assessment framework specifically designed for instant messaging group chats (e.g., Telegram), addressing challenges of short, fragmented, and culturally implicit expressions in multi-party conversations.
A partially-context evaluation method for early detection of suicide risk in multi-party conversations, enabling risk assessment with limited conversational context available at early stages.
idea_ch: 一种基于信号词提取和双向上下文扩展的群聊碎片化消息对话段构建方法，能够在多方聊天环境中实现自杀风险的情境化分析。
一种LLM辅助标注结合专家验证的用户自杀风险等级标注范式，用于群聊对话中敏感心理健康数据的高质量标注。
一种专为即时通讯群聊（如Telegram）设计的上下文自杀风险评估框架，解决多方对话中短消息、碎片化和文化隐晦表达带来的挑战。
一种面向多方对话自杀风险早期检测的部分上下文评估方法，能够在早期阶段使用有限的对话上下文进行风险评估。

title: Show, Don't TELL: Explainable AI-Generated Text Detection
summary: Research on AI-generated text detection has presented a number of approaches to discern human from AI prose, some of which achieving high in-distribution performance. However, real-world applicability has stalled because their outputs are misaligned with the needs of users, such as professors, who are presented with a numeric score that has no attached explanation. We tackle this issue with a novel architecture, TELL, that bakes explainability from the ground-up. While our system still offers a numerical score like other detectors for comparability, TELL takes a fundamentally different approach where we aim to show the user the "tells" by which the model believes a text is AI or human-written, to empower the user to decide who wrote a text using their own judgment and understanding of the context of the writing and its alleged author. We train TELL on a custom SFT dataset of domain-specific authorship annotations, and further refine the system using GRPO with curriculum learning to improve performance. We achieve competitive performance with state-of-the-art detectors (AUROC 0.927) while natively providing annotations that explain the basis for the detector's decision. We further evaluate the quality of our explanations using a dataset of human annotations and report a high (mean 72.3%) win-rate on annotation concreteness, falsifiability, coherence, plausibility and grounding, allowing users to critically think and decide for themselves. Our work thus reframes the problem of AI-generated text detection in a human-centric perspective and paves the way for a new family of detectors that focus on native explainability.

AI.tldr: 提出一种名为TELL的新型可解释AI文本检测架构，它不仅输出分数，还能提供文本中体现"AI痕迹"的标注解释，让用户自行判断文本来源。
AI.motivation: 现有AI文本检测器虽然准确率较高，但只输出无解释的数值分数，与实际用户（如教授）的需求不匹配，缺乏可解释性和用户赋能。
AI.method: 1) 设计TELL架构，从底层融入可解释性；2) 在自定义SFT数据集上进行领域特定作者归属标注训练；3) 使用GRPO结合课程学习进一步优化；4) 输出数值分数的同时提供文本中"tells"（AI痕迹）的标注。
AI.result: AUROC达0.927，与最先进检测器性能相当；在解释质量评估中（具体性、可证伪性、连贯性、合理性和依据性）平均胜率达72.3%。
AI.conclusion: 重新定义了AI文本检测问题，从以模型为中心转向以人为中心，为具备原生可解释性的新一代检测器开辟了道路。
idea_en: A method for AI-generated text detection that provides both a numerical score and native explainability by highlighting specific 'tells' (text segments) that indicate AI authorship, enabling users to make informed judgments.

A training pipeline combining supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on domain-specific authorship annotations with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and curriculum learning to improve both detection accuracy and explanation quality.
An evaluation framework for AI text detection explanation quality based on five metrics: concreteness, falsifiability, coherence, plausibility, and grounding, measured by human annotation win-rate.
A human-centric AI text detection architecture that reframes the detection problem from model-centric scoring to user-empowering explainability, applicable to educational and professional settings.
idea_ch: 一种AI生成文本检测方法，通过高亮标注文本中体现"AI痕迹"的特定片段，同时提供数值分数和原生可解释性，使用户能够基于自身判断做出决策。
一种结合领域特定作者归属标注的监督微调（SFT）与GRPO（组相对策略优化）及课程学习的训练流水线，同时提升检测准确率和解释质量。
一种基于五项指标（具体性、可证伪性、连贯性、合理性和依据性）的AI文本检测解释质量评估框架，通过人类标注胜率进行量化评价。
一种以人为中心的AI文本检测架构，将检测问题从以模型为中心的评分重新定义为赋能用户的可解释性方案，适用于教育和专业场景。

title: Harness-Bench: Measuring Harness Effects across Models in Realistic Agent Workflows
comment: 16 pages, 4 figures, 11 tables. The first three authors contributed equally
summary: LLM agents are increasingly deployed as executable systems that use tools, modify workspaces, and produce concrete artifacts. In such workflows, performance depends not only on the base model, but also on the harness: the system layer that manages context, tools, state, constraints, permissions, tracing, and recovery. However, existing benchmarks typically abstract away execution, compare complete agent systems, or hold the harness fixed, making execution-layer variation difficult to study. We introduce Harness-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark for evaluating configuration-level harness effects in realistic agent workflows. Harness-Bench evaluates representative harness configurations across multiple model backends under shared task environments, budgets, and evaluation protocols, while preserving each harness's native execution behavior. The benchmark contains 106 sandboxed offline tasks constructed from practical agent-use patterns and manually reviewed for realism, solvability, oracle-checkability, and integrity. Each run records final artifacts, execution traces, usage statistics, and validator outputs, enabling analysis beyond final completion. Across 5,194 execution trajectories, we observe substantial variation in completion, process quality, efficiency, and failure behavior across model-harness pairings. These results suggest that agent capability should be reported at the model-harness configuration level rather than attributed to the base model alone. Our analysis further identifies recurring execution-alignment failures, where plausible reasoning becomes decoupled from tool feedback, workspace state, evidence, or verifiable output contracts. Harness-Bench provides a reproducible foundation for diagnosing and improving reliable, efficient, and auditable agent execution stacks.

AI.tldr: Harness-Bench是一个诊断性基准，用于评估LLM代理工作流中配置层面的"系统层（harness）"影响。通过106个沙盒离线任务和5,194条执行轨迹的分析，发现代理能力应基于模型-harness配置组合来报告，而非仅归因于基础模型。
AI.motivation: 现有基准通常忽略执行层变化、比较完整代理系统或固定harness，使得执行层变化难以研究。实际中代理性能不仅取决于基础模型，还取决于管理上下文、工具、状态、约束、权限、追踪和恢复的系统层（harness）。
AI.method: 构建包含106个沙盒离线任务的Harness-Bench基准，任务来自实际代理使用模式。在共享任务环境、预算和评估协议下，评估多种模型后端上的代表性harness配置，同时保留各harness的原生执行行为。记录最终工件、执行轨迹、使用统计和验证器输出。
AI.result: 在5,194条执行轨迹中，观察到不同模型-harness配对在完成度、过程质量、效率和失败行为上存在显著差异。发现重复出现的"执行-对齐失败"（execution-alignment failures），即合理的推理与工具反馈、工作空间状态、证据或可验证输出契约脱钩。
AI.conclusion: 代理能力应基于模型-harness配置级别报告，而非单独归因于基础模型。Harness-Bench为诊断和改进可靠、高效、可审计的代理执行栈提供了可复现的基础。
idea_en: A diagnostic benchmarking framework (Harness-Bench) specifically designed to isolate and evaluate configuration-level harness effects in LLM agent workflows, enabling systematic comparison of system layer configurations independent of base model capabilities.

A method for detecting execution-alignment failures in LLM agents, where the system identifies decoupling between agent reasoning and tool feedback, workspace state, evidence, or verifiable output contracts during execution.

A sandboxed offline task evaluation protocol that preserves native harness execution behavior while maintaining shared task environments, budgets, and evaluation protocols across different model-harness pairings.

A multi-dimensional agent evaluation system that records final artifacts, execution traces, usage statistics, and validator outputs simultaneously, enabling analysis beyond binary task completion metrics.
idea_ch: 一种专门用于隔离和评估LLM代理工作流中配置层面harness影响的诊断性基准框架（Harness-Bench），能够在独立于基础模型能力的情况下系统比较系统层配置。
一种检测LLM代理执行-对齐失败的方法，通过识别代理推理与工具反馈、工作空间状态、证据或可验证输出契约之间的脱钩现象。
一种沙盒离线任务评估协议，在不同模型-harness配对之间保留原生harness执行行为的同时，维持共享的任务环境、预算和评估标准。
一种多维代理评估系统，同时记录最终工件、执行轨迹、使用统计和验证器输出，支持超越二元任务完成度的深入分析。

title: DiagramRAG: A Lightweight Framework to Retrieve Scientific Diagram for Figure Generation
summary: Scientific diagrams are essential for communicating complex methodologies in academic papers. A natural way for researchers to specify such diagrams is through rough sketches, where text labels, connectors, and spatial arrangements express early semantic and topological intentions. However, sketches are usually incomplete, making them insufficient for directly producing publication-quality diagrams. Existing sketch-based generation methods mainly reconstruct the sketch itself, while recent text-driven diagram generation frameworks rely on textual semantics and do not fully exploit the topological structure contained in sketches. In this paper, we introduce DiagramRAG, a lightweight retrieval-augmented framework for sketch-based scientific diagram completion. Given a user sketch, DiagramRAG retrieves reference diagrams that are both semantically relevant to the sketch content and topologically compatible with its structure, and uses them to guide downstream diagram generation. To enable efficient structure-aware retrieval, we represent diagrams as knowledge graphs, synthesize sketch variants at different simplification levels, and train an embedding model to align sketches with compatible diagrams in a shared space. The retrieved references further provide content, topology, and visual priors for completing and rendering the final diagram. Experiments show that DiagramRAG achieves F1-scores of 0.848 and 0.802 on DiagramBank and FigureBench, respectively, and improves generation quality with the best VLM-as-a-Judge score of 7.170, while reducing inference latency to 35.48 seconds per sample. Our code and data are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/DiagramRAG-A262 and https://huggingface.co/datasets/anonymous-review-a262/DiagramSketch.

AI.tldr: DiagramRAG是一个轻量级检索增强框架，通过将科学草图表示为知识图谱并检索语义和拓扑兼容的参考图，实现草图到出版级科学示意图的自动补全与生成。
AI.motivation: 现有方法中，基于草图的生成主要重建草图本身，而基于文本的图表生成框架未能充分利用草图中蕴含的拓扑结构信息。草图通常不完整，难以直接生成出版级图表，需要一种既能理解草图语义又能利用其空间拓扑结构的方法。
AI.method: 1) 将科学图表示例化为知识图谱，捕捉实体关系和拓扑结构；2) 合成不同简化级别的草图变体；3) 训练嵌入模型在共享空间中对齐草图与兼容图表；4) 检索语义相关且拓扑兼容的参考图；5) 利用检索结果提供内容、拓扑和视觉先验，引导最终图表的补全与渲染。
AI.result: 在DiagramBank和FigureBench上分别取得0.848和0.802的F1分数，最佳VLM-as-a-Judge评分7.170，推理延迟降至每样本35.48秒。
AI.conclusion: DiagramRAG通过检索增强实现了从草图到高质量科学示意图的有效补全，在准确率和效率上均优于现有方法，代码和数据已开源。
idea_en: A retrieval-augmented framework for sketch-based scientific diagram completion that retrieves reference diagrams based on both semantic relevance and topological compatibility with the input sketch.
A method of representing scientific diagrams as knowledge graphs to enable structure-aware retrieval, capturing entity relationships and topological structure.

A technique for synthesizing sketch variants at different simplification levels from complete diagrams to train an embedding model that aligns sketches with compatible diagrams in a shared embedding space.

A diagram generation pipeline that leverages retrieved references to provide content priors, topology priors, and visual priors for completing and rendering a publication-quality diagram from an incomplete sketch.
idea_ch: 一种基于检索增强的草图科学示意图补全框架，根据草图语义相关性和拓扑兼容性检索参考图来引导图表生成。
一种将科学图表示例化为知识图谱的方法，实现结构感知的检索，捕捉实体间关系和拓扑结构。
一种从完整图表合成不同简化级别草图变体的技术，用于训练嵌入模型在共享空间中对齐草图与兼容图表。
一种利用检索结果提供内容先验、拓扑先验和视觉先验的图表生成流水线，从不完整草图补全并渲染出出版级质量的示意图。

title: Do Agents Think Deeper? A Mechanistic Investigation of Layer-Wise Dynamics in Sequential Planning
summary: Recent mechanistic studies suggest that large language models (LLMs) may utilize their depth inefficiently in standard single-turn tasks. Whether this still holds in autonomous agent settings, where models must perform multi-turn planning, tool use, and iterative state updates, remains unclear. We study this question through a systematic layer-wise analysis of complete user-agent trajectories spanning three domains: Deep Research, Code Generation, and Tabular Processing. Using residual stream probes, causal layer-skipping interventions, and effective-depth measurements, we show that agentic reasoning exhibits a distinct depth profile from static tasks. As trajectories unfold, models progressively recruit more and deeper layers, with stronger long-range inter-layer dependencies emerging in later turns. At the same time, residual updates become increasingly correction-dominant, indicating a shift from stable feature accumulation toward repeated recalibration. Effective-depth analysis further reveals a substantial construction-refinement gap: semantic direction often forms relatively early, while deep layers remain necessary for stabilizing final outputs. Across model families, this gap is pronounced in Qwen and Minimax, whereas GLM shows a more domain-dependent depth allocation pattern. These results provide mechanistic evidence that autonomous LLM agents allocate depth adaptively as reasoning complexity grows.

AI.tldr: 本文通过层分析发现，LLM在自主Agent场景中会随着推理复杂度增加而动态调整网络深度的使用，表现出与静态任务不同的深度分配模式。
AI.motivation: 已有研究显示LLM在单轮任务中深度利用效率不高，但在需要多轮规划、工具使用和状态更新的自主Agent场景中是否仍然如此尚不清楚，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 采用残差流探针、因果层跳过干预和有效深度测量三种方法，对Deep Research、Code Generation、Tabular Processing三个领域的完整用户-Agent轨迹进行系统性的逐层分析。
AI.result: (1) Agent推理随轨迹展开逐步招募更多更深层，后期存在更强的长程跨层依赖；(2) 残差更新趋向纠错主导，从稳定特征积累转向反复校准；(3) 存在显著的构建-精炼差距：语义方向较早形成，但深层仍对输出稳定化必要；(4) Qwen和Minimax差距明显，GLM呈现领域依赖的深度分配模式。
AI.conclusion: LLM在自主Agent场景中会自适应地分配深度以应对推理复杂度的增长，不同模型家族展现出不同的深度分配策略。
idea_en: A method for adaptive depth allocation in large language models for autonomous agent tasks, where the model dynamically engages more and deeper layers as multi-turn trajectories unfold, based on real-time complexity assessment.
A residual stream probing technique for layer-wise analysis of agent trajectories, enabling detection of long-range inter-layer dependencies that emerge during multi-turn reasoning tasks.
A causal layer-skipping intervention mechanism that selectively bypasses layers during agent inference to optimize computational efficiency while maintaining output stability.

An effective-depth measurement framework that quantifies the construction-refinement gap in LLM reasoning, identifying the point where semantic direction is formed versus where deep layers are needed for output stabilization.

A domain-adaptive depth allocation system for language models that adjusts network depth usage based on the specific requirements of different agent task domains (research, code generation, tabular processing).
idea_ch: 一种面向自主Agent任务的LLM自适应深度分配方法，根据多轮轨迹展开过程中实时复杂度评估，动态激活更多和更深的网络层。
一种用于Agent轨迹逐层分析的残差流探针技术，能够检测多轮推理任务中涌现的长程跨层依赖关系。
一种因果层跳过干预机制，在Agent推理过程中选择性跳过特定层，在保持输出稳定性的同时优化计算效率。
一种量化LLM推理中构建-精炼差距的有效深度测量框架，识别语义方向形成点与深层输出稳定化必要点之间的差异。
一种领域自适应的语言模型深度分配系统，根据不同Agent任务领域（研究、代码生成、表格处理）的具体需求调整网络深度使用模式。

title: From Talking to Singing: A New Challenge for Audio-Visual Deepfake Detection
summary: With rapid advances in audio-visual generative models, reliable forgery detection becomes increasingly critical. Existing methods for audio-visual deepfake detection typically rely on cross-modal inconsistencies. In singing, rhythmic vocalization weakens this coupling and introduces a nontrivial domain shift, substantially degrading detection performance. We construct the Singing Head DeepFake (SHDF) dataset using rhythm-aware generative models to fill the gap in singing benchmarks. To cope with cross-scenario domain shifts, we propose a Text-guided Audio-Visual Forgery Detection (T-AVFD) framework that generalizes across both talking and singing scenarios. T-AVFD comprises a facial authenticity pattern learner and a multi-modal differential weight learning module. The pattern learner aligns facial features with multi-granularity textual descriptions to learn generalizable authenticity patterns. The weight learning module preserves intrinsic audio-visual consistency and adaptively integrates it with authenticity patterns via differential weighting. Extensive experiments on multiple talking head deepfake datasets and SHDF show consistent improvements over existing baselines and strong robustness under diverse perturbations.

AI.tldr: 针对歌唱场景中视听深度伪造检测性能下降的问题，本文构建了歌唱头部深度伪造(SHDF)数据集，并提出文本引导的视听伪造检测(T-AVFD)框架，通过面部真实性模式学习器与多模态差分权重学习模块，在说话和歌唱场景中均取得优于现有方法的检测效果。
