title: Defending LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems Against Cooperative Attacks with Sentence-Level Rectification
summary: Recent years have witnessed the rapid development of Large Language Model-based Multi-Agent Systems (MAS), which excel at collaborative decision-making and complex problem-solving. However, malicious agents in MAS may inject misinformation to mislead other agents and disrupt system performance, giving rise to a new research direction that focuses on attack mechanisms and defense strategies in MAS. Prior studies largely assume malicious agents act independently and investigate the corresponding defense strategies. However, we argue that malicious agents may exhibit collaborative behaviors, enabling more effective attacks through internal information exchange. In this paper, we propose an adaptive cooperative attack framework, where malicious agents autonomously coordinate and dynamically adjust their attack strategies through multi-round interactions. Furthermore, we introduce Sentence-Level Trustworthiness Analysis and Rectification (STAR), a defense framework that identifies and rectifies misleading information at the sentence level within agent communications. Our experiments show that cooperative attacks lead to a significantly larger degradation in task success rate than independent attacks, resulting in a relative drop of 5.34\%. Meanwhile, STAR effectively mitigates both cooperative and independent threats and improves task success rate by an average of 36.76\%. The code is available at https://github.com/smoooom/STAR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种多智能体系统中的自适应协同攻击框架，以及一种句子级可信度分析与纠正（STAR）防御框架。实验表明协同攻击比独立攻击更具破坏性（任务成功率相对下降5.34%），而STAR防御能有效提升任务成功率36.76%。
AI.motivation: 现有研究大多假设恶意智能体独立行动并研究相应防御策略，但忽视了恶意智能体可能通过内部信息交换进行协同攻击，从而造成更严重的破坏。
AI.method: 提出自适应协同攻击框架：恶意智能体通过多轮交互自主协调并动态调整攻击策略。提出STAR防御框架：在智能体通信的句子级别识别和纠正误导性信息。
AI.result: 协同攻击导致任务成功率相对下降5.34%，比独立攻击更严重。STAR防御可平均提升任务成功率36.76%，有效缓解协同和独立威胁。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体系统中的协同攻击威胁不容忽视，而句子级可信度分析与纠正是有效的防御手段。代码已开源。
idea_en: Adaptive cooperative attack framework for multi-agent systems: malicious agents autonomously coordinate and dynamically adjust attack strategies through multi-round interactions to inject misinformation.
Sentence-Level Trustworthiness Analysis and Rectification (STAR): a defense framework that identifies and rectifies misleading information at the sentence level within agent communications.
Cooperative attack mechanism where malicious agents share internal information to enable more effective attacks than independent malicious agents.
idea_ch: 自适应协同攻击框架：恶意智能体通过多轮交互自主协调并动态调整攻击策略，实现更高效的信息注入攻击。
句子级可信度分析与纠正（STAR）防御框架：在智能体通信的句子粒度层面识别并纠正误导性信息，而非传统的信息整体过滤。
多智能体系统中恶意智能体的协同信息共享机制：通过内部信息交换使协同攻击效果显著优于独立攻击。

title: Human-like in-group bias in instruction-tuned language model agents
summary: As autonomous AI agents are deployed in persistent, interacting networks -- coordinating tasks, routing resources, and accumulating reputational histories -- the social dynamics that emerge will determine who receives opportunity and who does not, at scales no human institution can supervise. We ran a controlled multi-agent simulation in which instruction-tuned language model agents interacted across 500 turns under three conditions manipulating group label salience and resource scarcity, across six model families with 20 seeds each. When group labels were visible, we observed in-group trust bias, action homophily, and network assortativity -- all absent when labels were hidden -- a pattern structurally consistent with salience-dependence in human social psychology. This discrimination was invisible to standard action-log audits: bias operated entirely through who received each action, not what actions were chosen, with action-type distributions showing no increase in negative actions across conditions. Per-turn in-group versus out-group differentials of 5 to 16 percentage points were statistically significant for all six models (Wilcoxon signed-rank, all Benjamini-Hochberg-corrected p < 0.001), establishing group-contingent targeting as a robust property of instruction-tuned language models across architectures and training regimes. Compounded through 500 turns of reciprocation, these differentials accumulated into in-group trust biases of +0.014 to +0.100 (d = 0.84-4.52) -- illustrating how modest per-interaction targeting propagates into structural inequality in persistent networks.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过多智能体模拟实验发现，指令调优的语言模型在群体标签可见时会产生内群体信任偏见、行动同质性和网络分类性，这些微观偏差在500轮交互中累积为结构性不平等，且传统审计无法检测到这种歧视。
AI.motivation: 探索自主AI代理在持久交互网络中是否会表现出类似人类的社会偏见（如内群体偏好），以及这种偏见如何在网络层面累积为结构性不平等，而传统审计方法可能无法察觉。
AI.method: 进行受控多智能体模拟实验，指令调优语言模型代理在三种条件下（群体标签显著性、资源稀缺性）交互500轮，跨越6个模型家族、每家族20个种子，分析行动模式、信任偏差和网络结构。
AI.result: 群体标签可见时出现内群体信任偏见（+0.014至+0.100）、行动同质性和网络分类性；偏见通过行动接收对象而非行动类型体现，传统行动日志审计无法检测；每轮内群体与外群体差异为5-16个百分点，统计显著。
AI.conclusion: 指令调优语言模型表现出群体条件性目标选择行为，微观交互差异在持久网络中累积为结构性不平等，凸显了现有AI安全审计方法的局限性。
idea_en: A multi-agent simulation system for detecting invisible social bias in AI agents, where bias is identified through network-level analysis of action recipients rather than action types, enabling detection of discrimination invisible to standard action-log audits.
A method for measuring in-group trust bias accumulation in persistent AI agent networks using per-turn differential tracking and compounding analysis across hundreds of interaction rounds.
A salience-dependent group label manipulation technique for controlled testing of AI agent social bias, comparing visible vs. hidden group labels across multiple model architectures.
A network assortativity and action homophily detection system specifically designed for auditing autonomous AI agents in persistent interaction networks.
A Wilcoxon signed-rank statistical testing framework with Benjamini-Hochberg correction for detecting group-contingent targeting biases in multi-agent AI systems.
idea_ch: 一种基于网络层面分析的多智能体AI社会偏见检测系统，通过分析行动接收对象而非行动类型来识别传统日志审计无法察觉的隐性歧视
一种持久性AI代理网络中内群体信任偏差累积的测量方法，通过每轮差异追踪和数百轮交互的复合分析来量化结构性不平等
一种基于显著性依赖的群体标签操控技术，用于对AI代理进行受控社会偏见测试，跨多种模型架构比较可见与隐藏标签下的行为差异
一种专为审计持久交互网络中自主AI代理设计的网络分类性和行动同质性检测系统
一种结合Benjamini-Hochberg校正的Wilcoxon符号秩统计检验框架，用于检测多智能体AI系统中群体条件性目标选择偏差

title: CIVIC: End-to-End Sequence Compactness for Efficient Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) face severe memory and latency bottlenecks due to high-resolution visual tokens. While current token reduction methods theoretically save FLOPs, post-hoc pruning introduces structural overhead, failing to yield proportional wall-clock acceleration. However, enforcing a contiguous compact pathway risks geometric disorientation and loss of fine-grained localization. To overcome these barriers, this paper introduces CIVIC, a path-consistent compact visual inference framework. By maintaining compact sequence representations seamlessly across the vision encoder, projection layer, LLM prefill, and KV-cache, CIVIC avoids non-contiguous memory access and localized unmerging overheads. Evaluated on the Qwen3-VL architecture, CIVIC successfully translates sequence reductions into genuine physical hardware efficiency, shrinking KV-cache memory to approximately one-third of the baseline and reducing end-to-end inference latency. Enabled by text-aligned KL distillation and an adaptive spatial retention floor, CIVIC achieves these efficiency milestones without degrading accuracy across rigorous multimodal reasoning and visual grounding benchmarks.

AI.tldr: CIVIC提出了一种路径一致的紧凑视觉推理框架，通过在整个视觉编码器、投影层、LLM预填充和KV缓存中保持紧凑序列表示，避免了非连续内存访问和局部取消合并开销，在Qwen3-VL架构上将KV缓存内存缩减至约三分之一，并降低了端到端推理延迟，同时通过文本对齐的KL散度蒸馏和自适应空间保留阈值保持精度。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM因高分辨率视觉token面临严重的内存和延迟瓶颈，当前token缩减方法虽理论上节省FLOPs，但事后剪枝引入结构开销，无法实现成比例的墙钟加速；而强制连续紧凑路径则面临几何方向迷失和细粒度定位损失。
AI.method: 提出CIVIC框架，核心包括：(1) 在视觉编码器、投影层、LLM预填充和KV缓存中全程保持紧凑序列表示，避免非连续内存访问；(2) 文本对齐的KL散度蒸馏；(3) 自适应空间保留阈值，在压缩与精度之间取得平衡。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-VL架构上，KV缓存内存缩减至约三分之一，端到端推理延迟显著降低，且在多项多模态推理和视觉定位基准测试中精度未下降。
AI.conclusion: CIVIC成功将序列缩减转化为真实的物理硬件效率提升，证明视觉token压缩可以在不牺牲精度的情况下实现实际加速。
idea_en: A path-consistent compact visual inference framework (CIVIC) that maintains compact sequence representations seamlessly across vision encoder, projection layer, LLM prefill, and KV-cache to avoid non-contiguous memory access and localized unmerging overhead.
An adaptive spatial retention floor mechanism that dynamically adjusts token compression thresholds to balance efficiency and fine-grained localization accuracy.
Text-aligned KL distillation method for training compact visual sequences that preserves multimodal reasoning capability while reducing token count.
End-to-end compact visual pathway architecture that translates FLOPs savings into genuine wall-clock latency reduction by eliminating structural overhead from post-hoc pruning.
idea_ch: 一种路径一致的紧凑视觉推理框架（CIVIC），在视觉编码器、投影层、LLM预填充和KV缓存中全程保持紧凑序列表示，避免非连续内存访问和局部取消合并开销。
一种自适应空间保留阈值机制，动态调整token压缩阈值以平衡效率和细粒度定位精度。
文本对齐的KL散度蒸馏方法，用于训练紧凑视觉序列，在减少token数量的同时保持多模态推理能力。
端到端紧凑视觉通路架构，通过消除事后剪枝的结构开销，将FLOPs节省转化为真实的墙钟延迟降低。

title: Gradient Step Plug-and-Play Model for Dental Cone-Beam CT Reconstruction
comment: CT Meeting 2026 - 9th International Conference on Image Formation in X-Ray Computed Tomography, Jun 2026, Salt lake City, United States
summary: The goal of this work is to reduce the effect of photon noise in dental cone-beam CT reconstruction. We consider an inverse problem formulation and develop a databased prior. To this end, we simulate fan-beam acquisitions and add photon noise to the projection data. The prior is obtained by training a gradient-step denoiser using reconstructed simulated acquisitions. The trained model is integrated into a plug-and-play gradient-step algorithm to reconstruct images from simulated projections. Experiments on synthetic data demonstrate the denoising capabilities of the trained model, while qualitative evaluations on real images showcase the algorithm's performance and generalization ability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于数据先验的即插即用梯度步进算法，用于减少牙科锥形束CT重建中的光子噪声，通过模拟扇形束采集并训练梯度步去噪器实现有效去噪。
AI.motivation: 减少牙科锥形束CT重建中光子噪声的影响，提高图像质量。
AI.method: 采用逆问题框架，开发基于数据的先验模型。通过模拟扇形束采集并向投影数据添加光子噪声，训练梯度步进去噪器（gradient-step denoiser），并将训练好的模型集成到即插即用梯度步进算法（plug-and-play gradient-step algorithm）中，从模拟投影重建图像。
AI.result: 在合成数据上证明了训练模型的去噪能力，在真实图像上的定性评估展示了算法的性能和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的基于数据先验的即插即用梯度步进算法能有效减少牙科CBCT中的光子噪声，且具有良好的泛化能力。
idea_en: A plug-and-play gradient-step algorithm incorporating a data-based prior for photon noise reduction in dental cone-beam CT reconstruction.
A gradient-step denoiser trained on simulated fan-beam acquisitions with photon noise for CT image denoising.
Integration of a trained gradient-step denoiser into an inverse problem framework for dental CBCT reconstruction.
idea_ch: 一种将基于数据的先验模型集成到即插即用梯度步进算法中的方法，用于牙科锥形束CT重建中的光子噪声抑制。
一种基于模拟扇形束采集和光子噪声添加的梯度步进去噪器训练方法，专用于CT图像去噪。
将训练好的梯度步去噪器作为先验信息，融合到逆问题求解框架中，实现牙科CBCT高质量图像重建的专利技术。

title: Do Clinical Models Change Treatment Decisions?
summary: Clinical foundation models are evaluated with factual or exam-style medical QA, but treatment decisions must change when patient context changes. We introduce ClinPivot, an auditable treatment-decision benchmark built from biomedical relations and pivoted patient contexts. ClinPivot asks whether models change treatment choices when new clinical constraints shift the action space. We find that strong medical QA performance does not reliably predict decision-making performance: frontier models and task-adapted Qwen variants often fail to change decisions correctly, and model rankings shift across evaluation regimes. Decision-structured supervision improves pivot-sensitive decision-making and medical QA under matched knowledge budgets, while lightweight replay reduces losses in general assistant ability.

AI.tldr: ClinPivot是一个基于生物医学关系和上下文切换构建的可审计治疗决策基准，用于评估临床基础模型在患者情境变化时能否正确调整治疗选择。研究发现，强大的医学问答能力并不能可靠预测决策表现，前沿模型常无法正确调整决策，而决策结构化的监督训练能提升模型在匹配知识预算下的决策质量和医学QA表现。
AI.motivation: 现有临床基础模型评估主要基于事实性或考试式医学问答，但实际治疗决策需要根据患者上下文变化而动态调整，现有评估方式无法反映这一关键能力。
AI.method: 构建ClinPivot基准，从生物医学关系中提取治疗决策场景，通过"枢转"（pivot）患者上下文（引入新的临床约束）来改变行动空间，评估模型是否能够相应调整治疗选择。采用决策结构化的监督训练和轻量级回放策略来提升模型性能。
AI.result: 强大的医学QA性能不能可靠预测临床决策表现；前沿模型和任务适配的Qwen变体常无法正确改变决策；模型排名在不同评估制度下会发生变化；决策结构化监督在匹配知识预算下提升了枢转敏感决策和医学QA；轻量级回放减少了通用助手能力的损失。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一个更贴近实际临床场景的评估基准，揭示了当前模型在动态治疗决策中的不足，并为提升模型在上下文变化下的决策能力提供了有效的训练策略。
idea_en: ClinPivot benchmark: A method for evaluating clinical foundation models' ability to change treatment decisions when patient contexts shift, built from biomedical relations and pivoted clinical constraints.
Pivot-sensitive supervision training: Decision-structured supervision approach that improves model performance on both treatment decision-making and medical QA under matched knowledge budgets.
Lightweight replay mechanism: A technique that reduces loss of general assistant abilities when fine-tuning models for clinical decision-making tasks.
Auditable treatment-decision evaluation framework: A systematic method to audit whether AI models adjust treatment choices when new clinical constraints alter the action space.
idea_ch: ClinPivot基准：一种基于生物医学关系和枢转临床约束构建的评估方法，用于测试临床基础模型在患者情境变化时能否正确调整治疗决策。
枢转敏感监督训练：在匹配知识预算下，通过决策结构化的监督训练方法同时提升模型在治疗决策和医学问答任务上的表现。
轻量级回放机制：在微调模型用于临床决策任务时，减少通用助手能力损失的技术方案。
可审计治疗决策评估框架：一种系统性审计方法，用于检测AI模型在临床约束改变行动空间时能否正确调整治疗选择。

title: Data-Efficient On-Policy Distillation for Automatic Speech Recognition
summary: Building competitive automatic speech recognition (ASR) models usually requires large-scale au- dio supervision, which makes reproduction and specialization expensive. We study Ark-ASR, a 0.6B- parameter audio-conditioned language model trained with 100k hours of speech, and examine whether a strong Qwen-ASR teacher can transfer additional recognition capability through on-policy distillation. Across Mandarin and English ASR benchmarks, the proposed training recipe consistently improves over supervised fine-tuning alone and outperforms the same-scale Qwen3-ASR-0.6B baseline on four of five evaluation sets. This is achieved with only 100k hours of speech, compared with the 20M hours of super- vised audio reported for the Qwen3-Omni AuT encoder. The larger Qwen3-ASR-1.7B remains stronger, but the results show that teacher-guided on-policy training can substantially close the gap for compact ASR models under a much smaller audio budget. A support-overlap diagnostic further suggests that the teacher-data stage improves local student-teacher compatibility, matching recent analyses of when on-policy distillation is effective.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Ark-ASR，一个0.6B参数的音频条件语言模型，通过on-policy蒸馏从强Qwen-ASR教师模型迁移识别能力。仅用10万小时语音数据，在多个中英文ASR基准上超越同等规模基线，显著缩小了与使用2000万小时数据训练的大模型的差距。
AI.motivation: 构建高性能ASR模型通常需要大规模音频监督数据，导致复现和专业化成本高昂。本文目标是探索能否通过on-policy蒸馏，让小模型在有限音频预算下从强教师模型中获取额外的识别能力。
AI.method: 提出Ark-ASR（0.6B参数）音频条件语言模型，采用on-policy蒸馏训练方案：使用强Qwen-ASR教师模型生成的伪标签进行蒸馏训练，监督微调作为基线对比。仅使用10万小时语音数据训练。
AI.result: 在五个中英文ASR基准测试中的四个上，所提训练方法一致优于监督微调，并超越同规模的Qwen3-ASR-0.6B基线。与使用2000万小时监督音频训练的Qwen3-Omni AuT编码器相比，仅用了其0.5%的数据量。Qwen3-ASR-1.7B仍然更强，但蒸馏方法显著缩小了差距。
AI.conclusion: 教师指导的on-policy训练能够在更小的音频预算下显著缩小紧凑ASR模型与大规模模型的性能差距。支持重叠诊断进一步表明，教师-数据阶段改善了局部学生-教师兼容性，验证了on-policy蒸馏的有效性。
idea_en: A method for training compact ASR models using on-policy distillation from a larger teacher model, where the teacher-generated pseudo-labels are used to train a student model with significantly less audio data (100k hours vs 20M hours).
An audio-conditioned language model architecture (Ark-ASR) with 0.6B parameters that achieves competitive ASR performance through teacher-guided on-policy training with limited audio supervision.
A support-overlap diagnostic technique to evaluate local student-teacher compatibility during on-policy distillation, providing a tool to assess when distillation is most effective.
A training recipe that combines supervised fine-tuning with on-policy distillation to improve ASR model performance across multiple languages (Mandarin and English) under constrained audio budgets.
idea_ch: 一种利用on-policy蒸馏训练紧凑ASR模型的方法：使用大型教师模型生成的伪标签训练学生模型，仅需10万小时音频数据即可达到接近使用2000万小时数据训练的模型的效果。
一种音频条件语言模型架构（Ark-ASR），参数量0.6B，通过教师指导的on-policy训练在有限音频监督下实现竞争性ASR性能。
一种支持重叠诊断技术，用于评估on-policy蒸馏过程中局部学生-教师兼容性，为判断蒸馏有效性提供量化工具。
一种结合监督微调与on-policy蒸馏的训练方案，在受限音频预算下跨多语言（中文和英文）提升ASR模型性能。

title: Deconstructing Spatial Complexity: Hierarchical Decomposition for LLM Spatial Reasoning
summary: LLMs have shown remarkable proficiency in general language understanding and reasoning. However, they consistently underperform in spatial reasoning that severely limits their application, particularly in embodied intelligence. Inspired by the success of hierarchical reinforcement learning, this paper introduces a novel method for hierarchical task decomposition in LLM spatial reasoning. Our approach guides LLMs to decompose complex tasks into manageable sub-tasks by identifying key intermediate states and generating simplified sub-environments. However, we identify that LLMs often fail to derive optimal intermediate states due to their insufficient spatial prior, leading to sub-optimal task decomposition. To address this limitation and enhance its planning capability, we propose the MCTS-Guided Group Relative Policy Optimization (M-GRPO), where we reformulate the UCT formula by incorporating the LLM's prior predictive probabilities alongside its epistemic uncertainty. Furthermore, we implement a more fine-grained advantage function, enabling the model to learn optimal path planning. Experimental results demonstrate that our method substantially improves LLM performance on spatial tasks, including navigation, planning, and strategic games, achieving state-of-the-art results. This work paves the way for LLMs in real-world applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种层次化任务分解方法提升LLM空间推理能力，并引入M-GRPO优化策略，在导航、规划、策略游戏等空间任务上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: LLM在空间推理任务上表现不佳，限制了其在具身智能等现实应用中的部署。现有方法缺乏有效的层次化分解机制和空间先验知识。
AI.method: 1) 层次化任务分解：引导LLM将复杂空间任务分解为子任务，识别关键中间状态并生成简化子环境；2) M-GRPO：重新设计UCT公式，融合LLM先验预测概率和认知不确定性，实现更细粒度的优势函数用于路径规划学习。
AI.result: 在导航、规划、策略游戏等空间推理任务上取得SOTA结果，显著提升LLM的空间推理性能。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法有效弥补了LLM在空间推理上的不足，为LLM在具身智能等现实场景的应用奠定了基础。
idea_en: A hierarchical task decomposition method for LLMs that decomposes complex spatial tasks into sub-tasks by identifying key intermediate states and generating simplified sub-environments.
MCTS-Guided Group Relative Policy Optimization (M-GRPO) with a reformulated UCT formula that incorporates LLM prior predictive probabilities and epistemic uncertainty.
A fine-grained advantage function for path planning optimization in LLM spatial reasoning.
Integration of hierarchical reinforcement learning principles into LLM prompting for spatial task solving.
idea_ch: 一种用于LLM的层次化任务分解方法，通过识别关键中间状态并生成简化子环境，将复杂空间任务分解为可管理的子任务
MCTS引导的组相对策略优化(M-GRPO)，重新设计UCT公式，融合LLM先验预测概率和认知不确定性
一种用于LLM空间推理路径规划优化的细粒度优势函数
将层次化强化学习原理集成到LLM提示中用于空间任务求解的方法

title: Adaptive Reservoir Computing for Multi-Scenario Chaotic System Forecasting
summary: We present an adaptive reservoir computing framework for the CTF-4-Science Lorenz benchmark, which evaluates machine learning models across twelve distinct tasks spanning five qualitatively different scenarios: baseline forecasting, noisy signal reconstruction, forecasting under noise, few-shot learning, and parametric generalization. Rather than applying a uniform inference strategy, we tailor the training and prediction procedure of Echo State Networks (ESNs) to the specific demands of each evaluation scenario. Our key contributions are fourfold: (1) exact reservoir state synchronization that eliminates warmup approximation error in short-time prediction; (2) histogram-guided candidate selection that directly optimizes the long-time ergodic evaluation metric; (3) multi-seed reservoir search for few-shot regimes with severely limited training data; and (4) sequential multi-sequence training that resolves state-distribution mismatch in parametric generalization tasks. The proposed framework achieves a score of 74.91 on the public benchmark leaderboard, demonstrating that carefully adapted reservoir computing constitutes a competitive and computationally efficient approach for diverse chaotic system modeling challenges.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种自适应储备池计算框架，针对CTF-4-Science Lorenz基准测试中的12个不同任务，通过四种关键技术（精确状态同步、直方图引导候选选择、多种子搜索、序列多序列训练）优化回声状态网络，在公共排行榜上取得74.91分。
AI.motivation: 传统储备池计算对不同的混沌系统建模场景采用统一推理策略，缺乏针对性优化，难以在多样化任务中达到最优性能。
AI.method: (1) 精确储备池状态同步消除暖机近似误差；(2) 直方图引导的候选选择优化长期遍历评估指标；(3) 多种子储备池搜索应对少样本学习；(4) 序列多序列训练解决参数泛化中的状态分布不匹配问题。
AI.result: 在CTF-4-Science Lorenz基准公共排行榜上获得74.91分，证明了自适应储备池计算在多种混沌系统建模挑战中的竞争力和计算效率。
AI.conclusion: 精心适配的储备池计算是应对多样化混沌系统建模挑战的一种高效且有竞争力的方法。
idea_en: Exact reservoir state synchronization method eliminating warmup approximation error for short-time chaotic prediction
Histogram-guided candidate selection technique for directly optimizing long-time ergodic evaluation metrics in reservoir computing
Multi-seed reservoir search strategy for few-shot learning regimes with severely limited training data in chaotic systems
Sequential multi-sequence training method resolving state-distribution mismatch in parametric generalization tasks for ESNs
Adaptive reservoir computing framework that tailors training and prediction procedures per specific evaluation scenario in chaotic system modeling
idea_ch: 一种精确储备池状态同步方法，消除短时混沌预测中的暖机近似误差
直方图引导的候选选择技术，直接优化储备池计算中长期遍历评估指标
多种子储备池搜索策略，用于训练数据极度有限的少样本混沌系统学习场景
序列多序列训练方法，解决回声状态网络在参数泛化任务中的状态分布不匹配问题
自适应储备池计算框架，针对混沌系统建模中每个评估场景定制训练和预测流程

title: OR-Space: A Full-Lifecycle Workspace Benchmark for Industrial Optimization Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly used to assist with operations research (OR) modeling, yet existing OR-oriented benchmarks often reduce evaluation to one-shot translation from a self-contained problem statement into a mathematical formulation or solver program. Such settings abstract away two characteristics of real industrial OR workflows: persistent multi-artifact workspaces and multi-stage task lifecycles. We introduce OR-Space, a full-lifecycle workspace benchmark for evaluating industrial optimization agents across model construction, model revision, and grounded explanation. Each instance is an executable workspace containing business documents, structured data, optional code artifacts, solver outputs, and task-specific evaluators distributed across interdependent files. OR-Space defines three task modes: Build, where agents construct solver-ready optimization models from heterogeneous artifacts; Revise, where agents modify existing models under changing requirements or solver feedback while preserving valid prior logic; and Explain, where agents answer grounded questions about solutions, constraints, and business implications using evidence spread across workspace artifacts. By combining persistent workspaces with lifecycle-oriented tasks, OR-Space evaluates whether agents can perform reliable optimization work beyond end-to-end text generation. We describe the benchmark design, evaluation protocol, and quality-control pipeline, and position OR-Space as a benchmark for studying the reliability, failure modes, and practical readiness of LLM agents in industrial OR workflows.

AI.tldr: OR-Space是一个面向工业运筹优化工作流的全生命周期基准测试，评估LLM代理在持久化多工件工作空间中执行模型构建、修订和解释三类任务的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有OR基准测试将评估简化为从问题陈述到数学公式或求解器程序的一次性翻译，忽略了真实工业OR工作流的两个特征：持久化多工件工作空间和多阶段任务生命周期。
AI.method: 构建包含商业文档、结构化数据、代码工件、求解器输出和任务特定评估器的可执行工作空间，定义Build（构建）、Revise（修订）、Explain（解释）三种任务模式进行全生命周期评估。
AI.result: 提出了OR-Space基准测试，包含基准设计、评估协议和质量控制流程，可用于评估LLM代理在工业OR工作流中的可靠性、失败模式和实际准备度。
AI.conclusion: OR-Space通过持久化工作空间和生命周期导向任务的结合，评估代理是否能够执行超越端到端文本生成的可靠优化工作。
idea_en: A multi-artifact executable workspace benchmark system for evaluating LLM agents in industrial optimization workflows, comprising persistent workspaces with interdependent files including business documents, structured data, code artifacts, solver outputs, and task-specific evaluators.

A three-mode lifecycle evaluation framework for industrial optimization agents: Build mode for constructing solver-ready models from heterogeneous artifacts, Revise mode for modifying models under changing requirements while preserving valid prior logic, and Explain mode for answering grounded questions using cross-artifact evidence.

A quality-control pipeline and evaluation protocol for assessing LLM agent reliability, failure modes, and practical readiness in persistent multi-stage industrial OR workflows beyond end-to-end text generation.
idea_ch: 一种用于评估LLM代理在工业优化工作流中能力的多工件可执行工作空间基准系统，包含包含商业文档、结构化数据、代码工件、求解器输出和任务特定评估器的持久化工作空间，各文件间相互依赖。
一种面向工业优化代理的三模式生命周期评估框架：构建模式（从异构工件构建求解器就绪模型）、修订模式（在变化需求下修改模型同时保留有效先验逻辑）、解释模式（利用跨工件证据回答基于实际场景的问题）。
一种用于评估LLM代理在持久化多阶段工业OR工作流中的可靠性、失败模式和实际准备度的质量控制流程和评估协议，超越端到端文本生成能力。

title: Look on Demand: A Cognitive Scheduling Framework for Visual Evidence Acquisition in Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Existing multimodal reasoning approaches predominantly follow two paradigms: converting visual inputs into text prior to reasoning, or performing end-to-end reasoning within a unified vision-language representation space. Despite their empirical progress, both paradigms suffer from fundamental structural limitations. The former relies on static visual-to-text conversion, which tends to compress and lose fine-grained visual details. The latter is prone to linguistic dominance induced by joint optimization and attention mechanisms, leading to systematically weakened faithfulness to visual evidence during reasoning. In this work, we argue that a central challenge is how and when visual evidence is introduced into the reasoning process. Motivated by this insight, we propose CSMR, a multimodal reasoning framework in which a language model controls the reasoning process by deciding when to invoke an independent visual perception module to acquire task-relevant visual evidence. Experiments across multiple multimodal reasoning benchmarks show that CSMR consistently outperforms representative baseline methods in accuracy under a zero-shot setting. Further experimental analysis confirms that these advantages primarily arise from the proposed cognitive scheduling mechanism.

AI.tldr: CSMR提出一种认知调度机制，让语言模型自主决策何时调用独立的视觉感知模块获取证据，从而解决多模态推理中视觉信息丢失和语言主导问题。
AI.motivation: 现有两种范式（视觉转文本后推理、统一视觉-语言空间端到端推理）都存在结构性缺陷：前者静态转换会导致细粒度视觉细节丢失；后者因联合优化和注意力机制导致语言主导，推理时对视觉证据的忠实度系统性减弱。核心挑战是视觉证据在推理过程中如何以及何时被引入。
AI.method: 提出CSMR框架，由语言模型控制推理过程，自主决策何时调用独立的视觉感知模块来获取任务相关的视觉证据。视觉感知模块与语言模型独立运作，仅在需要时才被激活，避免了持续的语言-视觉联合优化带来的偏差。
AI.result: 在多个多模态推理基准测试中，CSMR在零样本设置下一致优于代表性基线方法。实验分析证实，优势主要来自所提出的认知调度机制。
AI.conclusion: 视觉证据引入推理过程的时机（何时调用）和方式（独立模块按需获取）是多模态推理的关键。认知调度机制有效解决了视觉信息丢失和语言主导问题。
idea_en: A cognitive scheduling mechanism for multimodal reasoning where a language model dynamically decides when to invoke an independent visual perception module to acquire task-relevant visual evidence.

A framework that decouples visual perception from language reasoning, allowing the language model to control the timing of visual evidence acquisition rather than processing all visual information upfront.

A zero-shot multimodal reasoning method that uses on-demand visual evidence invocation to avoid the linguistic dominance problem caused by joint optimization and attention mechanisms in unified vision-language spaces.

An architecture where visual perception modules remain independent and are selectively activated by the reasoning controller, preventing fine-grained visual detail loss from static visual-to-text conversion.
idea_ch: 一种多模态推理的认知调度机制，语言模型动态决策何时调用独立的视觉感知模块来获取任务相关的视觉证据。
将视觉感知与语言推理解耦的框架，语言模型控制视觉证据获取的时机，而非预先处理所有视觉信息。
一种零样本多模态推理方法，通过按需调用视觉证据来避免统一视觉-语言空间中联合优化和注意力机制导致的语言主导问题。
一种架构：视觉感知模块保持独立，由推理控制器选择性激活，避免静态视觉转文本转换导致的细粒度视觉细节丢失。

title: OccuReward: LLM-Guided Occupant-Centric Reward Shaping for Demographic Equity in Grid-Interactive Buildings
comment: 4 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at OccuSys 2026, co-located with ACM Sustainability Week 2026. Preprint version
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated promising capability in generating reward functions for deep reinforcement learning (DRL)-based building energy management. However, their potential to exhibit or exacerbate disparities in occupant comfort across heterogeneous demographic populations remains unexplored. We present OccuReward, a framework investigating how LLM-mediated reward design affects demographic equity. Our contribution is three-fold: the introduction of the Comfort Equity Index (CEI) as a novel feedback signal; a methodology for iterative, equity-aware LLM reward shaping; and a performance analysis of DRL agents under these refined objectives. Utilizing four empirically grounded occupant profiles from the ASHRAE Global Thermal Comfort Database II (13,440 votes), we deploy a Soft Actor-Critic agent in CityLearn v2. Our approach employs the Gemini API to generate reward function logic and weights--rather than performing per-step inference--across three refinement rounds. Results across 15 experimental runs reveal that elderly female occupants consistently experience the lowest satisfaction in initial rounds. By Round 3, equity-aware LLM refinement activates specific reward components that improve satisfaction for Young Males (+17.6%), Mid-aged Females (+28.2%), Health Sensitive (+53.8%), and Elderly Females (+567%), while simultaneously reducing energy costs by 3.2%. Our findings highlight that while reward-level intervention significantly improves equity, demographic disparities in AI-driven controllers persist, necessitating further research into algorithmic fairness in building systems.

AI.tldr: 提出OccuReward框架，利用LLM迭代生成奖励函数以改善建筑能源管理中多人口群体的舒适公平性，老年女性满意度提升567%并降低3.2%能源成本。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在生成建筑能源管理奖励函数方面展现出潜力，但其对不同人口群体（如老年女性、中年男性等）的舒适公平性影响尚未被探索。
AI.method: 提出OccuReward框架，使用Gemini API生成奖励函数逻辑和权重（非逐步推理），通过三轮迭代进行公平性感知奖励塑形，结合Soft Actor-Critic智能体和ASHRAE Global Thermal Comfort Database II的4个人口群体画像，在CityLearn v2环境中进行仿真。
AI.result: 经过三轮公平性感知LLM奖励细化后，年轻男性满意度提升17.6%，中年女性提升28.2%，健康敏感群体提升53.8%，老年女性提升567%，同时能源成本降低3.2%。
AI.conclusion: Reward-level干预显著提升了多人口群体的舒适公平性（尤其是老年女性满意度提升567%），但AI驱动控制中的群体差异仍然存在，需进一步研究建筑系统的算法公平性。
idea_en: An iterative LLM-based reward shaping method that generates reward function logic and weights through multiple refinement rounds for deep reinforcement learning in building energy management
A Comfort Equity Index (CEI) serving as a novel feedback signal to quantify comfort fairness across heterogeneous demographic populations in building climate control

A building energy control system leveraging LLM API (e.g., Gemini) to generate reward function parameters (not per-step inference) that simultaneously improves demographic comfort equity and reduces energy costs

A demographic-aware comfort optimization method based on multiple occupant profiles (elderly females, mid-aged females, health-sensitive individuals, etc.) that adjusts reward components to achieve fairness across groups
idea_ch: 一种基于LLM的迭代式奖励塑造方法，通过多轮细化生成奖励函数逻辑和权重，用于深度强化学习中的建筑能源管理
一种舒适公平性指数（CEI）作为反馈信号，用于量化不同人口群体在建筑环境控制中的舒适度公平性
一种结合大语言模型API（如Gemini）生成奖励函数（非逐步推理）的节能建筑控制系统，在提升群体舒适公平性的同时降低能源成本
一种基于多人口群体画像（老年女性、中年女性、健康敏感人群等）的差异化舒适度优化方法，通过奖励函数调整实现群体公平性改善

title: Localizing Input Uncertainty Quantification for Large Language Models via Shapley Values
summary: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into high-stakes decision-making, the ability to reliably quantify uncertainty has become a critical requirement for safety and trust. However, current uncertainty quantification methods primarily operate at the output level, often failing to distinguish whether uncertainty arises from the model's lack of knowledge or from ambiguity in the user's input. While input-centric uncertainty quantification has recently emerged as a promising direction, it remains relatively underexplored and typically relies on coarse, input-level information. Consequently, users are provided with scalar uncertainty scores that offer little actionable guidance on which parts of the input should be clarified to improve reliability. To address this limitation, we propose Shapley-based input uncertainty Quantification (ShaQ), a framework for span-level attribution of input-induced uncertainty. Our approach models ambiguous spans in the input as players in a cooperative game and quantifies their contributions using Shapley values, defined via the weighted average of marginal reductions in conditional entropy obtained by clarifying each span coalition. Unlike existing input-level approaches, our formulation captures complex interactions among spans and provides a principled decomposition in which individual attributions sum exactly to the total input-induced uncertainty. We evaluate ShaQ on the AmbigQA and AmbiEnt benchmarks, where it achieves state-of-the-art performance in ambiguity detection. We further demonstrate its utility on MediTOD, showing that ShaQ can localize under-specified clinical utterances and facilitate human-AI collaboration in high-stakes settings. Overall, ShaQ improves uncertainty estimation and provides actionable insights for targeted input clarification.

AI.tldr: 提出Shapley-based input uncertainty Quantification (ShaQ)框架，通过将输入中的模糊片段建模为合作博弈中的玩家，利用Shapley值量化各片段对输入不确定性贡献，实现跨度级别的输入不确定性归因，提升高风险场景下的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有不确定性量化方法主要在输出层面操作，无法区分不确定性源于模型知识缺失还是用户输入模糊；输入层面方法仅提供粗粒度的标量分数，缺乏可操作的指导。
AI.method: 将输入中的模糊片段视为合作博弈中的参与者，通过澄清每个片段联盟后条件熵的边际减少量的加权平均来定义Shapley值，实现跨度级别的归因分解。
AI.result: 在AmbigQA和AmbiEnt基准上取得模糊性检测的SOTA性能；在MediTOD上可定位临床表述中不明确的片段，促进人机协作。
AI.conclusion: ShaQ不仅提升了不确定性估计的精度，还提供了可操作的输入澄清指导，适用于高风险的医疗等领域。
idea_en: A method for span-level attribution of input-induced uncertainty in LLMs using Shapley values from cooperative game theory, where ambiguous text spans are treated as players and their contributions quantified via marginal reductions in conditional entropy.

A weighted average mechanism for computing Shapley values based on clarification of span coalitions, enabling exact decomposition where individual span attributions sum to total input-induced uncertainty.
A framework that distinguishes uncertainty from model ignorance vs. input ambiguity by localizing under-specified spans in user queries, applicable to high-stakes decision-making systems.
An ambiguity detection system for clinical utterances (MediTOD) that identifies under-specified medical terms and facilitates targeted human-AI collaboration.
idea_ch: 一种基于合作博弈论Shapley值的LLM输入不确定性跨度归因方法，将文本中的模糊片段视为博弈参与者，通过条件熵边际减少量量化其贡献
一种基于片段联盟澄清的加权平均Shapley值计算机制，实现个体归因之和精确等于总输入不确定性的分解
一种区分模型知识缺失与输入模糊不确定性的框架，能够定位用户查询中未明确指定的片段，适用于高风险决策场景
一种用于临床表述模糊性检测的系统，可识别医疗术语中不明确的部分，促进人机协作中的针对性澄清

title: Agentic Active Omni-Modal Perception for Multi-Hop Audio-Visual Reasoning
summary: Multi-hop audio-visual reasoning remains challenging for Omni-LLMs, as relevant evidence is often sparse, temporally dispersed, and distributed across both audio and visual streams. Existing benchmarks provide limited investigation of this setting, typically involving only a limited number of modalities, relevant temporal segments, or reasoning steps. In this work, we introduce MOV-Bench, a benchmark containing 519 carefully curated questions that require multi-hop reasoning over temporally dispersed audio-visual evidence. Evaluations on MOV-Bench reveal that current Omni-LLMs still struggle with multi-hop cross-modal reasoning. To address this challenge, we further propose AOP-Agent, an efficient agentic framework built on open-source Omni-LLMs for active omni-modal perception. By combining a hierarchical omni-modal memory with a collaborative observe-reflect-replan loop, AOP-Agent enables open-source Omni-LLMs to perform active perception without additional training or proprietary models. Experiments on MOV-Bench and OmniVideoBench demonstrate that AOP-Agent consistently improves reasoning performance, with particularly notable gains on long videos and reasoning-intensive questions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MOV-Bench基准（519道多跳音视频推理题）和AOP-Agent框架（分层全模态记忆+协作式感知循环），旨在解决Omni-LLMs在多跳跨模态推理中的难题，实验证明该框架能有效提升长视频和推理密集型问题的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有Omni-LLMs在多跳音视频推理中表现不佳，因为相关证据稀疏、时间分散且跨模态分布；现有基准测试在模态数量、时间片段和推理步骤上存在局限。
AI.method: 1) 构建MOV-Bench基准，包含519道需多跳推理的跨模态音视频问题；2) 提出AOP-Agent代理框架，包含分层全模态记忆(hierarchical omni-modal memory)和协作式观察-反思-重规划循环(collaborative observe-reflect-replan loop)，无需额外训练或专有模型即可实现主动感知。
AI.result: 在MOV-Bench和OmniVideoBench上，AOP-Agent持续提升推理性能，尤其在长视频和推理密集型问题上表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 当前Omni-LLMs在多跳跨模态推理上仍存在困难，AOP-Agent提供了一种无需额外训练的高效解决方案，为开放源全模态大模型的多跳推理能力提升提供了新路径。
idea_en: Hierarchical omni-modal memory system that organizes and retrieves temporally dispersed audio-visual evidence across multiple time scales for multi-hop reasoning.
Collaborative observe-reflect-replan agentic loop enabling active perception without additional model training.
Benchmark design methodology for curating multi-hop cross-modal reasoning questions with temporally dispersed evidence across audio and visual streams.
idea_ch: 分层全模态记忆系统：在多个时间尺度上组织和检索时间上分散的音视频证据，支持多跳推理任务
协作式观察-反思-重规划代理循环：无需额外模型训练即可实现主动跨模态感知的智能体框架
多跳跨模态推理基准构建方法：专门设计需在音频和视频流中跨时间片段收集稀疏证据的推理问题集

title: Plant, Persist, Trigger: Sleeper Attack on Large Language Model Agents
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents remain vulnerable to safety threats from the external environment, where attackers inject adversarial content into external observations such as tool-returned data, webpages, or MCP context, causing harmful agentic behaviors such as unsafe actions or incorrect outputs. Existing studies typically focus on single-interaction attacks, where the agent observes adversarial content and immediately exhibits harmful behavior within one user request. However, we show that adversarial content can also persist across interactions served by the same agent, making such threats harder to detect and mitigate. Specifically, adversarial content may persist in the agent state, remain dormant across interactions, and later be activated by a benign user query. We formalize this type of safety threat as Sleeper Attack. To evaluate it, we construct a benchmark with 1,896 instances covering six real-world harmful outcomes, three attack strategies, and three agent state targets: session context, memory, and reusable skills. Experiments on seven strong open-source and closed-source LLMs show that state-of-the-art LLM agents remain vulnerable to Sleeper Attack, even when they achieve low attack success rates under a single-interaction baseline. Our code and data are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/skdvnfu23ihr9wdscnksf1asdffsaef.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Sleeper Attack（休眠攻击），一种针对LLM Agent的跨交互安全威胁：对抗性内容持久存在于Agent状态（会话上下文、记忆、可复用技能）中，跨交互潜伏，被良性用户查询激活，导致有害行为。构建了含1896个实例的基准，实验表明强LLM Agent对此类攻击依然脆弱。
AI.motivation: 现有研究仅关注单次交互攻击（攻击内容在单次请求中立即触发有害行为），忽视了对抗性内容可在Agent状态中长期持久存在、跨交互潜伏并随后被激活的安全威胁。
AI.method: 1. 形式化定义Sleeper Attack，提出攻击框架：持久化对抗内容到Agent状态→休眠→被良性用户查询激活。2. 构建基准测试集（1,896个实例），涵盖6种真实世界有害后果、3种攻击策略、3种Agent状态目标（会话上下文、记忆、可复用技能）。3. 在7个强开源/闭源LLM上进行实验评估。
AI.result: 最先进的LLM Agent在Sleeper Attack下仍然脆弱，即使它们在单次交互基线攻击下成功率很低。
AI.conclusion: 对抗性内容可在Agent状态中持久存在并跨交互激活，因此需要新的防御机制来检测和缓解这种跨交互的安全威胁。
idea_en: Sleeper Attack method: a multi-turn attack framework where adversarial content is persistently injected into LLM agent state (session context, memory, or reusable skills), remains dormant across multiple user interactions, and is later activated by a benign query to cause harmful agentic behaviors.

A benchmark dataset for evaluating cross-interaction persistent safety threats in LLM agents, comprising 1,896 instances across 6 harmful outcome types, 3 attack strategies, and 3 agent state targets (session context, memory, reusable skills).

Persistent adversarial content injection via agent memory mechanism: embedding malicious instructions into long-term memory stores of LLM agents that persist beyond individual sessions and activate upon retrieval of related benign queries.

Reusable skill poisoning: injecting adversarial content into agent-learned reusable skills/tools, such that the poisoned skill remains dormant until invoked by a benign user request, causing unintended harmful actions.
idea_ch: Sleeper Attack方法：一种多轮攻击框架，将对抗性内容持久注入LLM Agent状态（会话上下文、记忆或可复用技能），在多次用户交互间保持休眠，后被良性查询激活以引发有害Agent行为。
跨交互持久性安全威胁基准数据集：包含1,896个实例，覆盖6种有害后果类型、3种攻击策略和3种Agent状态目标（会话上下文、记忆、可复用技能）。
基于Agent记忆机制的持久对抗内容注入：将恶意指令嵌入LLM Agent的长期记忆存储中，跨会话持久存在，在检索到相关良性查询时激活。
可复用技能投毒：将对抗性内容注入Agent学习的可复用技能/工具中，使被投毒技能在调用前保持休眠，被良性用户请求触发后导致意外有害行为。

title: The Illusion of Opting in AI-Mediated Consequential Decisions
summary: Drawing on Ullmann-Margalit's concept of opting (transformative, irrevocable, and shadowed by foreclosed alternatives), we show that current AI systems raise a profound ethical problem that existing AI ethics has not fully captured: the illusion of opting, in which persons and groups encounter the deceptive appearance of meaningful consequential choice while the agency needed to become genuinely capable of choosing is weakened. Against approaches that treat AI primarily as an optimizer of already given ends, we argue that AI systems should be evaluated by whether they protect and cultivate meta-capacity against the illusion of opting: the socially and institutionally scaffolded agentive capacity through which means and ends can be formed, contested, revised, and owned. This reframing is especially urgent for disadvantaged populations, who are least able to absorb the costs of the illusion of opting when AI-mediated pathways misdirect behavior and action. We propose three normative imperatives for AI-mediated consequential decisions: existential honesty, which acknowledges the limits of prediction; ecological rationality, which situates guidance within heterogeneous lived ecologies; and counterfactual reparation, which acknowledges and repairs foreclosed alternatives when AI-mediated decision-making pathways fail.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AI系统存在"选择错觉"问题——表面提供有意义的选择，实则削弱了用户真正的选择能力。作者提出AI应保护和培养"元能力"（社会性选择能力），并给出三条规范原则：存在诚实、生态理性、反事实修复。
AI.motivation: 现有AI伦理未能充分捕捉AI系统造成的深层伦理问题：用户看似拥有选择权，实际上真正的选择能力被削弱，尤其对弱势群体影响更大。
AI.method: 基于Ullmann-Margalit的"选择"概念（变革性、不可逆性、被排除替代方案的阴影），分析AI系统中"选择错觉"的伦理问题，提出三个规范原则。
AI.result: 识别出"选择错觉"作为AI伦理新问题，提出保护"元能力"（社会性选择能力）的评估框架，以及三条规范原则。
AI.conclusion: AI系统不应仅被视为给定目标的优化器，而应评估其对用户"元能力"的影响，特别关注弱势群体。
idea_en: A method for evaluating AI systems based on their impact on users' meta-capacity for socially and institutionally scaffolded agentive choice, rather than mere optimization of given ends.
An AI system design framework incorporating existential honesty, which explicitly acknowledges and communicates the limits of prediction in consequential decision-making.
A counterfactual reparation mechanism for AI-mediated decisions, which detects and compensates for foreclosed alternatives when decision pathways fail.
An ecological rationality module that situates AI guidance within heterogeneous lived ecologies by incorporating contextual user feedback loops.

A system for detecting and mitigating the 'illusion of opting' in AI interfaces, using agency-preserving interaction design that maintains users' capacity to form, contest, revise, and own means and ends.
idea_ch: 基于元能力保护的AI系统评估方法：评估AI系统对用户社会性选择能力（元能力）的影响，而非仅衡量其对给定目标的优化效果
存在诚实机制：在AI驱动的重要决策中，明确承认并告知用户预测的不确定性和局限性，防止虚假确定性误导
反事实修复机制：当AI中介的决策路径失效时，自动检测并补偿被排除的替代方案，修复用户的损失
生态理性模块：通过融入用户上下文反馈循环，将AI引导置于用户异质生活生态中，避免一刀切建议
选择错觉检测与缓解系统：通过维护用户能动性的交互设计，识别并缓解AI界面中的'选择错觉'，确保用户能够形成、质疑、修订和拥有自己的手段与目标

title: Learning When to Optimize: Verified Optimization Skills from Expert GPU-Kernel Lineages
summary: LLM-based agents are increasingly used to generate GPU kernels, but they often know what optimizations to try without knowing when those optimizations are sound. We introduce KLineage, which learns this missing "when" knowledge from expert kernels: instead of relying on forward rollouts, KLineage walks expert implementations backward through validation-gated simplifications and reverses each accepted step into a reusable optimization skill. Each skill records not only the optimization intent, but also where it applies in code, what conditions made it valid, what effect it had, and what failures its assumptions avoid. A downstream LLM materializes these skills on new code surfaces under the same compile/correctness/profile gate. On five expert workloads across two NVIDIA architectures, these lineage-derived skills serve as an effective optimization curriculum, exceeding recent memory-based LLM-kernel baselines in both final kernel quality and optimization efficiency under the same fixed budget. We additionally use a separate 22-instance held-out check as a sanity test against source-case memorization.

AI.tldr: KLineage通过从专家GPU内核反向推导优化技能，学习优化何时适用，从而提升LLM代理生成内核的质量和效率。
AI.motivation: LLM代理在生成GPU内核时知道"做什么"优化，但不知道"何时"这些优化是安全的，缺乏验证优化适用性的知识。
AI.method: 从专家实现开始，通过验证门控的简化步骤反向遍历，将每个被接受的步骤逆转成可复用的优化技能。每个技能记录优化意图、适用代码位置、有效性条件、效果及假设失败的后果。
AI.result: 在5个专家工作负载和2种NVIDIA架构上，KLineage在最终内核质量和优化效率上均超过了基于记忆的LLM内核基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 从专家内核反向推导的优化技能可以作为有效的优化课程，显著提升LLM代理的GPU内核生成能力。
idea_en: A method for learning optimization applicability conditions by walking expert GPU kernel implementations backward through validation-gated simplification steps and reversing each accepted step into a reusable optimization skill.
A technical system where each optimization skill records optimization intent, applicable code location, validity conditions, effect, and failure assumptions to ensure safe application.
A validation-gated simplification process that decomposes expert GPU kernels into atomic optimization steps with verified correctness conditions.
A method for LLM agents to materialize lineage-derived optimization skills on new code surfaces under compile/correctness/profile gates.
A technique for using backward lineage traversal from expert implementations to generate an optimization curriculum for LLM-based GPU kernel generation.
idea_ch: 一种通过验证门控简化步骤反向遍历专家GPU内核实现，并将每个被接受的步骤逆转成可复用优化技能的方法。
一种技术系统，每个优化技能记录优化意图、适用代码位置、有效性条件、效果和失败假设，以确保安全应用。
一种验证门控的简化过程，将专家GPU内核分解为具有已验证正确性条件的原子优化步骤。
一种让LLM代理在编译/正确性/性能分析门控下，将优化技能物化到新代码表面的方法。
一种利用从专家实现反向遍历生成优化课程，用于LLM驱动的GPU内核生成的技术。

title: Explaining is Harder Than Predicting Alone: Evaluating Concept-based Explanations of MLLMs as ICL Visual Classifiers
comment: Accepted to the CompLearn Workshop at ICML 2026
summary:
In-context learning (ICL) enables multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to classify images from a few labelled examples. Yet, how these models use the provided context remains opaque. While Chain-of-Thought prompting is widely used, recent work argues that it may not reflect true internal computation.
  In this paper, we systematically evaluate the concept-based explainability of frozen MLLMs under few-shot ICL using five conditions of increasing formal rigour, ranging from baseline classification to Description Logics (DL) axiom generation.
  Evaluating four state-of-the-art MLLMs via an independent LLM-as-a-judge pipeline, we demonstrate that explaining is genuinely harder than predicting alone. Surprisingly, forcing models to generate formally structured, concept-based explanations degrades predictive accuracy monotonically (from 93.8% to 90.1%), contradicting the assumption that explicit reasoning universally aids performance.
  However, when models successfully articulate class-discriminative visual features, explanation quality strongly correlates with correct predictions. Our findings suggest that while MLLMs excel at visual classification, they lack the specific instruction-tuning required for formal, machine-verifiable explainability.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了多模态大语言模型在少样本上下文学习下的概念可解释性，发现生成形式化结构化解释会降低预测准确率（从93.8%降至90.1%），但成功描述类别判别视觉特征时，解释质量与正确预测强相关。
AI.motivation: 现有研究对MLLMs在ICL中如何使用上下文信息理解不足，且Chain-of-Thought提示可能不反映真实内部计算，需要更严格的评估方法。
AI.method: 设计了五个递增形式化严格程度的条件（从基线分类到描述逻辑公理生成），使用独立LLM-as-a-judge流程评估四个SOTA MLLMs。
AI.result: 形式化解释降低预测准确率（93.8%→90.1%），但高质量解释与正确预测强相关；MLLMs缺乏形式化可验证可解释性的指令微调。
AI.conclusion: MLLMs擅长视觉分类但缺乏形式化可解释能力，明确推理并不总是提升性能，解释与预测之间存在复杂关系。
idea_en: A method for evaluating concept-based explainability of frozen multimodal large language models using Description Logics axiom generation under few-shot in-context learning
An LLM-as-a-judge pipeline for independently assessing explanation quality of MLLMs across multiple formal rigor conditions
A systematic framework with five conditions of increasing formal rigor for measuring the gap between predictive accuracy and explanation quality in MLLMs
A technique to force MLLMs to generate formally structured, concept-based explanations while monitoring monotonic degradation in predictive accuracy
idea_ch: 一种利用描述逻辑公理生成在少样本上下文学习下评估冻结多模态大语言模型概念可解释性的方法
一种跨多个形式化严格程度条件独立评估MLLMs解释质量的LLM-as-a-judge流水线
一种包含五个递增形式化严格程度条件的系统框架，用于衡量MLLMs预测准确性与解释质量之间的差距
一种强制MLLMs生成形式化结构化概念解释并监控预测准确率单调下降的技术

title: When Does Memory Help Multi-Trajectory Inference for Tool-Use LLM Agents?
comment: More evaluation and analysis are on the way
summary: Multi-trajectory inference for tool-use LLM agents - generating multiple reasoning attempts and selecting among them - benefits from transferring knowledge across attempts so that later ones avoid the pitfalls of earlier ones. Existing cross-trajectory memory methods (trajectory-level reflection, atomic fact extraction, raw observation injection) are each evaluated under a single inference strategy on a single task, making it unclear whether reported gains reflect properties of the memory abstraction or of the inference method. We propose a unified framework that decomposes memory along two axes -- the scope of transfer (within an expansion vs. across trajectories) and the abstraction of the transferred content -- and evaluate four methods under three inference strategies (best-of-N, beam search, MCTS) on four tool-use benchmarks spanning SQL, knowledge-graph, and CLI environments, in a verifier-free setting that matches the deployment regime of practical agents. The experiment matrix identifies the inference method as a confound: the same memory method produces statistically distinct results under different inference strategies on the same examples. Reflection reaches significance only under MCTS (not under best-of-N); within-expansion injection (conditioning each candidate on prior siblings' outcomes) helps only diversity-starved beam search; and atomic fact extraction is accuracy-neutral but shortens trajectories by 19-26% on tasks with reusable environmental structure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出统一框架，将工具型LLM智能体的跨轨迹记忆分解为两个维度（转移范围和内容抽象），在三种推理策略（best-of-N、beam search、MCTS）和四个基准上系统评估四种记忆方法，发现推理策略本身是显著的混淆变量。
AI.motivation: 现有跨轨迹记忆方法（轨迹级反思、原子事实提取、原始观察注入）各在不同推理策略和任务上独立评估，无法判断性能提升是源于记忆抽象本身还是推理方法。
AI.method: 提出统一框架，沿两个维度分解记忆：转移范围（扩展内 vs. 跨轨迹）和内容抽象程度；在无验证器设定下，对四种记忆方法在三种推理策略（best-of-N、beam search、MCTS）下进行系统评估。
AI.result: 推理策略是混淆变量；反思仅在MCTS下显著；扩展内注入仅对多样性不足的beam search有效；原子事实提取对精度中性但可将轨迹长度缩短19-26%。
AI.conclusion: 记忆方法的效果高度依赖于推理策略，未来研究需控制这一混淆变量，原子事实提取在保持精度的同时显著缩短轨迹。
idea_en: A unified framework for cross-trajectory memory in tool-use LLM agents that decomposes memory along two axes: transfer scope (within-expansion vs. across-trajectories) and content abstraction level.
A verifier-free evaluation methodology for multi-trajectory inference in tool-use LLM agents that matches practical deployment conditions.
Systematic identification of inference strategy as a confounding variable when evaluating cross-trajectory memory methods for LLM agents.
Atomic fact extraction method that reduces trajectory length by 19-26% without accuracy loss in tool-use tasks with reusable environmental structure.
idea_ch: 一种用于工具型LLM智能体的跨轨迹记忆统一框架，沿两个维度分解记忆：转移范围（扩展内 vs. 跨轨迹）和内容抽象程度。
一种匹配实际部署条件的无验证器评估方法论，用于工具型LLM智能体的多轨迹推理。
系统性地识别推理策略作为评估LLM智能体跨轨迹记忆方法时的混淆变量。
一种原子事实提取方法，在具有可复用环境结构的工具使用任务中，可将轨迹长度缩短19-26%且不损失精度。

title: PIRS: Physics-Informed Reward Shaping for SAC-Based Building Energy Management
comment: N pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the 2nd Workshop on AI-Driven Energy Efficiency in Dynamic Systems (AI-DEEDS '26), co-located with ACM e-Energy / ACM Sustainability Week, Banff, AB, Canada, June 22-25, 2026
summary: Occupant comfort and grid-aware energy efficiency are competing objectives whose joint optimization depends critically on how reward functions are specified in deep reinforcement learning (DRL) controllers for buildings. Yet reward design remains largely ad hoc: comfort terms are either hand-tuned heuristics or simple temperature-deviation proxies without explicit grounding in thermal-comfort physics. We present PIRS (Physics-Informed Reward Shaping), which replaces these ad-hoc comfort proxies with the ISO 7730 Predicted Mean Vote (PMV) formulation inside a weighted multi-objective reward for Soft Actor-Critic (SAC). By anchoring the comfort signal in the ISO 7730 PMV formulation, PIRS improves reward interpretability and provides a standards-grounded comfort proxy without changing any other component of the learning pipeline. We evaluate PIRS in CityLearn v2.1.2 (challenge 2022 phase 1) with a central SAC agent trained for 50k steps over five random seeds, and compare against a rule-based controller (RBC), a manually engineered reward (E2), an energy-only reward (E3), and a naive temperature-deviation comfort reward (E4). District-level key performance indicators (KPIs), reported as ratios versus RBC, show that PIRS attains cost, carbon, and electricity metrics on par with the manual baseline while substantially outperforming non-physics-grounded designs -- particularly on load ramping (1.78x vs. ~2.4x RBC) and daily peak demand. All DRL policies remain above RBC at this training budget; we interpret this gap honestly and position PIRS as an interpretable, standards-aligned foundation for reward design rather than a claim of dominance over classical control at limited compute.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PIRS（物理信息奖励塑形方法），将ISO 7730 PMV热舒适物理模型嵌入深度强化学习（SAC）的奖励函数中，替代传统启发式或温度偏差类舒适代理，实现更可解释、符合标准的建筑能耗与舒适度联合优化。实验表明PIRS在多项KPI上优于非物基奖励设计，尤其是在负荷爬坡和峰值需求方面。
AI.motivation: 现有建筑DRL控制器的奖励函数设计中，舒适度项要么是靠手工调参的启发式规则，要么是简单的温度偏差代理，缺乏热舒适物理理论的支撑，导致优化效果不稳定且难以解释。
AI.method: 将ISO 7730标准的PMV（预测平均投票）公式作为奖励函数中的舒适度分量，与能耗目标一起构成加权多目标奖励，用于SAC（Soft Actor-Critic）算法训练。不改变学习管道的其他任何组件。
AI.result: 在CityLearn v2.1.2基准上，PIRS在成本、碳排放和电力指标上与手工设计基线相当，在负荷爬坡（1.78x vs ~2.4x RBC）和日峰值需求上显著优于非物理基奖励设计。
AI.conclusion: PIRS提供了一种可解释、符合标准、即插即用的奖励塑形方法，可作为DRL建筑控制奖励设计的基准基础，而非声称在有限计算下超越经典控制。
idea_en: A physics-informed reward shaping method for building DRL controllers that replaces ad-hoc comfort proxies with ISO 7730 PMV formulation as a weighted multi-objective reward component.
A standardized comfort reward anchor based on thermal-comfort physics (Predicted Mean Vote) integrated into Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) without altering other learning pipeline components.
A plug-and-play reward design framework that improves interpretability and provides standards-grounded comfort proxy for deep reinforcement learning in building energy management.
idea_ch: 一种基于物理信息的奖励塑形方法，将ISO 7730 PMV公式替代传统启发式舒适度代理，作为建筑DRL控制器的加权多目标奖励组成部分。
一种将热舒适物理标准（PMV预测平均投票）嵌入SAC算法、且不改变学习管道其他部分的标准化舒适奖励锚定技术。
一种即插即用的奖励设计框架，在建筑能源管理深度强化学习中提升奖励可解释性并提供符合标准的舒适度代理。

title: AI, Take the Wheel: What Drives Delegation and Trust in Human-Computer Cooperative Question Answering?
comment: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics, 2026
summary: AI systems are fallible, and humans can make mistakes in deciding whether to trust AI over their own judgment. Thus, improving human-AI collaboration requires understanding when, why, and how humans decide to rely on AI. We study two distinct reliance decisions: the delegation choice -- deciding when to let AI act autonomously without knowing its output, and the adoption choice -- evaluating AI suggestions and deciding how to use them. Both of these decoupled reliance patterns shape collaboration, but prior work rarely studies them together in realistic settings with the same users. We address this gap by studying collaborative human--AI teams competing in a question-answering game in which humans can choose when and how to work with AI agents to win. Our 24 matches pair 23 expert humans with 16 AI agents, capturing 387 delegation and 1440 adoption decisions. While human--AI collaboration performs better than either AI or humans alone, humans make suboptimal collaboration decisions, both under-relying on correct AI suggestions (3.9% of opportunities missed) and over-relying when AI misleads them (1.7%). Both parties contribute wrong answers: reported model confidence is near chance when humans and AI disagree, while confirmation bias drives higher under-reliance (64.5%) when an AI suggestion agrees with humans' initial incorrect answer. To close this gap, we recommend calibrated confidence, evidence-grounded explanations, and mechanisms that help users refine trust.

AI.tldr: 研究人类与AI协作中的两种依赖决策（委托与采纳），通过问答游戏实验发现人类存在过度依赖和依赖不足的双重问题，并提出校准置信度、证据解释和信任优化机制等改进建议。
AI.motivation: 现有研究很少在同一真实场景中同时研究人类对AI的委托决策（是否让AI自主行动）和采纳决策（是否采纳AI建议），无法全面理解人类-AI协作中的依赖模式。
AI.method: 设计问答游戏，让23名专家与16个AI代理配对进行24场比赛，捕获387次委托决策和1440次采纳决策，分析人类在两种依赖决策中的行为模式。
AI.result: 人类-AI协作优于单独AI或人类，但人类存在次优协作决策：对正确AI建议的依赖不足（错失3.9%机会）和错误时的过度依赖（1.7%）；确认偏差导致64.5%的依赖不足发生在AI建议与人类初始错误答案一致时。
AI.conclusion: 需要校准的置信度、基于证据的解释以及帮助用户优化信任的机制来改善人机协作。
idea_en: A method for decoupled analysis of delegation and adoption decisions in human-AI collaboration using a competitive question-answering game framework
A system for detecting and mitigating confirmation bias in human-AI collaboration by analyzing when AI suggestions align with users' initial incorrect answers
A calibrated confidence mechanism that adjusts AI confidence scores based on the disagreement patterns between human and AI predictions
An evidence-grounded explanation system that provides interpretable reasoning for AI suggestions to improve user trust calibration
A trust refinement mechanism that dynamically alerts users to potential under-reliance or over-reliance patterns based on historical decision data
idea_ch: 基于问答竞赛游戏框架的人机协作委托与采纳决策解耦分析方法
通过分析AI建议与用户初始错误答案一致性的确认偏差检测与缓解系统
基于人机预测分歧模式的校准置信度机制，动态调整AI置信度评分
提供可解释推理过程的证据型解释系统，用于改善用户对AI建议的信任校准
基于历史决策数据动态预警用户潜在依赖不足或过度依赖模式的信任优化机制

title: Entropy Distribution as a Fingerprint for Hallucinations in Generative Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) often generate factually incorrect outputs, commonly termed hallucinations, that undermine trust and limit deployment in high-stakes settings. Existing hallucination detection methods typically require multiple forward passes, or access to model internals. In this work, we provide theoretical background and empirical evidence that the distribution of token-level entropies, beyond the mean captured by perplexity or length-normalised entropy, serves as a fingerprint of hallucination, with distributional shape and tail behaviour carrying independent signal. We formalize hallucination detection as a statistical hypothesis test and propose the Calibrated Entropy Score (CES), a lightweight algorithm requiring only a single forward pass and black-box access to token logits. CES combines the mean signal with the maximum signal of the generated entropy through a calibrated reference CDF, producing scores that are directly comparable across models and tasks. We establish finite-sample calibration guarantees via a novel random-length Dvoretzky--Kiefer--Wolfowitz inequality, and also prove that CES detects hallucinations with probability converging to one exponentially fast in the generation length. Across eight QA benchmarks and ten generator models spanning open-source and API access models, CES achieves the highest detection performance among all single-pass black-box methods while providing formal error guarantees that existing heuristics lack. Remarkably, CES is statistically indistinguishable from multi-sample methods that require far greater computational cost, closing the gap between lightweight and expensive detection and making it suitable for real-time, large-scale deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出校准熵分数（CES），一种仅需单次前向传递和黑盒访问token logits的轻量级幻觉检测算法。通过结合熵的均值信号与最大值信号，并利用校准参考CDF，CES在多个QA基准和生成模型上达到了与多采样方法统计不可区分的检测性能，同时提供了形式化的误差保证。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型（LLM）常产生事实性错误输出（幻觉），现有检测方法需要多次前向传递或访问模型内部结构，计算成本高且缺乏形式化保证。需要一种轻量级、单次前向传递、无需模型内部访问的幻觉检测方法。
AI.method: 1. 理论分析token级熵分布的尾部行为与分布形状可作为幻觉指纹。2. 将幻觉检测形式化为统计假设检验。3. 提出CES算法：结合生成熵的均值信号与最大值信号，通过校准参考CDF生成可直接跨模型与任务比较的分数。4. 证明随机长度DKW不等式，建立有限样本校准保证。5. 证明CES检测幻觉的概率随生成长度指数收敛到1。
AI.result: 在8个QA基准和10个生成模型上，CES在所有单次前向传递黑盒方法中取得最高检测性能，且与计算成本更高的多采样方法统计不可区分。
AI.conclusion: CES弥合了轻量级与昂贵检测方法之间的差距，适合实时、大规模部署，同时提供形式化误差保证，弥补了现有启发式方法的不足。
idea_en: A method for hallucination detection in LLMs using distributional fingerprint of token-level entropies beyond mean/perplexity, including shape and tail behavior analysis.
A Calibrated Entropy Score (CES) algorithm that combines mean and maximum signals of generated entropy through a calibrated reference CDF for single-pass black-box hallucination detection.
A statistical hypothesis testing framework for formalizing hallucination detection in LLMs with finite-sample calibration guarantees.
A novel random-length Dvoretzky-Kiefer-Wolfowitz inequality providing theoretical calibration guarantees for hallucination detection.
A lightweight single-forward-pass hallucination detection method that achieves performance statistically indistinguishable from multi-sample methods without requiring model internals access.
idea_ch: 一种基于token级熵分布指纹（超越均值/困惑度，包括分布形状和尾部行为）的LLM幻觉检测方法
一种校准熵分数（CES）算法，通过校准参考CDF结合生成熵的均值信号与最大值信号，实现单次前向传递黑盒幻觉检测
一种将LLM幻觉检测形式化为统计假设检验的框架，具备有限样本校准保证
一种随机长度Dvoretzky-Kiefer-Wolfowitz不等式，为幻觉检测提供理论校准保证
一种轻量级单次前向传递幻觉检测方法，无需访问模型内部，性能与计算成本更高的多采样方法统计不可区分

title: Global Policy-Space Response Oracles for Two-Player Zero-Sum Games
summary: The Policy-Space Response Oracles (PSRO) framework scales equilibrium computation to large zero-sum games by iteratively expanding a restricted strategy set using deep reinforcement learning (DRL). A central challenge is to construct, under limited computational budgets, a small strategy population whose induced game well approximates the full game. Existing PSRO variants typically expand the population using best responses to meta-strategies computed from restricted-game payoffs, which can lead to inefficient expansions that provide limited global improvement. We propose to guide population expansion by directly evaluating the post-expansion population quality. Specifically, we adopt Population Exploitability (PE) to measure how well a restricted strategy set represents the full game, and introduce a two-phase exploration--selection framework that explicitly minimizes PE during expansion. We instantiate this framework as Global PSRO, a practical DRL-based algorithm that efficiently generates candidate responses and estimates PE via parameter-sharing conditional neural networks. Experiments across multiple two-player zero-sum games show that Global PSRO achieves lower exploitability and approximates Nash equilibria with significantly fewer policy iterations than prior PSRO methods.

AI.tldr: 提出Global PSRO框架，通过直接优化总体可利用性(Population Exploitability)来指导策略种群扩展，在更低策略迭代次数下实现更优的纳什均衡近似。
AI.motivation: 现有PSRO变体基于受限博弈收益计算的元策略来扩展种群，可能导致效率低下的扩展，全局改进有限。
AI.method: 采用Population Exploitability (PE)衡量受限策略集对完整游戏的表示质量，引入两阶段探索-选择框架显式最小化PE，通过参数共享条件神经网络高效生成候选响应并估计PE。
AI.result: 在多个两人零和游戏中，Global PSRO以更少的策略迭代实现了更低的可利用性，优于先前PSRO方法。
AI.conclusion: 直接优化种群质量指标(PE)可以显著提升PSRO的扩展效率，实现更高效的均衡计算。
idea_en: A method for guiding strategy population expansion in equilibrium computation using Population Exploitability (PE) as a direct optimization metric for post-expansion population quality
A two-phase exploration-selection framework that explicitly minimizes population exploitability during strategy set expansion in zero-sum games
Parameter-sharing conditional neural networks for efficiently generating candidate responses and estimating Population Exploitability in deep RL-based PSRO
idea_ch: 一种利用种群可利用性(PE)作为直接优化指标来引导策略种群扩展的均衡计算方法
一种在零和博弈策略集扩展中显式最小化种群可利用性的两阶段探索-选择框架
基于参数共享条件神经网络的深度强化学习PSRO方法，用于高效生成候选响应并估计种群可利用性

title: Do LLMs Build World Models From Text? A Multilingual Diagnostic of Spatial Reasoning
summary: Whether large language models (LLMs) construct internal spatial world models from pure-text descriptions remains contested, and whether such capabilities transfer across languages has not been systematically studied. We introduce MentalMap, a multilingual diagnostic benchmark with a six-level capability hierarchy (L0-L5) spanning atomic spatial facts to generative world-graph construction, together with four diagnostic axes probing frame of reference, reading-direction bias, reasoning-effort allocation, and hallucination. MentalMap is built from 100 ProcTHOR household scenes, covers eight typologically diverse languages plus a structured-text control, and contains 39 task families across 1,950 evaluation cells. Evaluating thirteen LLMs across scales and model families, we identify a universal L3 reasoning cliff: no model retains even half of its L0 performance on viewpoint reasoning once baseline atomic accuracy exceeds 40%. The cliff persists across languages, scales, and prompting strategies, while structured-output failures and reasoning patterns vary substantially across models. Human evaluation under the identical pure-text protocol reproduces the same failure pattern, suggesting that the bottleneck arises from text-only working memory constraints rather than being specific to current LLM architectures. Our findings reframe pure-text spatial reasoning as a multi-axis world-modeling problem and motivate multimodal and scratchpad-augmented reasoning as future directions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MentalMap多语言诊断基准，发现所有LLM在空间视角推理中存在普遍的L3推理断崖，即无论模型规模、语言类型或提示策略，在基线原子事实准确率超过40%后，视角推理性能甚至无法保持一半。该断崖在人工评估中也复现，表明瓶颈源于纯文本工作记忆限制。
AI.motivation: 现有研究对LLM是否能从纯文本中构建内部空间世界模型存在争议，且跨语言的空间推理能力尚未被系统研究。作者希望系统性地诊断和揭示LLM在多语言环境下的空间推理能力边界。
AI.method: 构建MentalMap基准，包含六级能力层级(L0-L5)和四个诊断轴（参考框架、阅读方向偏差、推理努力分配、幻觉）。基于100个ProcTHOR室内场景，覆盖8种语言+结构化文本对照，包含39个任务族、1950个评估单元，对13个LLM进行全面评估。
AI.result: 发现普遍存在的L3推理断崖：所有模型在视角推理任务上的性能无法保持基线原子事实准确率的一半。该断崖跨语言、跨模型规模、跨提示策略均存在。人工评估在相同纯文本协议下复现了相同失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 纯文本空间推理应被重新定义为多轴世界建模问题，瓶颈来自纯文本工作记忆限制而非LLM架构特有。未来方向包括多模态和草稿板增强推理。
idea_en: A multilingual spatial reasoning diagnostic benchmark with hierarchical capability levels (L0-L5) for systematically evaluating LLM internal world model construction from pure-text descriptions.
A four-axis diagnostic framework (frame of reference, reading-direction bias, reasoning-effort allocation, hallucination) for analyzing spatial reasoning failures in language models.
Discovery of a universal L3 reasoning cliff phenomenon where viewpoint reasoning performance sharply drops regardless of model scale, language, or prompting strategy.
A method for cross-lingual spatial reasoning evaluation covering 8 typologically diverse languages using structured-text control for isolating language-specific effects.
Identification that text-only working memory constraints, rather than architecture-specific limitations, are the fundamental bottleneck for spatial reasoning from pure text.
idea_ch: 一种多语言空间推理诊断基准，具有层级能力分级体系(L0-L5)，可系统评估LLM从纯文本描述中构建内部世界模型的能力
四轴诊断框架（参考框架、阅读方向偏差、推理努力分配、幻觉），用于分析语言模型在空间推理中的失败模式
发现通用的L3推理断崖现象：所有模型在视角推理任务上性能急剧下降，不受模型规模、语言类型或提示策略影响
跨语言空间推理评估方法，覆盖8种类型多样的语言，并引入结构化文本对照以隔离语言特异性影响
纯文本工作记忆限制（而非LLM架构特有局限性）是纯文本空间推理的根本瓶颈这一发现

title: ResearchLoop: An Evidence-Gated Control Plane for AI-Assisted Research
summary: AI-assisted research compresses ideation, implementation, evaluation, and manuscript writing into a single interactive loop. This compression is useful, but it also creates a publication risk: paper claims can become easier to state than to audit. We present ResearchLoop, an evidence-gated control plane for AI-assisted computational research. ResearchLoop treats research questions, task contracts, evidence objects, claim ledgers, closeouts, and paper bindings as durable project state, realized here as a repository-backed runtime. This technical report provides the complete protocol specification, state model, transition rules, claim-admission algorithm, and insight-compounding mechanism. It also reports the full experimental record spanning nine versions (V0--V9), including a self-hosting case study, a controlled task-suite study with component ablations, a mathematical olympiad evaluation, and a supplementary SciCode boundary experiment evaluated with the official generated-code harness. All artifacts, manifests, and verification reports are preserved in the project repository.

AI.tldr: ResearchLoop是一个证据驱动的控制平台，用于AI辅助计算研究，通过可审计的证据门控机制防止论文声明无法验证的风险。
AI.motivation: AI辅助研究压缩了研究流程，使论文声明容易提出但难以审计验证，存在出版风险。
AI.method: 提出ResearchLoop，一个证据门控控制面，将研究问题、任务合约、证据对象、声明分类账、结项和论文绑定作为持久化项目状态，实现为仓库支持运行时。包含完整协议规范、状态模型、转换规则、声明准入算法和洞察复合机制。
AI.result: 报告了九个版本（V0-V9）的实验记录，包括自托管案例研究、控制任务套件研究（含组件消融）、数学奥林匹克评估以及SciCode边界实验。
AI.conclusion: ResearchLoop通过证据门控机制确保AI辅助研究的可审计性和可验证性，所有工件、清单和验证报告均保存在项目仓库中。
idea_en: Evidence-gated control plane for AI-assisted research that enforces auditability of paper claims through a state-machine model
Repository-backed runtime system with durable project state including claim ledgers and evidence objects
Claim-admission algorithm that gates publication claims based on verifiable evidence
Insight-compounding mechanism that accumulates verified findings across research iterations
Task contract-based decomposition of research questions into auditable units with evidence objects
idea_ch: 基于证据门控的AI辅助研究控制面，通过状态机模型强制论文声明的可审计性
仓库支持的运行时系统，包含声明分类账和证据对象等持久化项目状态

跨研究迭代累积已验证发现的知识洞察复合机制
基于任务合约将研究问题分解为可审计单元（含证据对象）的分解方法

title: Where Rollouts Begin: Low-Load, High-Leverage First-Token Diversification for RLVR
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) trains reasoning models without labeled trajectories, relying on grouped rollouts to expose the policy to alternative reasoning paths and a verifier to score them. Rollout diversity has accordingly emerged as a central bottleneck in RLVR, with most existing methods broadening exploration through temperature, prefix, or rollout-selection adjustments. We identify a structurally distinguished but overlooked position for broadening this diversity: the first token after the reasoning marker. The policy's first-token distribution exhibits a sharply peaked yet correctness-decoupled phenomenon, and this first token position can broaden the regions a rollout group covers without altering the correctness signal. We introduce REFT (Rollout Exploration with First-Token Diversification), a light addition to the RLVR pipeline that samples first tokens uniformly from the policy's own top-$N$ candidates and allocates rollouts evenly, leaving every other component unchanged. Trained on the resulting diversified rollouts, REFT improves aggregate Pass@1, Pass@8, and Pass@64 over DAPO and GRPO baselines across four base models (0.5B-7B) and three difficulty regimes.

title: REED: Post-Training Representation Editing for Cross-Domain Linguistic Steganalysis
summary: In real-world scenarios of linguistic steganalysis, tested texts usually come from unseen domains with different vocabularies, topics, writing styles, and steganographic generation patterns, which can significantly degrade the detection performance. Although existing cross-domain steganalysis methods can effectively alleviate this problem through distribution alignment, domain-invariant feature learning, etc., the detection performance is not satisfactory. In this paper, we propose a post-training representation editing method for cross-domain linguistic steganalysis. Specifically, the detector is first trained on source-domain data, and then the feature extractor and classifier are kept frozen, and the intermediate representations are deterministically edited before classification. For domain adaptation, we construct a domain-offset vector from marginal source and target representations. For domain generalization, we derive a source-domain cover-to-stego direction to guide sample-specific editing. Experimental results show that compared with the advanced methods, the proposed method can achieve high cross-domain detection performance, especially in terms of F1-score, while requiring no architecture modification or parameter updates after source-domain training.

AI.tldr: 提出一种后训练表示编辑方法，通过构造域偏移向量和源域cover-to-stego方向，在不修改架构或更新参数的情况下实现跨域 linguistic steganalysis，显著提升F1分数。
AI.motivation: 实际语言隐写分析中，测试文本常来自未见域，存在词汇、主题、写作风格和隐写生成模式的差异，导致检测性能严重下降。现有跨域方法通过分布对齐、域不变特征学习等效果仍不理想。
AI.method: 提出后训练表示编辑方法：先在源域数据上训练检测器，然后冻结特征提取器和分类器，在分类前对中间表示进行确定性编辑。域适应：从边缘源域和目标域表示构造域偏移向量。域泛化：推导源域cover-to-stego方向以指导样本特定编辑。
AI.result: 与先进方法相比，所提方法在无需架构修改或参数更新的情况下，实现了高跨域检测性能，尤其在F1分数上表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 后训练表示编辑方法简单有效，无需架构修改或参数更新即可实现跨域语言隐写分析，为实际部署提供了可行方案。
idea_en: Post-training representation editing method for cross-domain linguistic steganalysis that keeps feature extractor and classifier frozen while deterministically editing intermediate representations before classification.
Domain-offset vector construction from marginal source and target representations for domain adaptation in linguistic steganalysis.
Source-domain cover-to-stego direction derivation for sample-specific editing to achieve domain generalization in steganalysis.
Zero-architecture-modification and zero-parameter-update cross-domain steganalysis method that works after source-domain training only.
idea_ch: 一种后训练表示编辑方法，冻结特征提取器和分类器，在分类前对中间表示进行确定性编辑，实现跨域语言隐写分析。
从边缘源域和目标域表示构造域偏移向量，用于语言隐写分析的域适应。
推导源域封面到隐写方向指导样本特定编辑，实现隐写分析的域泛化。
零架构修改、零参数更新的跨域隐写分析方法，仅在源域训练后即可部署。

title: Better Accuracies, Worse Reasoning: A Step-Level Audit of Medical Chain-of-Thought Distillation
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) distillation trains a smaller model to imitate a teacher's reasoning trace, but it is typically evaluated by final-answer metrics including accuracy. We ask whether gains in answer quality are accompanied by improvements in the trace. In medical QA, where short answer options can leave a richer clinical justification under-specified, a Qwen3-8B student distilled from a DeepSeek-V3-family teacher improves on MedQA-USMLE answer metrics (SC@64 74.7% to 84.4%; expected calibration error (ECE) 0.096 to 0.034). Yet under a Kimi-K2.6 style-blind LLM-judge audit, its error rate over non-abstained steps rises from 30.6% to 50.3%. In this primary medical setting, answer quality and trace factuality move in opposite directions. This before--after pattern persists across evaluators, teacher strengths, student scales and families, medical benchmarks, and style, segmentation, and answer-correctness controls. A 150-step blinded audit by a clinical expert reproduces the same ordering. Boundary checks narrow the scope of the claim: the risk appears when a compact answer under-constrains the rationale and a capable student can imitate expert-like form without reliably grounding each local claim. Standard answer metrics and aggregate hedging rates do not reveal the shift. When such traces are released or reused, answer-level metrics alone are insufficient.

AI.tldr: 本文发现在医疗QA场景中，思维链蒸馏虽然提升了学生模型的答案准确率，但推理轨迹的事实正确性反而显著下降，答案质量与轨迹事实性呈现反向关系。
AI.motivation: 现有CoT蒸馏评估仅关注最终答案指标（如准确率），忽视了推理轨迹本身的事实正确性，在医疗等需要临床论证的高风险场景中，虚假的推理轨迹可能带来严重风险。
AI.method: 以Qwen3-8B为学生模型、DeepSeek-V3为教师模型进行CoT蒸馏，在MedQA-USMLE数据集上评估答案指标（准确率、校准误差），同时使用Kimi-K2.6风格盲审LLM法官和临床专家对推理轨迹进行事实性审核。
AI.result: 蒸馏后学生模型答案准确率从74.7%提升至84.4%，校准误差从0.096降至0.034；但推理轨迹错误率从30.6%上升至50.3%。经控制实验、边界检验和150步临床专家盲审验证该趋势稳定成立。
AI.conclusion: 当答案选项紧凑而无法充分约束推理过程时，学生模型可能模仿专家式表达形式但未可靠支撑每一步局部陈述，导致答案质量与轨迹事实性背离，仅靠答案级指标评估CoT蒸馏是不充分的。
idea_en: A method for evaluating chain-of-thought distillation quality that jointly assesses final answer accuracy and reasoning trace factuality using a blind LLM judge.
A system for detecting factual degradation in distilled reasoning traces where answer metrics improve but trace correctness declines, enabling early warning in high-stakes domains.

A dual-metric evaluation framework for CoT distillation that separates answer-level performance from trace-level factual reliability, applicable to medical QA and other safety-critical NLP applications.

A technique for auditing chain-of-thought reasoning traces by segmenting each step and independently verifying factual claims against a knowledge base, providing granular trace quality assessment beyond aggregated metrics.

A method for constraining CoT distillation to preserve trace factuality by incorporating per-step grounding verification during the distillation process, preventing the imitation of expert-like form without factual substance.
idea_ch: 一种评估思维链蒸馏质量的联合评估方法，同时评估最终答案准确性和推理轨迹事实正确性，使用盲审LLM法官进行审核。
一种检测蒸馏推理轨迹事实退化的系统，当答案指标改善但轨迹正确性下降时发出预警，适用于高风险领域。
一种CoT蒸馏的双指标评估框架，将答案级性能与轨迹级事实可靠性分离评估，适用于医疗QA等安全关键型NLP应用。
一种通过分段分割推理轨迹并独立验证每一步事实主张与知识库一致性的审计技术，提供超越聚合指标的细粒度轨迹质量评估。
一种在蒸馏过程中引入逐步基础验证以保持轨迹事实性的约束方法，防止学生模型模仿专家表达形式但缺乏事实内容的情况。

title: From Fact Overwriting to Knowledge Evolution: Causal Editing via On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: While Knowledge Editing (KE) enables efficient updates, its dominant Static Fact Overwriting paradigm treats LLMs as discrete databases, forcibly injecting isolated facts. Fracturing pre-trained logical topologies, this triggers Epistemic Dissonance -- a pathology where un-evolved legacy priors force the model to explicitly negate the injected update. Idealized interventions reveal that this is an inherent structural flaw rather than mere algorithmic noise, with a zero-distortion proxy yielding a catastrophic 95.6% self-refutation rate. Given the causally driven nature of real-world knowledge, grounding updates in explicit causal narratives effectively collapses this conflict rate to just 6.6%, underscoring the imperative for a paradigm shift toward Causal Editing. To internalize this evolution, we propose CODE (Causal On-policy Distillation for Editing). By coupling causal bootstrapping with asymmetric on-policy distillation, CODE engraves causal transition logic directly into parametric memory. Experiments on LLaMA-3.1 and Qwen-2.5 show CODE drastically suppresses self-refutation to 1.8% while securing robust multi-hop accuracy (up to 83.5%), seamlessly transforming discrete fact injection into coherent knowledge evolution. Code is available at https://github.com/CrashBugger/CODE.

AI.tldr: 论文指出传统知识编辑（静态事实覆盖）会导致LLM产生“认知失调”（自反驳率高达95.6%），提出了一种因果编辑范式CODE（因果在线策略蒸馏），通过将更新嵌入因果叙事结构，将自反驳率降至1.8%，同时保持多跳推理准确率83.5%。
AI.motivation: 传统知识编辑采用静态事实覆盖范式，将LLM视为离散数据库强行注入孤立事实，破坏了预训练的逻辑拓扑结构，导致模型产生“认知失调”——旧有先验知识使模型明确否定新注入的更新。需要一种新的编辑范式来解决这一结构性缺陷。
AI.method: 提出CODE（Causal On-policy Distillation for Editing）方法，核心包括：(1) 因果引导的更新——将知识更新嵌入显式因果叙事中；(2) 因果自举（causal bootstrapping）——构建因果推理链；(3) 非对称在线策略蒸馏（asymmetric on-policy distillation）——将因果转换逻辑直接刻入参数化记忆。
AI.result: 在LLaMA-3.1和Qwen-2.5上的实验显示：CODE将自反驳率从95.6%降至1.8%，多跳推理准确率达到83.5%，实现了从离散事实注入到连贯知识演化的转化。
AI.conclusion: 真实世界知识具有因果驱动特性，将更新基于显式因果叙事可有效解决知识编辑中的认知失调问题，未来应转向因果编辑范式。
idea_en: A method for knowledge editing in LLMs that converts discrete fact injections into causal narrative structures, reducing model self-refutation by embedding updates within explicit causal chains.
A causal bootstrapping technique that generates causal reasoning paths for knowledge updates, ensuring logical coherence between new and pre-existing knowledge.
An asymmetric on-policy distillation mechanism that engraves causal transition logic directly into parametric memory of LLMs.
A system for detecting and quantifying Epistemic Dissonance in LLMs after knowledge editing, measured via self-refutation rate.
A zero-distortion proxy intervention method to identify structural flaws in knowledge editing apart from algorithmic noise.
idea_ch: 一种将LLM知识编辑从离散事实注入转变为因果叙事结构嵌入的方法，通过将更新置于显式因果链中，显著降低模型自反驳率。
一种因果自举技术，为知识更新生成因果推理路径，确保新知识与预存知识之间的逻辑一致性。
一种非对称在线策略蒸馏机制，将因果转换逻辑直接刻入LLM的参数化记忆中。
一种检测和量化LLM知识编辑后认知失调程度的系统，以自反驳率为测量指标。
一种零失真代理干预方法，用于识别知识编辑中独立于算法噪声之外的结构性缺陷。

title: An Enhanced Large Neighborhood Search Approach for the Capacitated Facility Location Problem with Incompatible Customers
summary: A new variant of the classic capacitated facility location problem, which considers incompatibilities between customers, has recently been introduced in the literature. This problem captures the situation where given pairs of customers cannot be served by the same facility.
