Such a feature is crucial for many practical cases of location problems, such as the presence of hazardous or polluting materials and contention between competing costumers. In this paper, we propose a Large Neighborhood Search (LNS) method to solve this problem. Within the framework of LNS, we introduce three different destroy operators, which are combined in a hybrid manner, and we use an exact solver in the repair phase. Different algorithmic components are investigated for the design of LNS. The experimental analysis shows that our new method outperforms existing state-of-the-art metaheuristics, providing new best solutions for all available benchmark instances.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种大规模邻域搜索（LNS）方法，用于解决考虑客户间不兼容性的有容量限制的设施选址问题，该算法在基准实例上全面超越了现有最优元启发式方法。
AI.motivation: 经典的有容量限制的设施选址问题忽略了客户之间的不兼容性（如危险品、污染材料、竞争关系等），而实际场景中这种不兼容性普遍存在。现有方法在处理该问题时性能有限。
AI.method: 提出一种大规模邻域搜索方法，包含三个不同破坏算子并混合使用，修复阶段采用精确求解器。研究了不同的算法组件设计。
AI.result: 在所有可用基准实例上，该方法全面超越了现有最优元启发式方法，提供了新的最优解。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的LNS方法是解决带客户不兼容性的有容量限制设施选址问题的有效方法，具有显著的性能优势。
idea_en: A hybrid Large Neighborhood Search method for capacitated facility location with customer incompatibilities, combining multiple destroy operators with an exact repair solver.
A system of multiple heterogeneous destroy operators that are combined in a hybrid manner within LNS framework for facility location optimization.
An LNS-based approach for facility location problems that enforces pairwise customer incompatibility constraints, using exact solver for the repair phase.
A method for solving facility location problems with hazardous material constraints by integrating customer incompatibility rules into the LNS optimization framework.
idea_ch: 一种混合大规模邻域搜索方法，用于处理带客户不兼容性约束的有容量限制设施选址问题，该方法结合多个破坏算子与精确修复求解器。
一种在大规模邻域搜索框架内以混合方式组合多个异构破坏算子的系统，用于设施选址优化。
一种基于LNS的设施选址方法，强制执行成对客户不兼容性约束，并在修复阶段使用精确求解器。
一种通过将客户不兼容规则集成到LNS优化框架中，处理带有危险物料约束的设施选址问题的方法。

title: SafeMed-R1: Clinician-Audited Safety and Ethics Alignment for Medical Large Language Models
summary: Large language models(LLMs) increasingly match expert performance on licensing examinations, yet routine clinical use remains limited because governance requires auditable reasoning, safety and ethics alignment, and resilience to adversarial misuse. Here we present SafeMed-R1, trained with a traceable Clinical Trust Signals(CTS) pipeline that links each reasoning instance to clinician rubric scores and edit histories, and aligned through safety and ethics supervision and red team stress testing. SafeMed-R1 attains a macro-averaged accuracy of 79.6% across clinical benchmarks. Under adversarial safety testing, it shows the lowest aggregated risk and reduces unsafe outputs by about 3 to 5% relative to its baseline. In a paired expert study of 30 medication safety vignettes, SafeMed-R1 matches PGY1 and PGY2 residents on medical correctness and scores higher for medication safety, guideline consistency, and clinical usefulness. Collectively, these results suggest that clinician-audited supervision provenance, together with domain-tailored safety and ethics alignment, can strengthen governance-relevant evidence without relying on inference-time retrieval or citation grounding.

AI.tldr: SafeMed-R1是一个通过可追溯的临床信任信号管道训练的大语言模型，结合安全与伦理对齐及红队压力测试，在临床基准测试中达到79.6%的宏观平均准确率，减少3-5%的不安全输出，并在用药安全场景中与PGY1/PGY2住院医师水平相当甚至更优。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在执业考试中表现日益接近专家水平，但由于治理要求可审计推理、安全与伦理对齐以及对抗性滥用的韧性，常规临床使用仍然受限。
AI.method: 采用Clinical Trust Signals (CTS)管道，将每次推理实例与临床医生评分和编辑历史关联；通过安全与伦理监督及红队压力测试进行对齐训练。
AI.result: 临床基准测试宏观平均准确率79.6%；对抗性安全测试中风险最低，不安全输出减少约3-5%；在30个用药安全场景中，医学正确性与PGY1/PGY2住院医师相当，在用药安全、指南一致性和临床实用性方面得分更高。
AI.conclusion: 临床医生审计的监督溯源，结合领域定制的安全与伦理对齐，可以在不依赖推理时检索或引用依据的情况下增强治理相关证据。
idea_en: Clinical Trust Signals (CTS) pipeline: a training method that links each reasoning instance of an LLM to clinician rubric scores and edit histories, creating traceable audit trails for clinical AI governance.
Safety and ethics supervised alignment combined with red team stress testing specifically tailored for the medical domain to reduce unsafe outputs by 3-5% without retrieval augmentation.

A governance-relevant training framework that enables auditable reasoning in LLMs for clinical use, achieving expert-level medication safety performance without requiring inference-time citation grounding.
idea_ch: 临床信任信号(CTS)管道：一种将大语言模型的每个推理实例与临床医生评分和编辑历史关联的训练方法，为临床AI治理创建可追溯的审计轨迹。
结合红队压力测试的医疗领域安全与伦理监督对齐方法，在不依赖检索增强的情况下将不安全输出减少3-5%。
一种面向临床使用的LLM可审计推理治理训练框架，无需推理时引用依据即可达到专家级用药安全性能。

title: Picid: A Modular Evaluation Infrastructure for Reproducible PHM Across Tasks and Domains
summary: Progress in Prognostics and Health Management (PHM) is hindered by the lack of standardized and reusable evaluation practices across tasks, datasets, and application domains. Reported results are often difficult to reproduce and compare, as key protocol choices, such as data splits, preprocessing, label alignment, temporal windowing, and metrics, are often implicit or implemented ad hoc. We introduce \picid, a modular evaluation infrastructure that formalizes the PHM evaluation pipeline as an explicit, executable, and reproducible protocol. Through well-defined abstractions, \picid enforces deterministic, leakage-safe dataset construction while remaining flexible across diverse PHM settings. The framework supports fault detection, diagnostics, and prognostics through a unified interface and can be extended to new datasets and model classes without violating protocol invariants. By standardizing data contracts and evaluation boundaries, \picid also enables fair cross-task comparisons across diagnostics (classification) and prognostics (regression), allowing identical model families to be evaluated consistently across heterogeneous settings. We demonstrate \picid through an empirical evaluation of thirteen models on twelve datasets spanning batteries, bearings, turbofan engines, hydraulics, filtration systems, and buildings. This work establishes a reusable foundation for standardized, fair and reproducible evaluation in PHM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PICID，一个模块化的评估基础设施，通过标准化、可执行和可复现的协议形式化PHM评估流程，支持跨任务、跨数据集和跨领域的公平比较，并在12个数据集上对13个模型进行了实证评估。
AI.motivation: PHM领域缺乏标准化和可复用的评估实践，关键协议选择（如数据分割、预处理、标签对齐、时间窗口和评估指标）常常隐式或临时实现，导致结果难以复现和比较。
AI.method: 提出PICID模块化评估基础设施，形式化PHM评估流程为显式、可执行、可复现的协议，通过良好定义的抽象强制确定性和无泄漏的数据集构建，同时保持灵活性，支持故障检测、诊断和预测的统一接口，可扩展至新数据集和模型类。
AI.result: 在12个数据集（涵盖电池、轴承、涡扇发动机、液压、过滤系统和建筑）上对13个模型进行了实证评估，证明了框架的有效性和通用性。
AI.conclusion: PICID为PHM领域建立了可复用的标准化、公平和可复现评估基础。
idea_en: A modular evaluation infrastructure that formalizes the PHM evaluation pipeline as an explicit, executable, and reproducible protocol with well-defined abstractions.
A deterministic, leakage-safe dataset construction mechanism that prevents data leakage across training, validation, and test sets in temporal PHM data.
A unified interface for fault detection, diagnostics, and prognostics tasks within a single evaluation framework.
A data contract and evaluation boundary standardization that enables fair cross-task comparisons between classification-based diagnostics and regression-based prognostics.
An extensible architecture supporting new datasets and model classes without violating protocol invariants.
idea_ch: 一种模块化评估基础设施，将PHM评估流程形式化为显式、可执行和可复现的协议，并具有良好定义的抽象层。
一种确定性的、无泄漏的数据集构建机制，可在时间序列PHM数据中防止训练集、验证集和测试集之间的数据泄漏。
统一的接口框架，在同一评估体系内同时支持故障检测、诊断和预测任务。
数据合约与评估边界标准化方法，能够实现基于分类的诊断任务和基于回归的预测任务之间的公平跨任务比较。
可扩展的架构设计，能够在违反协议不变量的情况下支持新数据集和新模型类的添加。

title: FedMPT: Federated Multi-label Prompt Tuning of Vision-Language Models
comment: 16 pages, including 11 pages of main text and 5 pages of appendix; Accepted by CVPR2026
summary: Multi-Label Recognition (MLR) based on Vision-Language Models (VLMs) aims to leverage their pre-trained knowledge to better adapt complex recognition scenarios, thereby enhancing model robustness. However, for realistic decentralized applications requiring federated learning, adapting VLMs to each client that possesses private and heterogeneous data can cause the model to overfit spurious label correlations, consequently triggering irrelevant categories when encountering new samples. To tackle this problem, we reconsider the federated learning for MLR with a causal model, in which we adopt a front-door adjustment and decouple the MLR modeling process by intermediate variables that magnify the oracle label co-occurrence. Guided by our analysis, we propose our FedMPT, the first method specifically designed for federated MLR. The core idea of FedMPT is to leverage generalizable conditions to steer federated MLR to mitigate erroneous label activations. To achieve this, FedMPT introduces an Large Language Model (LLM)-driven pipeline to decipher the underlying conditions that govern label dependencies. Furthermore, we introduce an optimal transport between the condition-enriched prompts and the image patches to uncover multiple region-level semantics. Finally, we generate synergistic predictions from different conditions with a crafted gating mechanism. Experiments on multiple benchmark datasets show that our proposed approach achieves competitive results and outperforms SOTA methods under varied settings.

AI.tldr: 提出FedMPT，首个专门用于联邦多标签识别的视觉-语言模型方法，通过因果干预（前门调整）和LLM驱动的条件解耦，解决联邦学习中标签虚假相关导致的误激活问题。
AI.motivation: 在联邦学习场景下，基于视觉-语言模型的多标签识别容易因客户端私有异构数据而过度拟合虚假标签相关性，导致新样本触发不相关类别。需要一种方法在保护隐私的同时消除误导性标签关联。
AI.method: 1) 采用前门调整的因果模型，通过中间变量（标签共现）解耦MLR建模过程；2) 引入LLM驱动的pipeline解析控制标签依赖的潜在条件；3) 通过条件增强提示与图像块之间的最优传输发现多区域语义；4) 设计门控机制生成不同条件的协同预测。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上，FedMPT在各种设置下均达到竞争性结果，超越现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: FedMPT有效解决了联邦多标签识别中的标签虚假相关和误激活问题，证明了因果干预和LLM驱动条件解耦在联邦VLM场景中的有效性。
idea_en: A federated multi-label recognition method using front-door causal adjustment to decouple label co-occurrence from spurious correlations via intermediate variables in a decentralized VLM setting.
An LLM-driven pipeline for deciphering underlying conditions that govern label dependencies, generating condition-enriched prompts to guide federated multi-label recognition.
An optimal transport mechanism between condition-enriched prompts and image patches to discover region-level semantics for multi-label recognition.
A gating mechanism that generates synergistic predictions by combining outputs from different label-condition conditions in federated learning.
idea_ch: 一种基于前门因果调整的联邦多标签识别方法，通过中间变量解耦标签共现与虚假相关性，在去中心化VLM场景中消除误导性标签激活。
一种LLM驱动的pipeline，用于解析控制标签依赖的潜在条件，生成条件增强提示以引导联邦多标签识别过程。
一种条件增强提示与图像块之间的最优传输机制，用于发现多区域级语义特征以增强多标签识别精度。
一种门控机制，在联邦学习中组合不同标签条件输出的协同预测结果，提升多标签识别的鲁棒性。

title: Plan Before Search: Search Agents Need Plan
summary: Training large language models as retrieval-augmented reasoning agents typically combines reinforcement learning with an SFT cold start distilled from a stronger model. However, this paradigm overlooks two fundamental factors: the dependency structure among sub-skills, and the possibility that distillation is not the only route to capability acquisition. We study this through Plan, a structured agentic behavior for multi-hop retrieval that decomposes a question into ordered sub-questions before any retrieval is performed, so that each search step can be anchored to a pre-designed sub-question instead of drifting under the influence of partially relevant documents retrieved earlier. However, across three model families spanning 3B to 14B parameters, we find that an identical reward signal induces qualitatively different RL failure modes. This phenomenon indicates that successful training hinges not only on reward design but also on model-specific feasibility conditions: sufficient initial entropy, training stability, and prerequisite sub-skills. Motivated by this, we propose a self-bootstrapping paradigm in which a small-scale seed model generates filtered trajectories that activate Plan in any target model, eliminating the need for distillation from an external stronger model. Our pipeline activates Plan across every tested model and consistently outperforms competitive baselines on multi-hop QA benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种自举范式（self-bootstrapping），无需从强模型蒸馏，通过种子模型生成过滤轨迹来激活任意目标模型的多跳检索规划能力（Plan），实验证明该方法在多个模型族上优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有检索增强推理智能体（如多跳检索）的训练通常依赖强化学习结合从强模型蒸馏的SFT冷启动，但忽视了子技能间的依赖结构以及蒸馏并非能力获取的唯一路径。本文旨在解决这些问题，探索更高效的能力激活方法。
AI.method: 提出Plan，一种结构化的智能体行为：在检索之前将问题分解为有序子问题，使每个搜索步骤锚定于预设计的子问题，避免被先前检索的部分相关文档带偏。进一步提出自举范式：用小规模种子模型生成过滤后的高质量轨迹，直接激活目标模型的Plan能力，无需外部强模型蒸馏。
AI.result: 在3B到14B参数量的三个模型族上，相同的奖励信号导致不同的RL失败模式，表明训练成功依赖模型特定的可行性条件（初始熵、训练稳定性、先决子技能）。自举范式成功激活了所有测试模型的Plan能力，并在多跳QA基准上持续优于竞争基线。
AI.conclusion: 强化学习训练效果不仅取决于奖励设计，还取决于模型自身的可行性条件。所提出的自我自举范式是一种无需外部强模型蒸馏即可激活结构化推理能力的有效方法。
idea_en: A structured agentic behavior for multi-hop retrieval that decomposes a question into ordered sub-questions before any retrieval, ensuring each search step is anchored to a pre-designed sub-question.

A self-bootstrapping paradigm where a small-scale seed model generates filtered trajectories to activate the structured retrieval-planning capability in any target model without distillation from an external stronger model.

A method to identify and address model-specific RL failure modes caused by insufficient initial entropy, training instability, and lack of prerequisite sub-skills, rather than purely relying on reward design.
idea_ch: 一种结构化多跳检索智能体行为方法：在检索执行之前将问题分解为有序子问题，确保每个搜索步骤锚定于预先设计的子问题，避免被部分相关文档干扰。
一种自举训练范式：利用小规模种子模型生成并过滤高质量轨迹，直接激活任意目标模型的结构化检索规划能力，无需从外部更强模型进行知识蒸馏。
一种模型特定强化学习失败模式的诊断与应对方法：识别并解决因初始熵不足、训练不稳定、先决子技能缺失导致的训练失败，而非仅依赖奖励信号设计。

title: From Knowing to Doing: A Memory-Controlled Benchmark for LLM Trading Agents on Stock Markets
summary:
Evaluating whether large language model (LLM) agents can profit in capital markets is increasingly framed as end-to-end trading: place an agent in a historical market, let it trade, and measure portfolio returns. This setup is vulnerable to two evaluation failures. First, long backtests often overlap with the knowledge cutoffs of frontier LLMs, allowing memorized tickers, dates, prices, and market narratives to substitute for investment reasoning. Second, raw returns are a noisy proxy for stock-selection ability, since positive performance may come from market beta, style exposure, or favorable regimes rather than genuine alpha.
  We introduce KTD-Fin (Knowing-To-Doing Financial Benchmark), an end-to-end stock-market trading benchmark that addresses both issues. KTD-Fin uses a data-side masking protocol to anonymize key identifiers and calendar information consistently across prompts and tools, separating historical market memory from investment decision-making. It also incorporates a Barra-style performance attribution framework that decomposes portfolio returns into market, style, and stock-selection alpha components.
  Across ten frontier LLM agents evaluated on the Chinese CSI300 over a 2024--2026 window, masking substantially changes agent rationales, pushing them towards anonymized factor-based reasoning. Attribution analysis further shows that LLM agents' cumulative returns under leakage-controlled evaluation are largely explained by passive market and style exposure, with limited evidence of persistent stock-selection alpha. These findings suggest that financial LLM benchmarks should evaluate not only whether an agent makes money, but also whether the source of returns reflects transferable investment skill. We release KTD-Fin as a reproducible template for leakage-controlled and attribution-aware evaluation of LLM trading agents.

AI.tldr: KTD-Fin是一个端到端股市交易基准，通过数据脱敏协议和Barra风格归因框架，解决LLM交易智能体评估中的记忆泄露和回报归因问题。实验发现，在控制泄露后，LLM智能体的收益主要来自市场和风格暴露，而非选股Alpha。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM交易智能体的端到端评估存在两个严重缺陷：1）长时间回溯测试与LLM知识截止日期重叠，模型可能记忆了历史行情数据而非进行投资推理；2）原始收益率是选股能力的噪音代理指标，正向收益可能来自市场贝塔、风格暴露或有利市场环境，而非真正的Alpha。
AI.method: 1）数据侧脱敏协议：对关键标识符（股票代码、日期、价格、市场叙事）进行匿名化处理，在提示词和工具调用中一致性地屏蔽；2）Barra风格归因框架：将组合收益分解为市场因子、风格因子和选股Alpha三个成分。
AI.result: 在2024-2026年CSI300区间上对10个前沿LLM智能体进行评估，脱敏处理显著改变了智能体的推理逻辑，使其转向基于匿名因子的推理。归因分析表明，在泄露控制评估下，LLM智能体的累计收益主要由被动的市场和风格暴露解释，缺乏持续选股Alpha的证据。
AI.conclusion: 金融LLM基准不仅要评估智能体是否赚钱，还要评估收益来源是否反映可迁移的投资技能。KTD-Fin可作为泄露控制和归因感知评估的可复现模板。
idea_en: A data-side masking protocol for financial LLM evaluation that anonymizes ticker symbols, dates, prices, and market narratives consistently across prompts and tool calls to prevent historical data memorization from substituting for investment reasoning.

A Barra-style performance attribution framework integrated into LLM trading agent evaluation, decomposing portfolio returns into market beta, style exposure, and stock-selection alpha components to distinguish genuine stock-picking skill from passive factor returns.

A leakage-controlled end-to-end trading benchmark (KTD-Fin) that combines identifier anonymization with factor-based return decomposition for reproducible evaluation of LLM trading agents on Chinese CSI300 market.
idea_ch: 一种面向金融LLM评估的数据侧脱敏协议，在提示词和工具调用中一致性地匿名化股票代码、日期、价格和市场叙事，防止历史数据记忆替代投资推理过程。
一种集成到LLM交易智能体评估中的Barra风格归因框架，将投资组合收益分解为市场贝塔、风格暴露和选股Alpha成分，以区分真正的选股能力与被动因子收益。
一种结合标识符匿名化和因子收益分解的泄露控制端到端交易基准KTD-Fin，用于对沪深300市场上LLM交易智能体进行可复现评估。

title: Prompt Codebooks: Discrete Compositional Optimization for Language Model Instruction Refinement
summary: Automatic prompt optimization (APO) has driven significant gains in LLM-based agentic workflows. However, existing methods treat each task's prompt as a monolithic, instance-blind string optimized through global edits, producing brittle updates and preventing the reuse of learned sub-behaviors. We propose Prompt Codebooks (PCO), a novel compositional prompt optimization framework that recasts APO as discrete learning over a finite vocabulary of natural-language instincts - atomic, reusable instruction units. PCO organizes prompt-construction knowledge in a discrete codebook and routes each input to a small subset of entries via an LLM-based encoder; a generator composes them into a prompt for the frozen target model; a critic emits a structured verdict that decomposes by attribution into per-variable textual gradients, jointly training the encoder, generator, and codebook under a language-valued min-max objective. The resulting routing is per-instance: different inputs in the same task receive different instinct compositions, a regime structurally inexpressible under instance-blind methods. Across six benchmarks on Qwen3-8B and LLaMA-3.1-8B, PCO improves over zero-shot by up to +30.36 points, surpasses the strongest prior baseline (GEPA) by +3.34 on HotpotQA and +1.11 in aggregate, and reduces deployed prompt length by up to 14.1x versus MIPROv2 and 3.0x versus GEPA using only K=16 instincts.

AI.tldr: 提出Prompt Codebooks (PCO)，一种组合式提示优化框架，将自动提示优化重构为在有限自然语言"本能"词汇表上的离散学习，通过码本路由实现每个实例定制化的提示组合，性能优于现有基线且显著缩短提示长度。
AI.motivation: 现有自动提示优化方法将每个任务的提示视为单一的、实例无关的字符串，通过全局编辑进行优化，导致更新脆弱且无法复用已学习的子行为。
AI.method: PCO包含三个核心组件：1) 离散码本存储原子级可复用的自然语言指令单元（直觉）；2) LLM编码器将每个输入路由到码本中的少量条目；3) 生成器将这些条目组合成提示。通过批评器提供结构化裁决，分解为逐变量文本梯度，在语言值极小极大目标下联合训练编码器、生成器和码本。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-8B和LLaMA-3.1-8B上6个基准测试中，相较于零样本提升最高达+30.36分，在HotpotQA上超越最强基线GEPA达+3.34，综合提升+1.11，使用仅K=16个本能即可将提示长度相比MIPROv2减少14.1倍，相比GEPA减少3.0倍。
AI.conclusion: PCO通过离散码本机制实现了实例级别的自适应提示组合，在性能、效率和可解释性上均优于现有方法，为自动提示优化提供了全新的范式。
idea_en: A compositional prompt optimization framework using a discrete codebook of atomic natural-language instruction units (instincts), where each input is routed to a subset of entries via an LLM-based encoder and composed into a prompt by a generator.

A per-instance prompt routing mechanism where different inputs within the same task receive different instinct compositions, enabling instance-level adaptation inexpressible in monolithic prompt methods.
A structured critic that emits a decomposed verdict with per-variable textual gradients, enabling joint training of encoder, generator, and codebook under a language-valued min-max objective.
A discrete learning approach for prompt optimization over a finite vocabulary of reusable natural-language instincts, as opposed to continuous or monolithic optimization.
A codebook-based prompt compression method achieving 14.1x reduction in deployed prompt length versus MIPROv2 using only K=16 instinct entries.
idea_ch: 基于离散码本的组合式提示优化框架：将原子级自然语言指令单元（本能）存储在码本中，通过LLM编码器将每个输入路由到少量条目，再由生成器组合成提示。
实例级提示路由机制：同一任务中不同输入接收不同的本能组合，实现单体式提示方法无法表达的实例级自适应。
结构化批评器与文本梯度：批评器提供分解为逐变量文本梯度的结构化裁决，在语言值极小极大目标下联合训练编码器、生成器和码本。
离散学习范式：在有限的可复用自然语言本能词汇表上进行提示优化，替代传统的连续或单体式优化方法。
基于码本的提示压缩技术：仅用K=16个本能条目即可实现相比MIPROv2减少14.1倍的部署提示长度。

title: Risk-Controlled Lean-as-Judge for Natural-Language Mathematical Reasoning
summary: Lean is increasingly used to judge natural-language mathematical answers, but its signal is partial: many answers never formalize, and a failed proof may reflect an ill-typed statement or a missing library fact, not a wrong answer. On MATH-500 we show this signal is (i) sharply coverage-dependent, that is the proof-winning answer is correct 96% of the time at high proved coverage but 20% at low, and (ii) sparse and often unfaithful: a 7B autoformalizer proves a class for only 28% of problems, and a manual audit finds only approximately 43% of those proofs faithful. We propose COVCAL, a selector over Lean-trace diagnostics that certifies a finite-sample selective-risk bound on accepted answers or abstains, under two regimes (a conservative Bonferroni bound and a tighter dev-then-cal rule). Feasibility depends on autoformalization coverage: with the 7B formalizer the signal is too sparse and Bonferroni abstains on all 20 bootstrap partitions, whereas a prover-specialized formalizer reaches 79% coverage and flips it to feasible on 17 of 20, accepting approximately 48% of problems at 0.98 accepted accuracy. Since self-consistency alone is already 91% accurate, our contribution is a precise account of when, and with which formalizer, a partial formal signal can be trusted under risk control.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了Lean在评估自然语言数学答案时的信号可靠性问题。提出COVCAL方法，通过Lean追踪诊断进行选择器，在有限样本下对接受答案进行选择性风险控制。实验表明，证明获胜答案在高覆盖率下正确率为96%，低覆盖率下仅20%。使用7B自动形式化器仅覆盖28%问题，而专用形式化器可达79%覆盖率，能接受约48%问题且准确率达0.98。
AI.motivation: Lean在评估自然语言数学答案时，其信号是偏颇且不完整的：许多答案无法形式化，失败的证明可能源于类型错误或知识库缺失，而非答案本身错误。需要一种可控的方法来量化何时可以信任这种部分形式化信号。
AI.method: 提出COVCAL（Coverage-Calibrated Selective Risk Control）方法：基于Lean追踪诊断构建选择器，在两种风险控制机制（保守的Bonferroni边界和更紧的开发-校准规则）下，对接受答案进行有限样本选择性风险控制，允许系统在不确定时选择弃权。
AI.result: 在MATH-500上：(i)证明获胜答案在高覆盖率下96%正确，低覆盖率下仅20%；(ii)7B自动形式化器仅覆盖28%问题，其中仅约43%证明忠实；(iii)COVCAL使用Bonferroni在20个分区中全部弃权，而专用形式化器在17/20分区可行，接受约48%问题，准确率0.98。
AI.conclusion: 自一致性方法本身已达到91%准确率，本文的贡献在于精确刻画了在何种条件下、使用何种形式化器，部分形式化信号可以在风险控制下被信任。
idea_en: COVCAL: A selective risk-controlled acceptance method that uses Lean-trace diagnostics to certify a finite-sample selective-risk bound on accepted mathematical answers, with two regimes: conservative Bonferroni bound and tighter dev-then-cal rule.

Coverage-dependent reliability characterization: A method to quantify the correlation between formalization coverage and answer accuracy, showing proof-winning answers are 96% correct at high coverage vs 20% at low coverage.

Autoformalization coverage analysis as a feasibility criterion for formal verification of natural-language math answers, demonstrating the critical threshold effect where only specialized formalizers (79% coverage) make risk-controlled acceptance feasible.
A dual-formalizer framework combining a general 7B autoformalizer and a prover-specialized formalizer, with selective switching based on coverage requirements for risk-controlled answer acceptance.
idea_ch: COVCAL方法：一种基于选择性风险控制的数学答案接受机制，通过分析Lean追踪诊断信息，在有限样本下对接受答案进行风险边界认证，支持保守的Bonferroni边界和更紧的开发-校准规则两种模式。
覆盖度依赖的可靠性表征方法：量化形式化覆盖度与答案正确率之间的相关性，发现高覆盖度下证明获胜答案正确率达96%，低覆盖度下仅20%的关键差异。
自动形式化覆盖度作为形式验证可行性判据：通过分析不同形式化器的覆盖能力（7B通用型28% vs 专用型79%），建立风险可控接受是否可行的临界阈值判定标准。
双形式化器协同框架：结合通用7B自动形式化器与专用形式化器，根据覆盖度需求选择性切换，在风险可控条件下最大化可接受答案数量。

title: CyberJurors: A Multi-Agent Simulation Task for E-Commerce Disputes Verdict
summary: E-commerce platforms have begun recruiting crowdsourced jurors to adjudicate massive volumes of transaction disputes. Unlike formal legal judgment, E-commerce dispute verdicts require grounding pivotal clues from redundant, multi-round, multimodal evidence and making decisions under flexible platform-specific conventions. These characteristics render existing methods insufficient for this scenario. To bridge this gap, we introduce a pioneering task, E-commerce Dispute Verdicts (EDV), and present VerdictBench, a multimodal benchmark comprising 6,000 real-world cases designed to reflect crowdsourced jury decisions. Building upon this, we propose CyberJurors, a multi-agent framework to clarify the dispute logic and regulate the verdict process. At the individual level, Individual Verdict Chain-of-Thought decomposes the EDV task into four structured reasoning stages, enabling fine-grained clue perception and clarifying causal logic between pivotal clues and the dispute focus. At the collective level, Jury Consensus Verdict simulates multi-round discussion and voting among jurors, while incorporating verdict precedents to mitigate cognitive biases toward either disputant. Experiments on VerdictBench show that CyberJurors outperforms state-of-the-art LLMs, MLLMs, and court simulators, while achieving stronger alignment with real-world jury voting patterns. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/YanhuiS/CyberJurors and https://huggingface.co/datasets/piggi/VerdictBench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了电商争议裁决（EDV）任务及包含6000个真实案例的多模态基准VerdictBench，并设计了多智能体框架CyberJurors，通过个体级推理链和集体级陪审团共识机制，显著提升了电商平台争议裁决的准确性和与真实陪审团投票的一致性。
AI.motivation: 电商平台需要众包陪审员裁决大量交易纠纷，但现有法律判决方法无法适应电商场景中多模态冗余证据、灵活平台规则等特点，存在方法空白。
AI.method: 提出了CyberJurors多智能体框架：个体层面采用Individual Verdict Chain-of-Thought，将裁决分解为四个结构化推理阶段，实现细粒度线索感知和因果逻辑澄清；集体层面采用Jury Consensus Verdict，模拟多轮讨论投票并引入先例裁决以缓解认知偏差。
AI.result: 在VerdictBench上，CyberJurors超越现有LLM、MLLM及法庭模拟器，与真实陪审团投票模式更强对齐。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体框架结合结构化推理链和集体共识机制，能有效处理电商争议裁决复杂场景，提供更接近人类陪审团判断的结果。
idea_en: A multi-agent framework (CyberJurors) for e-commerce dispute verdicts that decomposes the task into structured reasoning stages at individual level and simulates jury discussion/voting at collective level.

Individual Verdict Chain-of-Thought: a staged reasoning process that enables fine-grained clue perception and clarifies causal logic between pivotal clues and dispute focus in multimodal e-commerce evidence.
Jury Consensus Verdict mechanism: multi-round discussion and voting among agents incorporating verdict precedents to mitigate cognitive biases toward either disputant in e-commerce disputes.
VerdictBench: a multimodal benchmark comprising 6,000 real-world e-commerce dispute cases with crowdsourced jury decisions for evaluating dispute verdict systems.
idea_ch: 一种用于电商争议裁决的多智能体框架（CyberJurors），在个体层将裁决任务分解为结构化推理阶段，在集体层模拟陪审团讨论和投票。
个体裁决思维链（Individual Verdict Chain-of-Thought）：将电商争议裁决任务分解为四个结构化推理阶段，实现对多模态证据的细粒度线索感知，并澄清关键线索与争议焦点的因果逻辑。
陪审团共识裁决机制（Jury Consensus Verdict）：多智能体间多轮讨论和投票，引入先例裁决以缓解对任一方当事人的认知偏差。
VerdictBench多模态基准数据集：包含6000个真实电商争议案例及众包陪审团裁决结果，用于评估争议裁决系统的性能。

title: From paper to benchmark: agentic, framework-based reproduction of under-specified methods in machine health intelligence
summary: Industrial Prognostics and Health Management (PHM) provides a representative case study for a broader challenge in applied machine learning: translating published papers into executable, benchmark-ready implementations. Reproducing under-specified methods in PHM is particularly difficult due to restricted access to industrial datasets, incomplete reporting of preprocessing and evaluation protocols, and implicit design choices (e.g., windowing, target construction, data splits) that critically affect performance. Existing paper-to-code systems generate implementations for individual papers, but these artifacts are often not directly comparable due to inconsistencies in assumptions and evaluation settings. We introduce \emph{agentic, framework-based PHM paper reproduction}, where an agent translates a paper into a shared PHM benchmark framework via a \emph{slot-binding interface}. This interface maps equations and protocol descriptions into structured components (task definitions, dataset adapters, windowing, targets, models, and evaluators), while explicitly recording unresolved assumptions. The resulting implementations are validated against standardized task contracts and evaluation hooks, enabling consistent and comparable benchmarking. We evaluate this approach on 16 PHM papers, comparing framework-enhanced, skill-based and prompt-based agentic reproduction against a recent framework-free paper-reproduction agent. We assess reproduction success, model-based code evaluation, framework binding of paper assumptions, and cross-paper benchmark comparability under standardized protocols. Our results show that coupling agentic generation with a shared framework transforms paper reproduction from isolated code synthesis into executable, assumption-aware, and systematically comparable benchmark implementations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于智能体与共享框架的PHM论文复现方法，通过槽绑定接口将论文映射到标准化基准框架，解决了工业健康管理领域因数据受限、报告不完整导致的论文复现和跨论文比较困难的问题。
AI.motivation: 工业PHM领域论文复现面临三大挑战：工业数据集获取受限、预处理和评估协议报告不完整、窗口划分/目标构建/数据分割等隐式设计选择严重影响性能。现有论文到代码系统虽能生成单个实现，但因假设和评估设置不一致而难以直接比较。
AI.method: 提出基于智能体的框架式PHM论文复现方法：1）采用共享PHM基准框架；2）通过槽绑定接口将论文中的方程和协议描述映射到结构化组件（任务定义、数据集适配器、窗口化、目标、模型、评估器）；3）显式记录未解决的假设；4）通过标准化任务合约和评估钩子验证实现。
AI.result: 在16篇PHM论文上评估了框架增强型、基于技能和基于提示的智能体复现方法，与无框架的论文复现智能体对比，结果显示将智能体生成与共享框架结合可转变为可执行、假设感知且可系统比较的基准实现。
AI.conclusion: 智能体生成与共享框架的结合能够将论文复现从孤立的代码合成转变为可执行、假设感知且可系统比较的基准实现，显著提升PHM领域论文的可复现性和跨论文可比性。
idea_en: A slot-binding interface mechanism that maps equations and protocol descriptions from scientific papers into structured benchmark framework components (task definitions, dataset adapters, windowing, targets, models, evaluators)
An explicit assumption recording system that documents unresolved or implicit design choices during paper reproduction to ensure transparency and reproducibility
Standardized task contracts and evaluation hooks for validating reproduced implementations against formal specifications, enabling consistent cross-paper benchmarking

A framework-enhanced agentic reproduction method that couples LLM-based code generation with a shared benchmark framework, transforming isolated code synthesis into comparable benchmark implementations
Cross-paper benchmark comparability protocol that ensures different reproduced implementations share consistent evaluation protocols, data splits, and preprocessing pipelines
idea_ch: 一种槽绑定接口机制，将科学论文中的方程和协议描述映射到结构化基准框架组件（任务定义、数据集适配器、窗口化、目标函数、模型、评估器）
一种显式假设记录系统，在论文复现过程中记录未解决的或隐式的设计选择，确保透明度和可重复性
标准化任务合约和评估钩子，用于根据形式化规范验证复现实现，实现一致的跨论文基准测试
一种框架增强的智能体复现方法，将基于LLM的代码生成与共享基准框架耦合，将孤立的代码合成为可比较的基准实现
跨论文基准可比性协议，确保不同复现实现共享一致的评估协议、数据划分和预处理流水线

title: Mechanistically Interpreting the Role of Sample Difficulty in RLVR for LLMs
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Reward (RLVR) is empirically shown to notably enhance the reasoning performance of large language models (LLMs), particularly in mathematics and programming. However, the mechanistic role of Sample Difficulty in RLVR remains poorly understood. In this paper, we investigate RLVR through the lens of difficulty-wise and one-sample analysis. We find that sample difficulty has a non-monotonic effect on RLVR: easy and medium-difficulty problems yield the strongest and most stable reasoning improvements, whereas overly hard problems often provide weak learning signals, induce degenerate behaviors such as answer repetition or skipping necessary computation, and can ultimately degrade the model's pre-existing capabilities. Beyond the obverse of response, we further analyze the model's internal feature dynamics using Temporal Sparse Autoencoders (T-SAE). Easy problems mainly reinforce direct-answer and basic-computation features while suppressing deliberative-reasoning features; hard problems activate reasoning-related features but become useful only when successful trajectories are sampled; medium-difficulty problems provide a more balanced signal, strengthening both computation and multi-step reasoning features. Motivated by these findings, we propose difficulty-adaptive strategies for hard-sample utilization, using backward-reasoning reformulation and T-SAE-guided training signals to improve reward density and credit assignment during RLVR. Overall, our results identify sample difficulty as a key factor governing both the optimization dynamics and representation evolution of RLVR.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了RLVR中样本难度的机制作用，发现中等难度样本带来最佳推理提升，而过度困难的样本会导致退化行为。基于此提出基于难度自适应的策略，包括反向推理重述和T-SAE引导的训练信号。
AI.motivation: 现有研究虽验证了RLVR对LLM推理能力的提升效果，但样本难度在RLVR中的机制性作用尚不清晰，缺乏对难度如何影响学习信号、内部特征动力学的系统理解。
AI.method: 通过难度维度和单样本分析，结合Temporal Sparse Autoencoders (T-SAE) 分析模型内部特征动力学，提出基于难度自适应的策略：反向推理重述（backward-reasoning reformulation）和T-SAE引导的训练信号。
AI.result: 1) 样本难度对RLVR呈现非单调效应：容易和中等难度问题带来最强且最稳定的推理提升，过难问题导致弱学习信号、退化行为（重复回答、跳过必要计算），损害模型已有能力。2) 内部特征分析：容易问题强化直接答案和基础计算特征，抑制深思推理特征；困难问题激活推理相关特征但仅在有成功轨迹时有用；中等难度问题提供平衡信号。3) 提出的难度自适应策略可改善奖励密度和信用分配。
AI.conclusion: 样本难度是控制RLVR优化动力学和表征演化的关键因素，难度自适应策略可有效提升困难样本的利用效率。
idea_en: A difficulty-adaptive reinforcement learning method that dynamically adjusts training signals based on sample difficulty level, using backward-reasoning reformulation to convert hard problems into more learnable forms for LLM reasoning enhancement.

A method combining Temporal Sparse Autoencoders (T-SAE) with RLVR training, where T-SAE monitors internal feature dynamics to guide credit assignment and identify when reasoning-related features are being suppressed or activated during training.

A system for detecting and mitigating degenerative behaviors in LLM reasoning (answer repetition, skipped computation) by monitoring sample difficulty and adjusting reward density in reinforcement learning.

A dual-path training strategy for RLVR where easy/medium problems use standard reward signals while hard problems use backward-reasoning reformulated trajectories and T-SAE-guided feature reinforcement signals.
idea_ch: 一种基于样本难度的自适应强化学习方法，动态调整训练信号强度，利用反向推理重述（Backward-Reasoning Reformulation）将困难问题转化为更易学习的形式，提升LLM推理能力。
结合时序稀疏自编码器（T-SAE）与RLVR训练的方法，通过T-SAE监测模型内部特征动力学，在训练过程中识别推理相关特征被抑制或激活的状态，引导信用分配和奖励设计。
一种检测并缓解LLM推理过程中退化行为（如回答重复、跳过必要计算）的系统，通过监控样本难度并动态调整强化学习中的奖励密度来实现。
一种面向RLVR的双路径训练策略：容易/中等难度问题使用标准奖励信号，困难问题使用反向推理重述的轨迹和T-SAE引导的特征增强信号进行训练，以改善奖励密度和信用分配。

title: You Live More Than Once: Towards Hierarchical Skill Meta-Evolving
summary: Test-time skill evolving is regarded as a new paradigm for enhancing deployed agentic systems. Existing works mainly focus on hard-coded skill evolving strategies or parametric learning that rely on expensive parameter updates in the underlying LLMs. In this paper, we demonstrate that test-time refinement of the skill evolving framework itself is necessary for continuous improvement of the agent systems in different downstream scenarios, and lightweight algorithmic adaptation is feasible. Specifically, we propose HiSME, a lightweight hierarchical skill meta-evolving solution that jointly optimizes skills and the skill evolving strategy by learning meta-skills from agents' task execution traces. Experiments on diverse agentic benchmarks show that meta-evolving can produce a higher-quality skill library than pure skill evolving and can derive diverse meta-skills for different scenarios, thereby facilitating future continual experience learning. Our code is temporarily public at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/HiSME-BD45.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HiSME，一种轻量级分层技能元进化方法，通过在测试时从智能体任务执行轨迹中学习元技能，同时优化技能库和技能进化策略，从而持续提升部署的智能体系统性能，无需昂贵的参数更新。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时技能进化方法多依赖硬编码策略或需要更新底层LLM参数，成本高昂。本文论证了在测试时对技能进化框架本身进行轻量级算法自适应优化是必要的，以在不同下游场景中持续改进智能体系统。
AI.method: 提出HiSME分层技能元进化方案：通过从智能体任务执行轨迹中学习元技能（meta-skills），实现技能库与技能进化策略的联合优化。采用轻量级算法自适应方式，避免昂贵的底层LLM参数更新。
AI.result: 在多个智能体基准测试上，元进化相比纯技能进化能产生更高质量的技能库，并能针对不同场景推导出多样化的元技能，从而促进未来的持续经验学习。
AI.conclusion: 测试时对技能进化框架本身进行轻量级自适应优化是可行且必要的，HiSME为部署的智能体系统持续改进提供了新范式。
idea_en: A lightweight hierarchical skill meta-evolving method (HiSME) that jointly optimizes skills and skill evolving strategy without updating underlying LLM parameters.
Learning meta-skills from agent task execution traces to guide test-time skill evolution in deployed agentic systems.
A test-time skill evolving framework refinement technique that adapts the evolving strategy itself to different downstream scenarios via meta-learning.
idea_ch: 一种轻量级分层技能元进化方法（HiSME），无需更新底层LLM参数即可联合优化技能库和技能进化策略
从智能体任务执行轨迹中学习元技能，用于指导部署系统中测试时技能进化的技术
一种测试时技能进化框架自身的细化方法，通过元学习使进化策略自适应不同下游场景

title: HRBench: Benchmarking and Understanding Thinking-Mode Switch Strategies in Hybrid-Reasoning LLMs
summary: Hybrid-reasoning large language models (LLMs) expose explicit controls over reasoning effort, allowing users or systems to trade off answer quality against inference cost. However, existing methods for adaptive thinking-mode selection are typically evaluated under different models, datasets, and implementation assumptions, making it difficult to compare their practical behavior. We introduce HRBench, a unified evaluation framework for studying thinking-mode switching in hybrid-reasoning LLMs. HRBench organizes the design space along two axes: three switching strategy families, prompt-based selection, external routing, and speculative execution, and four training regimes, training-free, SFT, offline and online RL, yielding 12 controlled evaluation settings. We evaluate these settings across 6 LLMs, from Qwen3.5-2B to Kimi-K2.5-1.1T, and 5 reasoning benchmarks covering mathematics, science, and code, while reimplementing 12+ representative prior methods within the same pipeline. Our analysis characterizes how different switching strategies occupy distinct effectiveness-efficiency trade-off regions: prompt-based methods often provide favorable token-accuracy trade-offs, routing methods offer more stable cost reduction, and speculative methods tend to improve accuracy at higher token cost. We further find that training affects strategies differently, and that the preferred strategy varies with model scale and task domain. HRBench provides reference implementations and a unified evaluation platform to support more controlled research on efficient reasoning in hybrid-reasoning LLMs. Our data, code and repository are available at https://github.com/usail-hkust/HRBench.

AI.tldr: HRBench是首个统一评估混合推理LLM思考模式切换的框架，系统对比了12种策略在6个模型上的表现，揭示了不同策略在效率与准确性之间的权衡特性。
AI.motivation: 现有混合推理LLM的思考模式切换方法在不同模型、数据集和实现假设下评估，缺乏统一的比较框架。
AI.method: 构建12种受控评估设置（3种切换策略家族×4种训练范式），在6个LLM和5个推理基准上统一复现并对比现有方法。
AI.result: 不同切换策略占据不同的效率-效果权衡区域：提示方法提供良好的token-准确率权衡，路由方法稳定降低开销，推测方法在高token成本下提高准确率；训练对不同策略影响不同，最优策略随模型规模和任务领域变化。
AI.conclusion: HRBench提供了一个统一的评估框架，揭示了混合推理LLM中切换策略与训练方式对效率-效果权衡的影响，并开源了基准平台供后续研究使用。
idea_en: A prompt-based adaptive reasoning mode switching method that dynamically selects between fast answer and deep reasoning modes by real-time query difficulty analysis, optimizing the trade-off between token usage and accuracy.

An external routing mechanism for hybrid reasoning that uses a lightweight classifier to judge task complexity before LLM inference, routing queries to different reasoning-depth models or reasoning modes of the same model.

A speculative hybrid reasoning execution architecture where an LLM first generates a quick candidate answer, then a verification module decides whether to trigger deep reasoning for correction, maintaining high accuracy at lower cost.

A reinforcement learning-based training method for thinking-mode switching strategy that optimizes the timing of switching to deep reasoning modes (e.g., chain-of-thought) during LLM inference via online RL.

A cross-scale collaborative model reasoning system combining small models (fast response) with large models (deep reasoning), using a policy network to dynamically allocate reasoning tasks for joint optimization of cost and quality.

An adaptive token budget allocation method that dynamically adjusts the token usage upper limit during reasoning for different domain tasks (math, science, code), ensuring answer quality while reducing inference cost.
idea_ch: 一种基于提示的自适应推理模式切换方法，通过实时分析查询难易度动态选择LLM的思考模式（快速回答 vs 深度推理），优化token使用与准确率之间的平衡。
一种外部路由机制的混合推理系统，在LLM推理前通过轻量级分类器判断任务复杂度，将查询路由至不同推理深度的模型或同一模型的不同推理模式。
一种推测性混合推理执行架构，LLM先快速生成候选答案，然后由验证模块决定是否触发深度推理进行修正，以较低成本保持高准确性。
一种基于强化学习的思维模式切换策略训练方法，通过在线RL优化LLM在推理过程中切换深度思考模式（如链式推理）的时机决策。
一种跨尺度模型协同推理系统，结合小模型（快速响应）与大模型（深度推理），通过策略网络动态分配推理任务，实现成本与质量的联合优化。
一种自适应token预算分配方法，针对数学/科学/代码等不同领域任务，动态调整推理过程中的token使用上限，在保证答案质量前提下降低推理成本。

title: Measuring Progress Toward AGI: A Cognitive Framework
summary: Despite widespread discussion of AGI, there is no clear framework for measuring progress toward it. This ambiguity fuels subjective claims, makes it difficult to track progress, and risks hindering responsible governance. As a starting point to address this gap, we present a framework for understanding system capabilities in relation to human cognitive abilities. Drawing from decades of research in psychology, neuroscience, and cognitive science, we introduce a Cognitive Taxonomy that deconstructs general intelligence into 10 key cognitive faculties. We then propose a rigorous evaluation protocol in which a system's performance is measured across a suite of targeted, held-out cognitive tasks, generating a 'cognitive profile' that can be used to understand a system's strengths and weaknesses. We hope this framework will provide a practical roadmap and an initial step toward more rigorous, empirical evaluation of AGI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一套基于认知科学的AGI评估框架，将通用智能分解为10个认知能力，并通过一套保留的认知任务来测量系统的"认知轮廓"，从而客观评估AGI进展。
AI.motivation: 目前缺乏明确的AGI进展衡量框架，导致主观论断泛滥、进展追踪困难、治理受阻。
AI.method: 基于心理学、神经科学和认知科学的研究，构建包含10项关键认知能力的认知分类体系，并设计一套保留的认知任务来评估系统表现，生成系统的"认知轮廓"。
AI.result: 提出了一套结构化的AGI评估框架和认知分类体系。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为更严格、实证的AGI评估提供了实用路线图和初步步骤。
idea_en: A Cognitive Taxonomy framework decomposing general intelligence into 10 key cognitive faculties for systematic AGI evaluation
A held-out cognitive task evaluation protocol generating a 'cognitive profile' to map system strengths and weaknesses
Integration of psychology, neuroscience, and cognitive science benchmarks into AGI assessment methodology
idea_ch: 一种将通用智能分解为10项关键认知能力的认知分类体系框架，用于系统性评估AGI
一套保留的认知任务评估协议，生成系统的'认知轮廓'以映射其优势和劣势
将心理学、神经科学和认知科学基准整合到AGI评估方法中的技术方案

title: Efficient Post-training of LLMs for Code Generation With Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: Post-training using online reinforcement learning (RL) is an important training step for LLMs, including code-generating models. However, online RL for code generation involves LLM inference and verification of the generated output, which can take considerable time and resources. In this paper, we explore the application of offline RL to code-generating models by leveraging existing code datasets. Our experiments demonstrate that offline RL is an effective training strategy for improving LLM performance. We show that offline RL can be especially beneficial for small LLMs and challenging coding problems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了将离线强化学习（offline RL）应用于代码生成大语言模型（LLMs）的可行性，通过利用现有代码数据集进行训练，避免了在线RL中耗时的推理和验证步骤。实验表明离线RL能有效提升模型性能，尤其对小模型和困难编程问题效果显著。
AI.motivation: 在线强化学习用于代码生成需要大量的LLM推理和输出验证，耗时且耗费资源。作者希望探索离线RL作为一种更高效的替代方案，利用已有的代码数据集进行训练。
AI.method: 利用现有的代码数据集，对代码生成模型应用离线强化学习训练策略，避免在线RL中的推理和验证环节。
AI.result: 离线RL能有效提升代码生成LLM的性能，尤其对小规模LLM和具有挑战性的编程问题效果更为显著。
AI.conclusion: 离线强化学习是改进代码生成LLM的有效训练策略，在资源受限场景下具有实际应用价值。
idea_en: Offline RL training method for code-generating LLMs using existing code datasets without online inference and verification
Small LLM performance enhancement system via offline RL for challenging coding problems
Resource-efficient code generation model training framework using offline reinforcement learning
idea_ch: 基于现有代码数据集的离线强化学习训练方法，无需在线推理和验证即可提升代码生成LLM性能
面向小规模LLM的离线RL增强系统，专门针对困难编程问题进行性能提升
利用离线强化学习的高效代码生成模型训练框架，显著降低计算资源消耗

title: DenoiseRL: Bootstrapping Reasoning Models to Recover from Noisy Prefixes
summary: Reinforcement learning has become a central paradigm for advancing reasoning in large language models, yet most existing methods still depend on stronger teacher models or heavily curated difficult datasets, limiting scalable capability improvement. In this paper, we introduce DenoiseRL, a reinforcement learning framework that substitutes external supervision with recovery-oriented optimization over failures from weak models. Instead of relying on stronger supervision or carefully engineered data, DenoiseRL learns directly from incorrect reasoning traces by converting them into opportunities for improvement, making training more scalable and less dependent on external resources. This yields a richer and more diverse learning signal, improving exploration efficiency from imperfect model behavior. As a result, DenoiseRL improves reasoning performance and overall training efficiency while reducing the need for expensive data curation or stronger teacher models. Empirically, DenoiseRL consistently outperforms strong on-policy RL baselines across competitive mathematical and general reasoning benchmarks and promotes stronger self-corrective behavior as training difficulty increases, highlighting an effective and scalable alternative pathway for improving reasoning in large language models.

AI.tldr: DenoiseRL是一种强化学习框架，通过从弱模型的失败推理轨迹中进行恢复导向优化，替代外部监督，实现大规模语言模型推理能力的可扩展提升。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习方法依赖更强的教师模型或精心设计的困难数据集，限制了可扩展的能力提升。需要一种不依赖外部监督的可扩展训练方法。
AI.method: 提出DenoiseRL框架，将不正确的推理轨迹转化为改进机会，通过恢复导向优化替代外部监督，直接从失败中学习，产生更丰富多样的学习信号。
AI.result: 在数学和通用推理基准测试上，DenoiseRL持续优于强on-policy RL基线，并随着训练难度增加促进更强的自我纠正行为。
AI.conclusion: DenoiseRL提供了一种有效且可扩展的替代路径，用于提升大语言模型的推理能力，减少了对昂贵数据整理和更强教师模型的依赖。
idea_en: A reinforcement learning framework that converts incorrect reasoning traces from weak models into training opportunities through recovery-oriented optimization, eliminating the need for stronger teacher models or curated datasets.
A method for generating rich and diverse learning signals directly from model failures, improving exploration efficiency in imperfect model behavior without external supervision.
A self-corrective reinforcement learning mechanism that promotes stronger self-correction behavior as training difficulty increases, enhancing reasoning capabilities in large language models.
A scalable training approach that uses failure recovery as a substitute for external supervision, reducing dependency on expensive data curation and stronger teacher models.
idea_ch: 一种强化学习框架，通过恢复导向优化将弱模型的不正确推理轨迹转化为训练机会，无需强教师模型或精心整理的数据集。
一种直接从模型失败中生成丰富多样学习信号的方法，无需外部监督即可提高在不完美模型行为中的探索效率。
一种自我纠正强化学习机制，随着训练难度增加促进更强的自我纠正行为，提升大语言模型的推理能力。
一种用失败恢复替代外部监督的可扩展训练方法，减少对昂贵数据整理和更强教师模型的依赖。

title: GONDOR to the Rescue: Satisficing Planning with Low Memory
summary: Greedy Best-First Search (GBFS) is the dominant approach for solving search problems where the goal can be estimated with a heuristic, such as planning, route finding, navigation, and pathfinding. This is especially true when the memory is tightly constrained, such as planning on edge devices. To alleviate that, we present GONDOR (Greedy Online Navigation with Dynamic Outpost-based Re-search), a memory-efficient extension of GBFS that allows search to continue under strict memory limits by periodically compressing the search tree while retaining a sparse set of anchor states, then upon reaching the goal reconstructs the path by re-searching between the sparse states. We analyze the algorithm and discuss several variants defined by different outpost selection policies. In addition, we explore using Bloom filters for compact duplicate detection in the closed list. Experiments across numeric planning domains and heuristic configurations show that GONDOR consistently improves coverage under low memory budgets compared to standard GBFS. We release the implementation of GONDOR and the Bloom-filter variant to facilitate further research on memory-efficient heuristic search.

AI.tldr: GONDOR是一种内存高效的GBFS扩展算法，通过周期性压缩搜索树并保留稀疏锚点状态，在严格内存限制下继续搜索，到达目标后再通过重新搜索重建路径。实验表明在低内存预算下比标准GBFS有更好的覆盖率。
AI.motivation: GBFS是规划、路径查找等启发式搜索问题的主流方法，但在边缘设备等内存严格受限的场景下，搜索树会迅速耗尽内存，导致搜索失败。需要一种内存高效的GBFS扩展方案。
AI.method: 提出GONDOR算法：1) 周期性压缩搜索树，仅保留稀疏的锚点(outpost)状态；2) 从锚点继续搜索；3) 到达目标后，通过在稀疏状态之间重新搜索来重建完整路径。探索了多种锚点选择策略，并使用Bloom过滤器实现紧凑的重复检测。
AI.result: 在数值规划领域和多种启发式配置下的实验表明，GONDOR在低内存预算下持续优于标准GBFS的覆盖率。
AI.conclusion: GONDOR有效解决了GBFS在严格内存限制下的搜索问题，通过压缩-重建机制在内存效率和搜索完整性之间取得了良好平衡，Bloom过滤器进一步提升了内存效率。
idea_en: A memory-efficient search method that periodically compresses the search tree by retaining only a sparse set of anchor states (outposts), enabling continued search under strict memory limits, and reconstructs the complete path upon reaching the goal by re-searching between the sparse anchor states.

A dynamic outpost selection policy for determining which states to retain during search tree compression, with multiple variant strategies for optimizing the trade-off between memory usage and search efficiency.
Integration of Bloom filters into heuristic search for compact duplicate detection in the closed list, reducing memory overhead for state memorization during Greedy Best-First Search.

A two-phase search architecture for Greedy Best-First Search: a forward compression phase that stores sparse anchor states, and a backward re-search phase that reconstructs the complete solution path by connecting anchor states.
idea_ch: 一种内存高效的搜索方法，通过周期性压缩搜索树仅保留稀疏锚点状态(outpost)，在严格内存限制下继续搜索，到达目标后通过在稀疏锚点状态之间重新搜索来重建完整路径
一种动态锚点选择策略，用于确定搜索树压缩期间应保留哪些状态，提供多种变体策略以优化内存使用与搜索效率之间的权衡
将Bloom过滤器集成到启发式搜索中，用于紧凑的重复检测(closed list)，减少GBFS中状态记忆的内存开销
一种GBFS的两阶段搜索架构：前向压缩阶段存储稀疏锚点状态，后向重新搜索阶段通过连接锚点状态重建完整解决方案路径

title: Diffusion Large Language Models for Visual Speech Recognition
summary: Existing Visual Speech Recognition (VSR) systems commonly rely on left-to-right autoregressive decoding, which can force premature decisions on visually ambiguous tokens before sufficient context is available. We propose DLLM-VSR, to the best of our knowledge, the first Diffusion Large Language Model (DLLM)-based VSR framework, formulating transcription as iterative masked denoising with flexible-order decoding. With confidence-based unmasking, DLLM-VSR commits high-confidence positions early and uses the committed tokens as bidirectional context to refine ambiguous ones. To adapt DLLMs to VSR, we introduce a two-stage masked-denoising training strategy that separates visual-to-text content alignment from length modeling. We further observe a performance gap with oracle-length decoding, which assumes access to the true transcript length, indicating that reducing target-length uncertainty can improve DLLM-based VSR. To reduce this gap, we develop length-guided candidate decoding, which uses video duration to construct plausible transcript-length hypotheses, decodes under multiple hypotheses, and reranks candidates using length plausibility and decoding confidence. The proposed method achieves a state-of-the-art WER of 19.5\% on LRS3 using only its labeled training data.

AI.tldr: 提出首个基于扩散大语言模型（DLLM）的视觉语音识别（VSR）框架DLLM-VSR，通过迭代掩码去噪和灵活顺序解码替代传统自回归解码，并引入长度引导候选解码来减少目标长度不确定性，在LRS3上实现19.5%的WER。
AI.motivation: 传统VSR系统使用从左到右的自回归解码，在视觉模糊的token上会在获得充分上下文之前被迫做出过早决策，导致错误累积。
AI.method: 1) 基于DLLM的VSR框架，将转录建模为迭代掩码去噪和灵活顺序解码；2) 置信度驱动的解掩码策略，先确定高置信度位置，再用双向上下文优化模糊位置；3) 两阶段掩码去噪训练策略，分离视觉-文本对齐与长度建模；4) 长度引导候选解码，利用视频时长生成候选长度假设并重排序。
AI.result: 在LRS3数据集上仅使用标注训练数据即达到19.5%的WER，达到SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: 证明了扩散模型在VSR任务中的有效性，揭示了减少目标长度不确定性对提升DLLM-based VSR性能的重要性。
idea_en: A non-autoregressive visual speech recognition method based on Diffusion Large Language Model (DLLM) that formulates transcription as iterative masked denoising with flexible-order decoding, overcoming premature decision issues of left-to-right autoregressive decoding.

A confidence-based unmasking strategy for visual speech recognition that commits high-confidence token positions early and uses bidirectional context from committed tokens to refine visually ambiguous tokens.
A two-stage masked-denoising training strategy for adapting Diffusion Large Language Models to visual speech recognition, which separates visual-to-text content alignment from length modeling.

A length-guided candidate decoding method for visual speech recognition that uses video duration to construct plausible transcript-length hypotheses, decodes under multiple length hypotheses, and reranks candidates using length plausibility and decoding confidence.
idea_ch: 一种基于扩散大语言模型（DLLM）的非自回归视觉语音识别方法，将转录过程建模为迭代掩码去噪和灵活顺序解码，克服了从左到右自回归解码的过早决策问题。
一种用于视觉语音识别的置信度驱动解掩码策略，先确定高置信度位置，再利用已确定token的双向上下文来优化视觉模糊的token。
一种为适应视觉语音识别而设计的两阶段掩码去噪训练策略，将视觉到文本的内容对齐与长度建模分离开来。
一种用于视觉语音识别的长度引导候选解码方法，利用视频时长构建合理的转录长度假设，在多个长度假设下进行解码，并使用长度合理性和解码置信度对候选进行重排序。

title: From Learning Resources to Competencies: LLM-Based Tagging with Evidence and Graph Constraints
summary: Linking learning resources to a structured competency framework is key to enabling competency-based search and curriculum analytics in Learning Management Systems (LMS). However, manual tagging is labor-intensive, and fully automatic methods often lack transparency. In this paper, we present an end-to-end alignment pipeline that uses a large language model (LLM) as a constrained, evidence-producing tagger. LMS resources -both instructional content and assessments -are first segmented into meaningful pedagogical fragments. For each fragment, a small set of candidate competencies is retrieved from structured competency profiles enriched with graph-based context. The LLM then selects the most relevant competencies from this set and provides supporting evidence spans from the fragment text. These predictions are refined using the structure of the competency graph and aggregated at the resource level. We evaluate our approach on a dataset built from the Computer Science department's competency referential at the Université de Technologie de Compiègne (UTC), covering 22 competencies across multiple course materials. Our LLM+BM25+Graph (LBG) pipeline achieves strong results, with a micro-F1 of 0.57 and macro-F1 of 0.50 at the fragment level, 0.51 macro-F1 at the resource level, and an MRR of 0.82outperforming zero-shot and few-shot LLM variants, retrieval/similarity baselines, and supervised classifiers -while also producing more mechanically traceable evidence spans to support human auditing and educational analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种端到端的对齐流水线（LBG），利用大语言模型作为受约束的、产生证据的标签器，将学习资源链接到结构化能力框架上，实现可审计的能力标签生成。
AI.motivation: 手动将学习资源与能力框架对齐耗时费力，全自动方法缺乏透明度和可审计性，亟需一种既能自动标注又能提供可追溯证据的方法。
AI.method: 将LMS资源分割成教学片段；从结构化能力画像中检索候选能力；LLM从候选中选择最相关能力并提取片段中的支持证据；利用能力图谱结构优化预测并聚合到资源级别。
AI.result: 在UTC计算机系数据集上，LBG流水线在片段级别达到micro-F1 0.57、macro-F1 0.50，资源级别macro-F1 0.51，MRR 0.82，优于零样本/少样本LLM、检索/相似度基线和监督分类器。
AI.conclusion: LLM+检索+图谱约束的流水线能有效提升能力标签的准确性和可解释性，支持人工审计和教育分析。
idea_en: A constrained LLM-based tagging method that selects competencies only from a retrieved candidate set and outputs evidence spans from the source text, enabling transparent and auditable competency labeling.
A graph-based refinement module that leverages the structure of a competency graph to correct and aggregate LLM predictions at both fragment and resource levels.
A retrieval pipeline combining BM25 with graph-based context enrichment from structured competency profiles to generate high-quality candidate sets for LLM selection.
idea_ch: 一种受约束的大语言模型标签方法，仅从检索到的候选能力集中进行选择，并从源文本中输出证据片段，实现透明且可审计的能力标注。
一种基于图谱的优化模块，利用能力图谱的结构对LLM预测结果进行纠错，并在片段和资源两个层面进行聚合。
一种结合BM25与结构化能力画像的图上下文增强的检索流水线，用于生成高质量候选能力集供LLM选择。

title: ProvMind: Provenance-grounded reasoning for materials synthesis
summary: Materials process optimization requires reasoning over routes, conditions, tools and causal dependencies, yet most computational formulations flatten synthesis procedures into text or ordered steps. We introduce MatProcBench, a provenance-grounded benchmark constructed from literature-mined MatPROV graphs, to evaluate seven process-reasoning tasks spanning route continuity, step-level variable inference and global causal consistency under both same-split and shift-aware evaluation, including a strict dual-OOD split that combines temporal and material-class shift. We further introduce ProvMind, a process-memory reasoning framework that retrieves analogous training processes, converts them into provenance-aware option-level compatibility scores, and uses a language model for constrained final decision making. ProvMind achieves 52.84\% accuracy on the dual-OOD split, outperforming prompting, retrieval-augmented and supervised fine-tuning baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于材料合成流程知识图谱的基准测试MatProcBench和流程记忆推理框架ProvMind，用于评估和提升材料流程优化中的因果推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将材料合成流程简化为文本或有序步骤，缺乏对路线、条件、工具及因果依赖关系的结构化推理能力。
AI.method: 构建MatProcBench基准，基于文献挖掘的MatPROV图，涵盖7项流程推理任务；提出ProvMind框架，通过检索相似训练流程、转换为溯源感知的选项级兼容性评分，并利用语言模型进行约束决策。
AI.result: ProvMind在双重分布外（dual-OOD）拆分上达到52.84%准确率，优于提示工程、检索增强和微调基线。
AI.conclusion: Provenance-aware的流程记忆推理方法在材料流程优化中具有显著优势，为材料逆向设计提供了可解释的因果推理路径。
idea_en: A provenance-grounded benchmark (MatProcBench) for evaluating process-reasoning tasks in materials synthesis, using MatPROV knowledge graphs constructed from literature mining.

A process-memory reasoning framework (ProvMind) that retrieves analogous training processes, converts them into provenance-aware option-level compatibility scores, and uses a language model for constrained final decision making.
A strict dual-OOD evaluation split combining temporal and material-class shift for robust assessment of generalization in materials process reasoning.
Option-level compatibility scoring mechanism that encodes causal dependencies and route continuity from provenance graphs into machine-readable scores.
idea_ch: 基于文献挖掘的MatPROV知识图谱构建的材料合成流程推理基准测试MatProcBench，用于评估路线连续性、步骤级变量推理和全局因果一致性。
流程记忆推理框架ProvMind，通过检索相似训练流程并转换为溯源感知的选项级兼容性评分，结合语言模型进行约束决策。
双重分布外（dual-OOD）评估分裂方法，同时考虑时间漂移和材料类别漂移，用于材料流程推理的鲁棒性测试。
选项级兼容性评分机制，将溯源图中的因果依赖关系和路线连续性编码为机器可读的评分，支持流程优化决策。

title: Benchmarking AI for low-resource contexts: Thinking beyond leaderboards
comment: Aakash Pant, Kavya Shah, and Apoorv Agnihotri contributed equally
summary: Existing AI evaluation practices often fail to capture how systems actually perform in low-resource environments, where operational constraints shape usability as much as model quality. Through a structured analysis of existing benchmark families across speech, chat/RAG, and vision systems, we identify critical gaps between laboratory evaluation practices and real-world deployment conditions in low-resource environments. We argue that the meaningful unit of assessment is the deployed system rather than an isolated model and that effective evaluation frameworks must integrate task performance with deployment conditions such as noisy inputs, code-switching, intermittent connectivity, low-end hardware, and domain shift. At the same time, benchmarks should recognize that different application classes require distinct evaluation profiles rather than a single aggregate score that obscures operational differences. To support practical decision-making, we propose a shared reporting framework that preserves comparability across systems and application types while remaining sensitive to deployment context. Finally, we emphasize the need for concise and actionable reporting artifacts for policymakers, donors, and implementers, including standardized one-page benchmark cards, deployment profiles, and explicit documentation of failure handling procedures and human oversight mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文指出当前AI评估实践未能反映低资源环境中的实际系统表现，提出应以部署系统而非孤立模型为评估单位，并建立考虑噪声输入、代码切换、间歇性连接等现实条件的评估框架。
AI.motivation: 现有AI评估方法在实验室环境与低资源环境实际部署之间存在显著差距，评估结果无法反映系统在真实约束条件下的可用性。
AI.method: 通过结构化分析语音、聊天/RAG和视觉系统的现有基准测试家族，识别评估实践与部署条件之间的关键差距。
AI.result: 发现评估应以部署系统为单位，需整合任务性能与部署条件；不同应用类别需差异化评估配置；提出共享报告框架保持可比性。
AI.conclusion: 需要标准化的单页基准卡、部署配置文件和失败处理文档等可操作报告工具，供政策制定者、资助方和实施者使用。
idea_en: A deployment-context-aware AI evaluation framework that integrates task performance metrics with real-world operational constraints (noisy inputs, code-switching, intermittent connectivity, low-end hardware, domain shift) as weighted evaluation dimensions.
A system-level assessment unit methodology that evaluates the entire deployed AI system rather than isolated models, capturing interaction effects between model performance and deployment conditions.
A multi-profile evaluation system that assigns different evaluation configurations based on application classes (speech, chat/RAG, vision) rather than using a single aggregate score.
A standardized one-page benchmark card reporting artifact that concisely documents deployment context, failure handling procedures, and human oversight mechanisms for policymakers and implementers.
A shared reporting framework that preserves cross-system comparability while maintaining sensitivity to deployment context through structured deployment profiles.
idea_ch: 一种部署环境感知的AI评估框架，将任务性能指标与实际运行约束（噪声输入、代码切换、间歇性连接、低端硬件、领域偏移）作为加权评估维度进行整合
一种系统级评估单元方法，评估完整的已部署AI系统而非孤立模型，捕捉模型性能与部署条件之间的交互效应
一种多配置文件评估系统，根据不同应用类别（语音、聊天/RAG、视觉）分配不同的评估配置，而非使用单一聚合评分
一种标准化单页基准卡报告工具，为政策制定者和实施者简洁地记录部署环境、失败处理程序和人工监督机制
一种共享报告框架，通过结构化的部署配置文件在保持跨系统可比性的同时保持对部署环境的敏感性

title: GS-FUSE: Granger-Supervised Gated Fusion and Multi-Granularity Alignment for Event-Driven Financial Forecasting
summary: Accurately forecasting the impact of salient financial events on markets is critical for investors and policymakers. However, existing multimodal time-series models typically fuse text and prices symmetrically, without an explicit way to decide when event text is truly predictive, and thus struggle to exploit the directional event-to-price structure and the heterogeneous roles of textual and price signals. In this work, we propose GS-Fuse, a multimodal event-based forecasting framework that employs (i) a Granger-supervised, causal-aware gated fusion module, which learns to open toward event text only when it provides incremental predictive value beyond historical prices, and (ii) a multi-granularity alignment mechanism that jointly aligns high-level event representations and fine-grained textual cues with future market trajectories. Built as a flexible, plug-and-play adapter on top of off-the-shelf large language models and time-series foundation models, GS-Fuse can be instantiated across diverse backbones and market settings. Extensive experiments on real-world financial datasets show that GS-Fuse consistently outperforms state-of-the-art time-series and multimodal baselines across multiple assets and forecasting horizons.

AI.tldr: GS-Fuse是一个多模态事件驱动金融预测框架，通过Granger因果监督的选通融合模块和多粒度对齐机制，有效利用事件文本与价格信号的异质关系，在多个金融数据集上超越现有基线模型。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态时间序列模型对称融合文本和价格信号，缺乏判断事件文本是否真正具有预测能力的机制，难以充分利用事件到价格的方向性结构和文本与价格信号的异质角色。
AI.method: 提出GS-Fuse框架，包含：(i) Granger监督的因果感知门控融合模块，仅在事件文本提供超越历史价格的增量预测价值时才开启对文本的融合；(ii) 多粒度对齐机制，联合对齐高层事件表示和细粒度文本线索与未来市场轨迹。该框架作为即插即用适配器，可集成于现有大语言模型和时间序列基础模型之上。
AI.result: 在真实金融数据集上的大量实验表明，GS-Fuse在多种资产和预测时间跨度上持续优于最新的时间序列和多模态基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过Granger因果监督的门控机制实现事件文本的条件性融合，以及多粒度对齐，能有效提升金融事件驱动预测的性能。
idea_en: Granger-causal gated fusion module that learns to open toward event text only when it provides incremental predictive value beyond historical prices
Multi-granularity alignment mechanism that jointly aligns high-level event representations and fine-grained textual cues with future market trajectories
Plug-and-play adapter architecture that integrates Granger-supervised fusion and alignment onto off-the-shelf large language models and time-series foundation models
idea_ch: 基于Granger因果监督的门控融合模块，仅在事件文本提供超越历史价格的增量预测价值时才激活文本融合路径
多粒度对齐机制，将高层事件表示和细粒度文本线索与未来市场轨迹进行联合对齐
即插即用适配器架构，可将Granger监督融合与对齐机制无缝集成到现有大语言模型和时间序列基础模型上

title: Let Relations Speak: An End-to-End LLM-GNN Soft Prompt Framework for Fraud Detection
summary: In recent years, Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown great capability in processing graph tasks such as fraud detection. However, most existing methods rely heavily on rich text attributes, which poses difficulties for this domain due to the lack of textual data. Although some pioneering methods attempt to overcome it, their textualization of graph structures via hard prompts easily leads to feature distortion. Additionally, fraud detection often exhibits multi-relational complexity, where current methods struggle to capture this deep semantic information. To address these challenges, we propose LLM-GNN Soft Prompt Framework (LGSPF). Specifically, LGSPF bridges the graph structure and semantic space using soft prompt to eliminate reliance on text. We further introduce a parallel Graph Neural Network (GNN) encoder to translate multi-relational topologies into graph tokens for fine-grained LLM fraud comprehension. Through end-to-end optimization, LGSPF enhances deep semantic alignment between LLM and GNN. Experiments across diverse fraud detection benchmarks demonstrate our method achieves state-of-the-art performance. Moreover, we further validate the contribution of LGSPF on enhancing the semantic interpretability of fraud behaviors.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种软提示框架LGSPF，将LLM与GNN结合用于欺诈检测，解决了缺乏文本属性和多关系复杂性的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在图任务（如欺诈检测）中依赖丰富文本属性，但欺诈领域缺乏文本数据；硬提示方式导致特征失真；多关系复杂性难以捕捉深层语义信息。
AI.method: 提出LGSPF框架：使用软提示（soft prompt）桥接图结构与语义空间，消除对文本的依赖；引入并行GNN编码器将多关系拓扑转化为图令牌（graph tokens），用于细粒度LLM欺诈理解；通过端到端优化增强LLM与GNN之间的深度语义对齐。
AI.result: 在多个欺诈检测基准数据集上达到SOTA性能，并验证了该方法在增强欺诈行为语义可解释性方面的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 软提示机制结合GNN能够有效解决欺诈检测中文本缺失和多关系复杂性问题，提升检测性能与可解释性。
idea_en: A soft prompt framework (LGSPF) that bridges graph structures and semantic space for LLM-based fraud detection without requiring rich text attributes.
A parallel GNN encoder that converts multi-relational graph topologies into graph tokens for fine-grained LLM comprehension in fraud detection.
End-to-end optimization method for deep semantic alignment between LLM and GNN in graph-based fraud detection tasks.
Soft prompt-based graph textualization mechanism that eliminates feature distortion caused by hard prompts in graph-structured fraud detection.
idea_ch: 一种软提示框架（LGSPF），桥接图结构与语义空间，使LLM无需丰富文本属性即可进行欺诈检测。
一种并行GNN编码器，将多关系图拓扑转化为图令牌（graph tokens），实现LLM对欺诈行为细粒度理解。
一种端到端优化方法，实现LLM与GNN在图欺诈检测任务中的深度语义对齐。
一种基于软提示的图谱文本化机制，消除硬提示在图结构欺诈检测中的特征失真问题。

title: Entropy-aware Masking for Masked Language Modeling
summary: Masked language modeling has become a standard pretraining objective for training encoder-based language models. In this approach, certain tokens in the input are masked, and the model learns to predict them using the surrounding context. This process enables the model to capture both syntactic and semantic properties of language. Conventionally, the tokens selected for masking are chosen at random, which may not always yield the most effective learning signals. In this work, we examine a token masking strategy based on entropy distribution. We use the model's entropy over token predictions to identify which tokens should be masked. This method aims to target tokens that are more informative and uncertain to improve the training efficacy. We also propose a novel self-masking approach that enhances training efficiency without relying on an external reference model. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves an average performance improvement of 5% in GLUE scores compared to the baseline. Further, we experiment with combining knowledge distillation with entropy masking, resulting in the best overall results.

AI.tldr: 提出基于熵分布和自掩码的token掩码策略，替代传统随机掩码方法，提升语言模型训练效率与性能，在GLUE上平均提升5%。
AI.motivation: 传统随机掩码策略无法保证选出最具信息量的训练信号，导致训练效率不高。
AI.method: 1) 基于熵分布的掩码策略：利用模型对token预测的熵值识别不确定性高的token进行掩码；2) 自掩码方法：无需外部参考模型，提升训练效率；3) 结合知识蒸馏与熵掩码。
AI.result: GLUE评分相较基线平均提升5%，结合知识蒸馏取得最佳结果。
AI.conclusion: 基于熵的掩码策略能提供更有效的学习信号，自掩码方法进一步提升了训练效率。
idea_en: Entropy-based token masking strategy for masked language modeling, where tokens with highest prediction entropy are selected for masking instead of random selection.
Self-masking approach that determines which tokens to mask without requiring an external reference model, improving training efficiency.
Combination of knowledge distillation with entropy-based masking for enhanced language model pretraining.
idea_ch: 基于熵分布的Token掩码方法：利用模型对Token预测的熵值高低来动态选择待掩码Token，替代传统随机掩码，提升训练信号质量。
自掩码机制：无需外部参考模型，通过模型自身熵信息确定掩码位置，降低训练依赖和计算成本。
熵掩码与知识蒸馏的结合方案：将基于熵的掩码策略融入知识蒸馏框架，进一步提升下游任务性能。

title: Do Agents Know What They Can't Do? Evaluating Feasibility Awareness in Tool-Using Agents
summary: Tool-using agents often incur substantial computational cost due to long reasoning chains and iterative tool usage. In practical scenarios, many tasks become infeasible under constrained tool environments, where the capabilities required for successful task completion are unavailable. Detecting infeasible tasks and stopping execution early can significantly reduce unnecessary execution cost. In this work, we propose FeasiGen, an automatic pipeline for constructing infeasible agent tasks by identifying the critical tools required for successful task completion. Our approach extracts tool-calling traces from successful executions across multiple agent systems, identifies critical tools consistently shared across diverse execution strategies, and masks these tools to automatically transform solvable tasks into infeasible ones. Human verification confirms that the infeasibility annotations for our constructed tasks achieve over 94% accuracy. We further introduce feasibility-aware evaluation metrics for measuring whether agents can recognize infeasible tasks and stop execution appropriately. Extensive evaluations across nine models reveal substantially weak infeasibility detection ability, with false continue rate reaching up to 73.9%. We further observe that multi-agent architectures significantly reduce erroneous execution under infeasible conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FeasiGen管道，通过识别关键工具并屏蔽它们，自动将可解决任务转化为不可解决任务，用于检测智能体在受限工具环境中的不可行任务识别能力。实验发现现有模型不可行检测能力较弱，多智能体架构可显著减少错误执行。
AI.motivation: 工具使用智能体在受限工具环境中执行不可行任务会浪费大量计算资源，现有方法缺乏有效检测不可行任务并提前停止执行的机制。
AI.method: FeasiGen管道：从多个智能体系统的成功执行中提取工具调用轨迹，识别跨不同执行策略一致共享的关键工具，然后屏蔽这些工具，自动将可解任务转化为不可解任务。
AI.result: 人工验证不可行标注准确率超94%；在9个模型上的评估显示不可行检测能力弱，错误继续率高达73.9%；多智能体架构显著减少不可行条件下的错误执行。
AI.conclusion: 现有智能体系统缺乏有效的不可行任务检测能力，FeasiGen可高效构建训练/评估数据，多智能体架构是提升可行感知能力的方向。
idea_en: An automated pipeline (FeasiGen) that transforms solvable agent tasks into infeasible ones by identifying and masking critical tools shared across successful execution traces from multiple agent systems.
A method for extracting tool-calling traces from successful executions to identify critical tools that are consistently used across diverse execution strategies.
A feasibility-aware evaluation metric that measures whether agent systems can recognize infeasible tasks and stop execution appropriately to reduce computational waste.
A multi-agent architecture approach that significantly reduces erroneous execution under infeasible tool environments.
idea_ch: FeasiGen自动管道：通过从多个智能体系统的成功执行轨迹中识别关键工具并屏蔽它们，将可解决任务自动转化为不可解决任务的技术方案
基于多系统执行轨迹交叉分析的关键工具识别方法：提取多个智能体系统的工具调用轨迹，识别跨不同执行策略一致共享的关键工具
可行感知评估体系：用于衡量智能体系统能否识别不可行任务并适时停止执行的评估指标和方法
多智能体架构在不可行工具环境下的应用：通过多智能体协作显著减少错误执行的技术方案

title: Cultural Binding Heads in Language Models
summary: LLMs often default to equal treatment across cultural groups, even though context warrants differentiation: this is a lack of difference awareness. Using mechanistic interpretability and a factorial design on the N4 cultural appropriation benchmark from Wang et al. (2025), we identify 2-3 mid-layer attention heads per model that contribute causally to cultural binding across eight models (four architectures, base and instruct). Cultural binding is the process of associating cultural items with the appropriate identity. Knockout of the identity-to-item edges on these heads lowers the binding strength by 9-23%. The identified heads transfer from instruct to base models, suggesting that cultural binding is created at pre-training. An $α$-scaling shows a graded dose-response and moderate amplification steering at generation ($α= 2-3$) increases cultural differentiation accuracy by 1-3 pp while leaving neutral reasoning mostly intact. A knowledge probing task shows that models know 3-5 times more than they act upon it, indicating that the bottleneck lies in routing and not knowledge.

AI.tldr: 本文发现LLMs在文化适配上缺乏差异感知，通过机制可解释性识别出跨8个模型（4种架构）的2-3个中间层注意力头负责"文化绑定"（将文化物品与适当身份关联）。敲除这些头会降低绑定强度9-23%。这些注意力头从指令模型迁移到基础模型，表明文化绑定在预训练阶段形成。α-缩放实验显示，适度放大（α=2-3）可提升文化区分准确率1-3个百分点，同时保持中性推理基本不变。知识探测表明模型知道的知识比实际表现出的多3-5倍，瓶颈在于路由而非知识本身。
AI.motivation: LLMs在处理不同文化群体时往往采取平等对待，但某些情境下需要差异化处理。现有模型缺乏这种文化差异感知能力，需要理解其内在机制。
AI.method: 使用机制可解释性方法和因子设计，在N4文化挪用基准测试上，识别了8个模型（4种架构的基础版和指令版）中2-3个中间层注意力头。通过敲除这些头的身份-物品边来验证其因果作用，并进行α-缩放实验和知识探测任务。
AI.result: 识别出的注意力头负责"文化绑定"，敲除后绑定强度降低9-23%。这些头从指令模型迁移到基础模型。α=2-3的适度放大可将文化区分准确率提升1-3个百分点。知识探测表明模型知识量是行为表现量的3-5倍。
AI.conclusion: 文化绑定在预训练阶段形成，模型的文化差异化瓶颈在于信息路由而非知识缺失。通过适度干预注意力头可以提升文化区分能力而不损害中性推理。
idea_en: A method for identifying and modulating mid-layer attention heads responsible for cultural binding in LLMs, enabling controlled differentiation across cultural groups while preserving neutral reasoning.
A knockout technique for identity-to-item edges on specific attention heads that reduces cultural binding strength by 9-23%, providing a means to calibrate cultural sensitivity in language models.
An alpha-scaling steering mechanism that amplifies cultural differentiation accuracy by 1-3 percentage points (at alpha=2-3) without degrading neutral reasoning performance.

A cross-architecture transferable cultural attention head identification method that works across base and instruct models of different architectures, revealing pre-training origins of cultural binding.
A knowledge-probing framework that quantifies the gap (3-5x) between stored cultural knowledge and model behavior, diagnosing routing bottlenecks in LLM cultural reasoning.
idea_ch: 一种识别和调控LLM中间层注意力头以控制文化绑定的方法，可在保持中性推理的同时实现跨文化群体的差异化处理
一种针对特定注意力头上身份-物品边的敲除技术，可将文化绑定强度降低9-23%，用于校准模型的文化敏感性
一种α缩放引导机制（α=2-3），可将文化区分准确率提升1-3个百分点且不损害中性推理性能
一种跨架构可迁移的文化注意力头识别方法，适用于不同架构的基础模型和指令模型，揭示文化绑定的预训练起源
一种知识探测框架，量化模型存储的文化知识与实际行为之间的差距（3-5倍），诊断LLM文化推理中的路由瓶颈

title: Modeling Vehicle-Type-Specific Pedestrian Crash Avoidance Behavior in Safety-Critical Interactions Using Smooth-Mamba Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: As automated vehicles (AVs) increasingly share roadways with human-driven vehicles (HDVs), understanding how pedestrians respond to different vehicle types in safety-critical interactions is essential for the safe deployment of automated driving technologies. This study extracts safety-critical pedestrian-vehicle interactions from the Argoverse 2 dataset to capture real-world crash avoidance behaviors in encounters involving AVs and HDVs. To model vehicle-type-specific pedestrian crash avoidance behavior, we develop a Smooth-Mamba Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient framework, termed SMamba-DDPG, which integrates smooth action constraints with efficient temporal representation learning. To quantify pedestrian behavioral differences, the framework trains separate crash avoidance policies for pedestrian interactions with AVs and HDVs. Results show that SMamba-DDPG outperforms baseline reinforcement learning and supervised learning models in reproducing pedestrian crash avoidance behaviors. Reconstructed trajectories demonstrate strong behavioral realism, accurately reproducing crash avoidance kinematics in both AV and HDV scenarios. Reaction time analysis shows that the model captures human-like response delays and reveals that pedestrians respond more quickly to AVs than to HDVs. Counterfactual analysis further indicates that pedestrians adopt lower crossing speeds when interacting with AVs. Large-scale safety analysis of model-generated data revealed that pedestrian-AV interactions consistently yielded lower conflict rates and higher pedestrian yielding rates compared to pedestrian-HDV interactions. The findings highlight the importance of incorporating vehicle-type-specific pedestrian behavioral models for safer automated driving system design and more realistic traffic simulations in mixed-traffic environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SMamba-DDPG框架，用于建模行人与自动驾驶车辆（AV）及人类驾驶车辆（HDV）在安全关键交互中的避碰行为。研究表明行人对AV的反应更快、穿越速度更低，且AV场景下冲突率更低、礼让率更高。
AI.motivation: 在混合交通环境中，理解行人对不同类型车辆（AV与HDV）的避碰行为差异，对于自动驾驶技术的安全部署至关重要，但现有研究缺乏对车辆类型特异性行为建模的深入分析。
AI.method: 提出Smooth-Mamba Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (SMamba-DDPG) 框架，集成平滑动作约束与高效时序表征学习，分别训练行人与AV及HDV交互的避碰策略。
AI.result: SMamba-DDPG优于基线强化学习与监督学习模型；行人对AV反应更快、穿越速度更低；AV交互场景下冲突率更低、行人礼让率更高。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调在自动驾驶系统设计与混合交通仿真中，需引入车辆类型特异性的行人行为模型，以提升安全性与真实感。
idea_en: 1. A reinforcement learning framework (SMamba-DDPG) integrating smooth action constraints with Mamba-based temporal representation learning for modeling pedestrian crash avoidance behaviors.
2. Vehicle-type-specific pedestrian behavior modeling method that separately trains policies for AV and HDV interactions.
3. A counterfactual analysis method using learned policies to reveal behavioral differences (e.g., crossing speed, reaction time) of pedestrians toward different vehicle types.
4. Large-scale safety evaluation methodology using model-generated pedestrian trajectories to compare conflict rates and yielding rates between AV-pedestrian and HDV-pedestrian interactions.
idea_ch: 1. 一种集成平滑动作约束与Mamba时序表征学习的强化学习框架（SMamba-DDPG），用于建模行人避碰行为。
2. 车辆类型特异性行人行为建模方法，分别为AV和HDV交互场景训练独立的避碰策略。
3. 利用学习到的策略进行反事实分析的方法，揭示行人对不同车辆类型的行为差异（如穿越速度、反应时间）。
4. 基于模型生成轨迹的大规模安全评估方法，用于比较AV-行人与HDV-行人交互中的冲突率与礼让率。

title: Refusal Before Decoding: Detecting and Exploiting Refusal Signals in Intermediate LLM Activations
summary: In this paper, we investigate whether refusal behavior can be predicted from LLM intermediate activations before decoding using linear probes trained on residual stream activations at each transformer block. We find that refusal is linearly decodable well before the final layer, indicating that safety-relevant behavior is represented in intermediate activations before output generation. To test whether this signal is actionable, we introduce Mechanistic AutoDAN, a probe-guided variant of AutoDAN that replaces full-model fitness evaluation with partial forward passes and probe-based scoring inside a genetic prompt search loop. Across the evaluated models, our method achieves attack success rates competitive with vanilla AutoDAN while reducing per-iteration search time by up to 72%, and probe-guided prompts match or exceed AutoDAN's cross-model transfer in several configurations. We further find that the usefulness of probe guidance increases with model scale. Our results show that refusal is not only observable at the output level, but is encoded as a structured and actionable signal in intermediate LLM activations.

AI.tldr: 本文通过线性探针从LLM中间激活中解码拒绝行为，并提出Mechanistic AutoDAN方法，利用探针引导的遗传搜索实现高效越狱攻击，减少72%搜索时间且保持竞争性攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: 探究LLM的拒绝行为是否在解码前的中间层激活中即可预测，以及这种中间信号是否可用于加速越狱攻击。
AI.method: 在残差流激活上训练线性探针，预测拒绝行为；提出Mechanistic AutoDAN，用部分前向传播和探针评分替代完整模型适应度评估，嵌入遗传提示搜索循环。
AI.result: 拒绝行为在远早于最终层的中间层即可线性解码；Mechanistic AutoDAN攻击成功率与AutoDAN相当，每轮搜索时间减少72%；探针引导的提示在跨模型迁移上表现匹配或超越；探针引导的有效性随模型规模增大而提升。
AI.conclusion: LLM的拒绝行为不仅在输出层可观察，还在中间激活中编码为结构化、可操作的信号，可被用于加速安全攻击。
idea_en: Method and system for predicting LLM refusal behavior using linear probes trained on intermediate residual stream activations, enabling early detection of safety-related responses before full decoding.

Mechanistic AutoDAN: A probe-guided genetic search algorithm for jailbreak attacks that replaces full-model fitness evaluation with partial forward passes and probe-based scoring, reducing computational cost.
System for cross-model transferable jailbreak prompts generated via probe-guided scoring, achieving competitive attack success rates across different LLM architectures.
Scalable probe guidance method for jailbreak attacks where probe effectiveness increases with model scale, enabling efficient attacks on larger language models.
idea_ch: 基于中间残差流激活训练的线性探针预测LLM拒绝行为的方法，可在解码前早期检测安全相关响应。
Mechanistic AutoDAN：探针引导的遗传搜索越狱攻击方法，用部分前向传播和探针评分替代完整模型评估，降低计算成本。
跨模型可迁移的探针引导越狱提示生成系统，在不同LLM架构上实现竞争性攻击成功率。
随模型规模递增的探针引导越狱攻击方法，实现对更大语言模型的高效攻击。

title: A Matter of TASTE: Improving Coverage and Difficulty of Agent Benchmarks
summary: As agent capabilities advance, existing benchmarks, such as $τ^2$-Bench, are becoming increasingly saturated.
