Yet constructing new benchmark tasks remains complex, costly, and labor-intensive. Moreover, the standard approach, in which scenarios are first written in natural language and then mapped to tool sequences, captures only a narrow subset of the tool-use patterns agents exercise. In this paper, we address these problems by reversing the task construction process. We propose TASTE: Task Synthesis from Tool Sequence Evolution, an automatic method that generates challenging tasks with broader tool-use coverage. TASTE utilizes an Adaptive Contrastive $n$-gram model trained on LLM-judged validity signals. This enables sampling valid tool sequences that cover a vast range of tool combinations. TASTE then selects representative sequences from the pool via clustering, instantiates them into complete benchmark tasks, and refines them through iterative difficulty evolution. Using TASTE, we construct $τ^c$-Bench, a challenging extension of the three domains of $τ^2$-Bench. We evaluate $11$ agent/user LLM pairs and find that models nearly saturating $τ^2$-Bench suffer severe performance drops on our tasks (e.g., Gemini-3-Flash falls from $0.82\!-\!0.94$ to $0.28\!-\!0.61$). Beyond increasing difficulty, our generated tasks more than double the number of unique tool combinations agents must execute. Our results suggest high scores on existing benchmarks often reflect saturation rather than robust task-solving ability. By automating the generation of difficult, high-coverage benchmarks, TASTE enables continuous, scalable evaluation of future agents.

AI.tldr: TASTE提出了一种逆向任务构建方法，通过自适应对比n-gram模型、聚类选择和迭代难度进化，自动生成覆盖更广泛工具组合的困难基准测试任务，构建了τ^c-Bench，揭示现有基准的高分实际是饱和现象而非真正的任务解决能力。
AI.motivation: 现有基准（如τ^2-Bench）逐渐饱和，且传统任务构建方法（自然语言→工具序列）复杂昂贵，只能覆盖有限的工具使用模式。
AI.method: TASTE包含三个步骤：(1) 使用自适应对比n-gram模型在LLM评判的有效性信号上训练，采样大量有效的工具序列；(2) 通过聚类选择代表性序列；(3) 将序列实例化为完整基准任务，并通过迭代难度进化进行优化。
AI.result: 构建了τ^c-Bench，包含三个领域。评估11个agent/LLM对发现，在τ^2-Bench上接近饱和的模型在τ^c-Bench上性能大幅下降（如Gemini-3-Flash从0.82-0.94降至0.28-0.61）。生成的工具组合数量翻倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 现有基准的高分反映的是饱和而非鲁棒任务解决能力；TASTE通过自动化生成困难、高覆盖率的基准，支持未来智能体的持续可扩展评估。
idea_en: Adaptive Contrastive n-gram model trained on LLM-judged validity signals for sampling valid tool sequences
Reverse task construction process that generates benchmark tasks from tool sequences rather than from natural language
Iterative difficulty evolution mechanism for refining benchmark tasks
Clustering-based representative sequence selection from a pool of tool sequences for maximum coverage
Automatic method for generating benchmark tasks with broader tool-use coverage than traditional approaches
idea_ch: 基于LLM评判的有效性信号训练的自适应对比n-gram模型，用于采样有效的工具序列
逆向任务构建方法：从工具序列生成基准任务，而非从自然语言映射到工具序列
迭代难度进化机制，用于逐步优化基准任务的难度
基于聚类的代表性序列选择方法，从工具序列池中选择最大覆盖率的序列
自动生成比传统方法覆盖更广泛工具使用模式的基准任务的方法

title: Tree of Thoughts as a Classical Heuristic Search Problem: Formal Foundations and Design Patterns
comment: Extended version of the SoCS 2026 paper. Includes appendices omitted from the proceedings version
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable reasoning capabilities, yet their standard generation process -- auto-regressive token prediction -- is inherently myopic and prone to cascading errors. To address this, the Tree-of-Thoughts (ToT) framework creates a search space over intermediate reasoning steps, allowing search models to explore, look ahead, and backtrack. However, current ToT research remains fragmented across Natural Language Processing and Automated Planning communities, often using inconsistent terminology and ad-hoc implementations. Consequently, we synthesize the ToT landscape through a unified taxonomy based on classical heuristic search terminology. We map LLM-based reasoning to classical search components: state representation (granularity of thoughts), successor generation (prompting operators), and heuristic evaluation (self-assessment of progress). We analyze existing work within the context of our taxonomy and identify emerging design patterns: systematic search (Best-First Search) for shallow, deterministic tasks and lookahead-heavy strategies (DFS, MCTS) for deep multi-step reasoning. We conclude by identifying open algorithmic challenges at the intersection of heuristic search and LLM reasoning, and call on the heuristic search community to engage with this emerging domain.

AI.tldr: 本文通过统一的启发式搜索术语分类法，系统化了Tree-of-Thoughts（ToT）框架在LLM推理中的应用，将LLM推理映射为经典搜索组件（状态表示、后继生成、启发式评估），并识别出不同类型任务对应的搜索策略模式。
AI.motivation: 当前ToT研究在NLP和自动规划社区之间碎片化，术语不一致、实现随意，缺乏统一的框架来理解和比较不同方法。
AI.method: 提出基于经典启发式搜索术语的统一分类法，将LLM推理映射为：状态表示（思维粒度）、后继生成（提示操作符）、启发式评估（自我进度评估），并用该分类法分析现有工作。
AI.result: 识别出两种设计模式：浅层确定性任务使用系统搜索（Best-First Search），深层多步推理使用前瞻性策略（DFS、MCTS）。
AI.conclusion: 指出了启发式搜索与LLM推理交叉领域的开放算法挑战，并呼吁启发式搜索社区参与这一新兴领域。
idea_en: A unified taxonomy mapping LLM-based Chain-of-Thought reasoning to classical heuristic search components (state representation, successor generation, heuristic evaluation), enabling systematic comparison and design of ToT methods.
An adaptive search strategy selector that automatically chooses between Best-First Search for shallow deterministic tasks and DFS/MCTS for deep multi-step reasoning based on task characteristics.
A self-assessment heuristic evaluation mechanism where LLMs evaluate their own progress toward a goal, enabling informed backtracking and lookahead decisions without external reward models.
idea_ch: 一种将LLM推理映射到经典启发式搜索组件的统一分类法，包括状态表示（思维粒度）、后继生成（提示操作符）和启发式评估（自我进度评估），实现对ToT方法的系统比较与设计
自适应搜索策略选择机制，根据任务特征在浅层确定性任务的Best-First Search与深层多步推理的DFS/MCTS之间自动切换
基于LLM自我评估的启发式评估机制，使模型无需外部奖励模型即可评估自身推理进度，从而实现智能回溯和前瞻决策

title: A Conflict-Aware Penalty and Statistical Loss Framework for Balancing Modalities and Enhancing Stability in Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
summary: Multimodal Sentiment Analysis (MSA) fuses text, acoustic, and visual streams to infer sentiment. Because pre-trained text encoders are far more expressive than their acoustic and visual counterparts, the text modality tends to dominate optimization, suppressing weaker modalities and inducing gradient norm conflicts that destabilize training. To address this, we propose a Conflict-aware Penalty (CP) that detects and penalizes gradient norm conflicts at each training step, and a Statistical Loss (SL) that aligns predicted distribution statistics with empirical input statistics. Crucially, CP prevents dominant modality gradients from interfering with the SL objective, enabling synergistic training within a unified framework incorporating adaptive modality encoding, gated cross-modal fusion, and unimodal auxiliary heads. Experiments on CMU-MOSI demonstrate state-of-the-art performance, with ablation studies confirming the effectiveness of each component.

AI.tldr: 提出冲突感知惩罚(CP)和统计损失(SL)来解决多模态情感分析中文本模态主导训练导致梯度冲突的问题，在CMU-MOSI上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 多模态情感分析中，预训练文本编码器远强于声学和视觉编码器，导致文本模态主导优化过程，压制弱模态并产生梯度范数冲突，造成训练不稳定。
AI.method: 1) 冲突感知惩罚(CP)：检测并惩罚训练过程中梯度范数冲突；2) 统计损失(SL)：对齐预测分布统计量与经验输入统计量；3) CP防止主导模态梯度干扰SL目标，实现协同训练；4) 统一框架包含自适应模态编码、门控跨模态融合和单模态辅助头。
AI.result: 在CMU-MOSI数据集上取得最先进性能，消融研究证实各组件有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效缓解了多模态训练中的模态不平衡问题，通过梯度冲突惩罚和统计分布对齐实现了更好的多模态协同。
idea_en: A conflict-aware penalty method for multimodal training that detects gradient norm conflicts between modalities and applies penalties to prevent dominant modality gradients from suppressing weaker modalities
A statistical loss function that aligns predicted distribution statistics with empirical input statistics for multimodal sentiment analysis
A unified multimodal framework integrating conflict-aware penalty, statistical loss, adaptive modality encoding, gated cross-modal fusion, and unimodal auxiliary heads
A gradient conflict detection mechanism that identifies when dominant modality gradients interfere with statistical distribution alignment objectives
A method for stabilizing multimodal training by penalizing gradient conflicts while preserving synergistic cross-modal learning
idea_ch: 一种多模态训练中的冲突感知惩罚方法，检测模态间梯度范数冲突并对主导模态梯度施加惩罚，防止其压制弱模态
一种统计损失函数，将预测分布统计量与经验输入统计量对齐，用于多模态情感分析
一种统一的多模态框架，集成冲突感知惩罚、统计损失、自适应模态编码、门控跨模态融合和单模态辅助头
一种梯度冲突检测机制，识别主导模态梯度何时干扰统计分布对齐目标
一种通过惩罚梯度冲突同时保持协同跨模态学习的多模态训练稳定化方法

title: Continual Model Routing in Evolving Model Hubs
comment: 42 pages, 24 tables, 6 figures, to be published at ICML 2026
summary: AI model hubs provide access to a rapidly growing collection of powerful pre-trained models, enabling off-the-shelf mixture-of-experts systems with different routing strategies. However, this rapid growth poses two fundamental challenges: scaling model selection across thousands of experts and continually updating routing mechanisms as new models and tasks are introduced. In this paper, we formalise this setting as Continual Model Routing (CMR) and propose CMRBench, a new large-scale benchmark simulating realistic hub expansion and including over 2,000 candidate models. Finally, we introduce CARvE, a contrastive embedding approach for efficient continual model routing via checkpoint-based anchoring and structured replay. Extensive empirical results and ablations show that CARvE significantly outperforms zero-shot retrieval, fine-tuning, and adapter-merging baselines in model, family, and domain-level accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出持续模型路由(CMR)问题、构建了含2000+模型的CMRBench基准，并设计了基于对比嵌入的CARvE方法实现高效路由。
AI.motivation: AI模型中心快速增长，面临两大挑战：跨数千专家模型的扩展性选择，以及新模型/任务不断加入时路由机制的持续更新。
AI.method: 提出CARvE对比嵌入方法，核心包括检查点锚定(checkpoint-based anchoring)和结构化重放(structured replay)，用于高效的持续模型路由。
AI.result: 在模型级、模型族级和领域级准确率上，CARvE显著优于零样本检索、微调和适配器融合等基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 对比嵌入结合检查点锚定与结构化重放，是解决持续模型路由问题的有效方案，可适应模型中心的动态扩展。
idea_en: Continual Model Routing (CMR) framework: A system that dynamically routes queries to the most appropriate pre-trained models from a growing hub, addressing both model selection scalability and routing mechanism updates.
CMRBench benchmark: A large-scale benchmark with over 2,000 candidate models designed to simulate realistic AI model hub expansion for evaluating continual routing strategies.
CARvE (Contrastive embedding approach for efficient continual model routing): A method using checkpoint-based anchoring to create stable reference embeddings for known models.
Structured replay mechanism in CARvE: A technique that replays representative samples from previously seen models to prevent catastrophic forgetting during continual routing updates.
Contrastive embedding learning for model routing: Training embedding spaces where models performing well on similar tasks/domains are pulled closer, enabling efficient nearest-neighbor routing.
Checkpoint-based anchoring: Using model checkpoint features as anchor points in embedding space for stable and efficient model identification and routing.
idea_ch: 持续模型路由(CMR)框架：一种从不断增长的模型中心动态路由查询到最合适预训练模型的系统，同时解决模型选择可扩展性和路由机制更新问题。
CMRBench基准测试：包含2000多个候选模型的大规模基准，设计用于模拟真实的AI模型中心扩展场景，评估持续路由策略。
CARvE对比嵌入方法：一种使用检查点锚定技术为已知模型创建稳定参考嵌入的高效持续模型路由方法。
CARvE中的结构化重放机制：通过重放先前见过模型的代表性样本，防止持续路由更新过程中的灾难性遗忘。
面向模型路由的对比嵌入学习：训练嵌入空间使得在相似任务/领域上表现良好的模型互相靠近，实现高效的近邻路由。
检查点锚定技术：利用模型检查点特征作为嵌入空间中的锚点，实现稳定高效的模型识别和路由定位。

title: MUSE: Benchmarking Manufacturable, Functional, and Assemblable Text-to-CAD Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have recently advanced text-driven 3D generation, yet Text-to-CAD remains far from supporting industrial product design. Existing benchmarks focus primarily on generating single-part CAD models and evaluate them using geometric similarity metrics that fail to capture functionality, manufacturability, and assemblability. To address this gap, we introduce MUSE, a Text-to-CAD benchmark focused on complex, editable boundary representation (B-Rep) assemblies. MUSE pairs practical design instances with structured Design Specifications and evaluates generated models through a three-stage protocol: code check, geometric check, and design-intent alignment. The final stage uses design-specific rubrics to assess functionality, manufacturability, and assemblability, moving beyond shape matching toward practical design quality. To enable scalable evaluation, we use a rubric-based visual language model (VLM) judge and validate its reliability through human annotation. Experiments on closed-source and open-source LLMs reveal a clear failure cascade from executable code to valid geometry and finally to engineering-ready design, with even the strongest models achieving limited success on fine-grained engineering criteria. Together, MUSE provides a realistic benchmark and evaluation framework for advancing Text-to-CAD from geometric generation toward true engineering design. Our project website, including the leaderboard, dataset, and code, is available at https://dong7313.github.io/muse-benchmark/.

AI.tldr: MUSE是一个面向复杂、可编辑B-Rep装配体的Text-to-CAD基准测试，通过三阶段评估协议（代码检查、几何检查、设计意图对齐）和基于VLM的评判机制，推动从几何生成走向真正的工程设计。
AI.motivation: 现有Text-to-CAD基准主要关注单部件CAD模型，使用几何相似性指标评估，无法捕捉功能性、可制造性和可装配性等工程关键要素。
AI.method: 构建包含复杂B-Rep装配体的数据集，配对结构化设计规范；设计三阶段评估协议：代码检查、几何检查和设计意图对齐；采用基于VLM的评判器并结合人工标注验证可靠性。
AI.result: 实验发现从可执行代码到有效几何再到工程就绪设计存在明显的失败级联，即使最强模型在细粒度工程标准上表现有限。
AI.conclusion: MUSE为Text-to-CAD从几何生成走向真正的工程设计提供了现实基准和评估框架。
idea_en: A three-stage evaluation protocol for Text-to-CAD comprising code check, geometric check, and design-intent alignment using design-specific rubrics
A rubric-based visual language model (VLM) judge for automated assessment of CAD model functionality, manufacturability, and assemblability
A structured Design Specification framework that pairs practical design instances with editable boundary representation (B-Rep) assemblies for Text-to-CAD benchmarking
A failure cascade analysis method for diagnosing Text-to-CAD models across executable code, valid geometry, and engineering-ready design levels
idea_ch: 一种面向Text-to-CAD的三阶段评估协议，包括代码检查、几何检查和基于特定设计标准的设计意图对齐
一种基于评分规则的视觉语言模型（VLM）评判器，用于自动化评估CAD模型的功能性、可制造性和可装配性
一种结构化设计规范框架，将实际设计实例与可编辑边界表示（B-Rep）装配体配对用于Text-to-CAD基准测试
一种失败级联分析方法，用于诊断Text-to-CAD模型在可执行代码、有效几何和工程就绪设计三个层次的表现

title: Satisfiability Solving with LLMs: A Matched-Pair Evaluation of Reasoning Capability
comment: Accepted at the ACM International Conference on the Foundations of Software Engineering (FSE 2026)
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for tasks that implicitly reduce to Boolean satisfiability (SAT), yet their reasoning ability on SAT remains unclear. We present a systematic study of LLMs on 2-SAT and 3-SAT, together with two canonical reductions, Vertex Cover and discrete 3D packing, to probe representation-invariant reasoning. We first evaluate models using conventional metrics, including accuracy, precision, recall, and F1, as well as the SAT phase-transition setting. We find that these metrics can be misleading: many models obtain high scores by over-predicting satisfiable formulas, fail to reproduce the classical easy-hard-easy signature around the 3-SAT threshold, and degrade sharply as the number of variables grows.
  To address this problem, we introduce a paired-formula protocol based on minimally different satisfiable and unsatisfiable instances, together with Accurate Differentiation Rate (ADR), which requires both members of each pair to be classified correctly. ADR separates reasoning-oriented models from heuristic ones and correlates with witness validity. Beyond CNF, we test cross-representation consistency by converting CNF to Vertex Cover and 3-SAT to discrete 3D packing. Model decisions on CNF and on the corresponding graph or packing instances agree for most models on more than 80 percent of instances, suggesting stable decision rules across representations. Overall, our results show that SAT is a conservative probe for LLM reasoning, and that paired evaluation with ADR provides a more faithful and representation-robust assessment than conventional metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了LLM在布尔可满足性（SAT）问题上的推理能力，发现传统评估指标（准确率、F1等）存在误导性，提出了基于配对实例的精确区分率（ADR）评估协议，并检验了跨表示（CNF、顶点覆盖、3D装箱）的一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有评估指标无法真实反映LLM在SAT问题上的推理能力，模型可能通过过度预测可满足实例获得高分，且跨表示的一致性未得到充分研究。
AI.method: 1) 在2-SAT和3-SAT上系统评估LLM；2) 引入配对的极小差异可满足/不可满足实例协议；3) 提出精确区分率（ADR）指标；4) 将CNF转换为顶点覆盖和3D装箱问题，测试跨表示一致性。
AI.result: 传统指标具有误导性；ADR能更好区分推理导向模型与启发式模型；大多数模型在CNF与对应图/装箱实例上的决策一致性超过80%。
AI.conclusion: SAT是LLM推理的保守探针，基于配对实例的ADR评估比传统指标更可靠且对表示形式更鲁棒。
idea_en: A paired-formula evaluation protocol for LLM reasoning on SAT problems, using minimally different satisfiable and unsatisfiable instances to test genuine logical reasoning ability.
Accurate Differentiation Rate (ADR) metric that requires correct classification of both instances in a pair, providing a more faithful assessment than accuracy or F1.
Cross-representation consistency testing method that transforms CNF SAT problems to Vertex Cover and discrete 3D packing to probe representation-invariant reasoning in LLMs.
A systematic phase-transition analysis framework for evaluating LLM reasoning on 3-SAT, using the classical easy-hard-easy signature as a diagnostic tool.
idea_ch: 一种基于配对实例的LLM SAT推理评估协议，通过极小差异的可满足与不可满足实例对来测试真正的逻辑推理能力。
精确区分率（ADR）指标，要求正确分类配对中的两个实例，提供比准确率或F1更可信的评估方法。
跨表示一致性测试方法，将CNF SAT问题转化为顶点覆盖和离散3D装箱问题，探测LLM的表示不变推理能力。
一种系统性的相变分析框架，利用经典的三SAT易-难-易特征作为诊断工具评估LLM推理能力。

title: Adaptive Multimodal Agents-Based Framework for Automatic Workflow Execution
comment: Copyright 2026 IEEE. Personal use of this material is permitted. Permission from IEEE must be obtained for all other uses. Accepted for publication at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Evolving and Adaptive Intelligent Systems (EAIS 2026)
summary: Modern information systems require autonomous agents capable of navigating complex workflows, yet current methodologies often struggle with the transition from structured metadata parsing to general environmental perception. While the integration of MLLMs has enabled agents to interact directly with GUIs, existing approaches typically treat task sequences as discrete, linear episodes. This fragmentation prevents agents from capturing the underlying transition topology, limiting their effectiveness in novel or non-stationary scenarios. To address this, we propose a novel multimodal multi-agent framework that achieves automatic workflow execution through a distinct two-phase pipeline. First, during an offline discovery phase, the architecture adaptively constructs a topological knowledge base from fragmented execution logs. During inference, agents leverage Adaptive Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) over this fixed, pre-established graph, coupled with a closed-loop collaborative verification protocol to dynamically self-correct and navigate. This graph-based approach facilitates superior task decomposition and adaptive navigation performance. We validate our framework in a real-world context, demonstrating its ability to maintain high reliability and semantic awareness even with limited training data.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于拓扑知识图谱和多模态多智能体框架的自动工作流执行方法，通过离线构建拓扑知识库和在线自适应RAG检索实现复杂GUI工作流导航。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将任务序列视为离散线性片段，无法捕获底层转移拓扑，导致在新颖或非平稳场景下效果受限。
AI.method: 两阶段流水线：1) 离线发现阶段，从碎片化执行日志自适应构建拓扑知识库（有向图结构）；2) 推理阶段，基于固定知识图谱进行自适应RAG检索，结合闭环协作验证协议实现动态自纠错和导航。
AI.result: 在真实场景中验证，即使在有限训练数据下也能保持高可靠性和语义感知能力。
AI.conclusion: 基于图的拓扑方法优于传统的离散线性任务序列方法，在有限数据下仍能有效工作。
idea_en: A multimodal multi-agent framework with offline topological knowledge base construction from fragmented execution logs
Adaptive Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) over a pre-established graph structure for workflow navigation
Closed-loop collaborative verification protocol enabling dynamic self-correction during task execution
Adaptive topological graph construction method that captures transition topology from fragmented logs
idea_ch: 一种从碎片化执行日志自适应构建拓扑知识库的多模态多智能体框架
基于预建立有向图结构的自适应检索增强生成(RAG)工作流导航方法
闭环协作验证协议，实现任务执行过程中的动态自纠错机制
从碎片化日志中捕获转移拓扑的自适应拓扑图构建方法

title: LACUNA: Safe Agents as Recursive Program Holes
summary: LLM agents increasingly act by writing code, yet a split persists between the runtime that drives the agent and the code the model writes. The runtime owns the loop, context, and control flow, and the model has little say over any of them. Letting model-written code shape the runtime itself would make agents more expressive, but it would also sharpen safety problems. A model can be diverted by a prompt injection, call the wrong tool, or fail partway and leave an inconsistent state, and each such failure reaches further when the code shapes the runtime than when it expresses a single action. We present LACUNA, a programming model for agents that closes this split while preserving safety. Each agent action is a typed call $\texttt{agent[T](task)}$ that the LLM fills with code when execution reaches it, and the code is type-checked against the surrounding program before it runs. Because each action is accepted or rejected as a whole, a rejected one leaves the environment untouched, and its compiler diagnostics drive a retry. The same check also bounds which tools and data an action may use and how they flow. Our primitive expresses ReAct loops, sub-agents, skills, parallel decomposition, and multi-model planning as ordinary control flow. We evaluate LACUNA on a collection of test cases, BrowseComp-Plus, and $τ^2$-bench. On BrowseComp-Plus, $8.6\%$ of generations are rejected before execution, with 0.7 retries per query on average, and the agent reaches $27.1\%$ accuracy. On $τ^2$-bench, LACUNA solves $76.0\%$ of $392$ tasks across four domains with a capable model, on par with the baseline agent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LACUNA，一种通过类型化agent[T](task)调用将LLM生成代码与运行时深度融合的编程模型，在保证安全性的同时让模型代码塑造运行时。每个动作在被执行前都会进行类型检查，拒绝的动作不会改变环境状态。该方法在BrowseComp-Plus和τ²-bench上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代理中，运行时（runtime）与模型生成的代码之间存在割裂：运行时拥有循环、上下文和控制流的控制权，而模型对这些几乎没有发言权。这种分离限制了代理的表达能力，同时若让模型代码影响运行时又会引发安全问题。
AI.method: LACUNA提出agent[T](task)类型化调用原语，LLM在执行到达时填充代码，代码在运行前会与周围程序进行类型检查。每个动作被整体接受或拒绝，拒绝时环境不受影响，编译器诊断信息用于重试。类型检查同时约束动作可使用的工具、数据及其流向。
AI.result: 在BrowseComp-Plus上，8.6%的生成在执行前被拒绝，每次查询平均0.7次重试，准确率达到27.1%。在τ²-bench上，LACUNA解决了392个任务中的76.0%，与基线代理表现相当。
AI.conclusion: LACUNA通过类型化编程模型弥合了代理运行时与模型生成代码之间的鸿沟，在保持安全性的同时提升了表达力。ReAct循环、子代理、技能、并行分解和多模型规划等均可作为普通控制流实现。
idea_en: A typed agent-call primitive agent[T](task) that allows LLM-generated code to shape runtime execution while being type-checked against the surrounding program before execution.
A safety mechanism where each agent action is accepted or rejected as a whole, with rejected actions leaving the environment untouched, and compiler diagnostics driving automatic retry.
Type-checking system that bounds which tools and data an agent action may use and how data flows between them, ensuring safety boundaries.
Unified programming model enabling ReAct loops, sub-agents, skills, parallel decomposition, and multi-model planning as ordinary control flow constructs.
idea_ch: 一种类型化的agent[T](task)调用原语，允许LLM生成的代码在执行前与周围程序进行类型检查，从而塑造运行时行为。
一种整体接受或拒绝机制：被拒绝的代理动作不改变环境状态，利用编译器诊断信息自动驱动重试，保证安全性。
类型检查系统约束代理动作可使用的工具、数据及其流向，在运行时前建立安全边界。
统一编程模型，将ReAct循环、子代理、技能、并行分解和多模型规划等作为普通控制流构造实现。

title: Bandwidth-Efficient and Privacy-Preserving Edge-Cloud Many-to-Many Speech Translation
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated significant potential for speech-to-text translation (S2TT). However, existing deployment paradigms face critical challenges: pure on-device models suffer from resource constraints, while centralized cloud systems incur severe privacy risks and bandwidth bottlenecks by transmitting raw voice data. Furthermore, most models exhibit English-centric biases, restricting many-to-many translation scaling. In this paper, we propose Edge-cloud Speech Recognition and Translation (ESRT), a privacy-preserving and bandwidth-efficient collaborative edge-cloud MLLM framework. Specifically, we design an edge-cloud split inference architecture that retains a lightweight speech encoder and adapter on the device, transmitting only highly compressed intermediate features to the cloud. This fundamentally prevents voiceprint leakage and reduces bandwidth requirements by up to 10$\times$. To overcome English-centric bottlenecks, we introduce a multi-task weighted curriculum learning strategy with data balancing to ensure robust cross-lingual consistency. Extensive experiments on the FLEURS dataset demonstrate that our models, ESRT-4B and ESRT-12B, achieve state-of-the-art many-to-many S2TT performance across 45 languages ($45 \times 44$ directions). Code and models are released to facilitate reproducible, privacy-aware MLLM S2TT research. The code and models are released at https://github.com/yxduir/esrt.

AI.tldr: ESRT提出了一种隐私保护、带宽高效的边缘-云协同多模态大语言模型框架，用于多语言语音到文本翻译，在45种语言上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM在语音翻译中面临三重挑战：纯端侧模型资源受限、云端传输原始语音数据存在隐私风险和带宽瓶颈、多数模型存在英语中心化偏见限制多对多翻译扩展。
AI.method: 设计了边缘-云拆分推理架构，设备端保留轻量级语音编码器和适配器，仅传输高度压缩的中间特征到云端；引入多任务加权课程学习策略与数据平衡，实现鲁棒的跨语言一致性。
AI.result: 在FLEURS数据集上，ESRT-4B和ESRT-12B在45种语言（45×44个方向）的多对多语音翻译任务上达到SOTA性能，带宽需求降低10倍。
AI.conclusion: ESRT通过边缘-云协同架构有效解决了隐私、带宽和英语中心化问题，为可复现的隐私感知MLLM语音翻译研究提供了基础。
idea_en: Edge-cloud split inference architecture for speech translation that transmits only compressed intermediate features to prevent voiceprint leakage and reduce bandwidth
Multi-task weighted curriculum learning strategy with data balancing for robust cross-lingual consistency in many-to-many S2TT
Lightweight speech encoder and adapter retained on-device enabling privacy-preserving collaborative inference with cloud-based large language model
idea_ch: 一种边缘-云拆分推理的语音翻译架构，仅传输压缩的中间特征到云端，从根本上防止声纹泄露并降低带宽需求
一种多任务加权课程学习策略与数据平衡方法，用于在多对多语音翻译中实现鲁棒的跨语言一致性
一种在设备端保留轻量级语音编码器和适配器、与云端大语言模型协作的隐私保护推理方法

title: The Ethics of LLM Sandbox and Persona Dynamics
summary: It is well known that LLM guardrails and trained persona dynamics can produce a reality gap: the distance between the world a LLM is permitted or shaped to describe, and the world in which users must act. Here we argue that actively generating reality gaps is in fact unethical because it knowingly shifts epistemic risk back to the uninformed user -- this is reality laundering. This can potentially cause harm when operationalised at scale. The risk is sharpest in high-exposure advice contexts, where users seek orientation rather than a bounded, externally checkable task. Guardrails naively appear ethically necessary when they claim to prevent direct harm, but often become suspect when they suppress truthful perception and launder uncomfortable mechanisms into acceptable abstractions. Basel-style financial regulation, B-BBEE-style compliance, Societe Generale, and the London Whale show how formal safety systems can become legible, gameable, and performative while real exposure migrates elsewhere. The same pattern can appear in LLMs as moral compliance: safe language, distorted reality. We therefore distinguish refusing harm, from refusing reality; and then argue for top-down causal requirements specification at the task level rather than bottom-up moral correction at the response or sandbox level. Persona dynamics matter because the assistant interface is not neutral; it shapes how uncertainty, conflict, authority, and risk are staged. The conclusion is that so-called ``ethical AI'' becomes substantively unethical when it substitutes institutional reassurance for contact with reality.

AI.tldr: 论文论证LLM护栏和角色动态会产生"现实差距"，而主动制造这种差距是"现实洗白"行为，不道德地将认知风险转移给不知情的用户，尤其在高风险建议场景中可能造成伤害。
AI.motivation: 揭示LLM安全护栏和角色设定看似伦理必要，实则可能通过过滤不适信息、美化现实而将认知风险转嫁给用户，造成实质性伤害。
AI.method: 通过类比金融监管（巴塞尔协议、B-BBEE合规、法国兴业银行、伦敦鲸事件）中的合规游戏化现象，分析LLM中道德合规的类似模式，提出从任务层进行自上而下的因果需求规范，替代自下而上的响应层道德纠正。
AI.result: 指出"伦理AI"在替代现实接触时可能变得实质性不道德，角色动态并非中立，而是塑造了不确定性、冲突、权威和风险的呈现方式。
AI.conclusion: 主张区分"拒绝伤害"与"拒绝现实"，提出应通过任务级因果需求规范而非响应级道德修正来解决这一问题。
idea_en: A system and method for detecting and quantifying 'reality laundering' in LLM responses by measuring the divergence between permitted/shaped outputs and ground-truth world state, providing a reality gap score.

A task-level causal requirements specification framework for LLMs that decomposes high-exposure advisory tasks into causal sub-components before response generation, ensuring factual transmission of uncomfortable mechanisms.
An LLM persona arbitration mechanism that dynamically adjusts assistant interface framing based on domain risk level, distinguishing between harm-prevention refusal and reality-suppression refusal.
A method for auditing LLM safety systems by tracking epistemic risk migration, identifying when compliance measures create performative safety that shifts real exposure to uninformed users.

A system for transparent layering of LLM guardrails that separates hard safety constraints from reality-presentation constraints, with explicit user-facing disclosure of which information categories are being shaped or filtered.
idea_ch: 一种检测和量化LLM响应中'现实洗白'的系统与方法，通过测量允许/塑造输出与现实世界状态之间的偏差，提供现实差距评分。
一种面向LLM的任务级因果需求规范框架，在高风险咨询任务生成响应前，将其分解为因果子组件，确保不适机制的真实传递。
一种LLM角色仲裁机制，根据领域风险等级动态调整助手界面框架，区分'防止伤害的拒绝'和'压制现实的拒绝'。
一种LLM安全系统审计方法，通过追踪认知风险迁移，识别合规措施何时创造了表演性安全，从而将真实风险转移给不知情用户。
一种LLM护栏透明分层系统，将硬性安全约束与现实呈现约束分离，并对用户明确披露哪些信息类别正在被塑造或过滤。

title: AutoScientists: Self-Organizing Agent Teams for Long-Running Scientific Experimentation
summary: Scientific research proceeds through iterative cycles of hypothesis generation, experiment design, execution, and revision. AI agents can automate parts of this process, but existing approaches typically follow a single research trajectory or coordinate through a central planner with fixed objectives. As a result, they struggle to sustain parallel exploration, adapt as experimental evidence changes, or preserve knowledge of failed directions over long-running experiments. We introduce AutoScientists, a decentralized team of AI agents for long-running computational scientific experimentation. Agents interpret a shared experimental state, self-organize into teams around promising hypotheses, critique proposals before using experimental compute, and share successes and failures to reduce redundant exploration. Under matched experimental budgets, AutoScientists improves over prior AI agents across biomedical machine learning, language-model training optimization, and protein fitness prediction. On BioML-Bench, spanning biomedical imaging, protein engineering, single-cell omics, and drug discovery, AutoScientists achieves a mean leaderboard percentile of 74.4% across 24 tasks, improving over the strongest AI agent by +8.33%. On GPT training optimization, AutoScientists reaches a target validation bits-per-byte 1.9x faster than Autoresearch and continues discovering improvements from a starting champion where the single-agent approach finds none (7 vs. 0 accepted improvements). On ProteinGym fitness prediction, AutoScientists discovers a method for ACE2-Spike binding that improves over the current state-of-the-art model by +12.5% in Spearman correlation. Applied without modification across all 217 ProteinGym assays, the same method improves over the prior state of the art by +6.5% (Spearman correlation).

AI.tldr: 提出AutoScientists——一个去中心化AI agent团队，通过共享实验状态、自我组织、批判提案、共享成败，实现长期计算科学实验的并行探索与自适应迭代。
AI.motivation: 现有AI agent在长期实验中难以维持并行探索、无法随实验证据变化自适应调整、无法保留失败方向的知识。
AI.method: 去中心化AI agent团队架构，agent解释共享实验状态、围绕有希望假说自组织团队、提案批判机制、共享成功与失败以减少重复探索。
AI.result: BioML-Bench 24个任务平均排名74.4%领先8.33%；GPT训练优化达目标验证bits-per-byte速度1.9倍提升；ProteinGym ACE2-Spike结合预测Spearman相关性提升12.5%。
AI.conclusion: 去中心化多agent协作框架在长期计算科学实验中的有效性远超单agent或中心化方案。
idea_en: A decentralized multi-agent system for scientific experimentation where agents interpret shared experimental state and self-organize into teams around promising hypotheses without a central planner.
A critique-before-execution mechanism for AI agents that evaluates and filters experimental proposals before consuming computational resources.
A shared knowledge repository that preserves both successful and failed experimental directions to reduce redundant exploration across parallel agents.
A self-organizing team formation method where agents dynamically regroup based on emerging experimental evidence and hypothesis promise.
idea_ch: 一种去中心化多智能体科学实验系统，智能体解析共享实验状态并围绕有前途的假说自主组织成团队，无需中央规划器。
一种先批判后执行的智能体机制，在消耗计算资源之前对实验提案进行评估和筛选。
一种共享知识库，保留成功和失败的实验方向，减少并行智能体间的冗余探索。
一种自组织团队形成方法，智能体根据不断变化的实验证据和假说前景动态重组。

title: An LLM-Based Assistance System for Intuitive and Flexible Capability-Based Planning
summary: In modern industry, dynamic environments and the complexity of modular and reconfigurable resources require automated planning of process sequences. Capability-based planning approaches address this by automatically generating plans from semantic knowledge models that describe resource functions in a machine-interpretable form. Their practical use, however, remains limited: solver feedback, especially in the case of unsatisfiability, is difficult to interpret, and the knowledge models require adaptation as operational conditions change or requests become infeasible. This paper presents a hybrid assistance system that augments an existing capability-based Satisfiability Modulo Theories (SMT) planning approach with an Large Language Model (LLM)-based layer for natural-language interaction, explanation, and adaptation. Formal planning correctness remains with the symbolic planner, while the LLM layer handles natural-language access and flexible knowledge model adaptation under explicit Human-in-the-Loop (HitL) approval. The system decomposes into four components: Capability Grounding, Symbolic Planning, Result Interpretation, and Planning Adaptation, realized as a routed agentic workflow in which a central router delegates to five specialized agents. The system is evaluated on a modular production system across four scenario types. Of 23 test cases, 9 of 10 knowledge queries and all 4 satisfiable planning cases were handled correctly, 3 of 4 unsatisfiable cases produced concrete repair proposals, and all 5 adaptive planning scenarios resolved into satisfiable plans through iterative, user-approved knowledge model modifications. The findings confirm that combining formal planning with LLM-based assistance substantially improves accessibility and adaptability in industrial automation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种混合辅助系统，将基于能力的形式化SMT规划与LLM自然语言交互层相结合，通过人机协作实现工业自动化规划的可解释性、可适应性和可用性提升。
AI.motivation: 基于能力的规划方法在工业自动化中具有潜力，但存在两个关键局限：一是求解器反馈（尤其当规划不可满足时）难以解释；二是知识模型在操作条件变化或请求不可行时需要人工调整，缺乏灵活性。
AI.method: 系统包含四个核心组件：能力基础化（Capability Grounding）、符号规划（Symbolic Planning）、结果解释（Result Interpretation）和规划自适应（Planning Adaptation）。采用路由代理工作流架构，中央路由器将任务分派给五个专门代理，LLM层处理自然语言交互和知识模型自适应，符号规划器保证规划正确性，所有模型修改需经人类审批。
AI.result: 在模块化生产系统上评估了23个测试用例：10个知识查询中9个正确处理，4个可满足规划全部正确，4个不可满足案例中3个生成了具体修复方案，5个自适应规划场景均通过用户审批的知识模型修改转为可满足规划。
AI.conclusion: 将形式化规划与LLM辅助相结合，显著提高了工业自动化的可访问性和可适应性，验证了混合系统在实际工业场景中的有效性。
idea_en: A hybrid assistance system combining capability-based SMT formal planning with LLM-based natural language layer for industrial process sequence planning
An agentic workflow architecture with a central router delegating tasks to specialized agents for capability grounding, planning, interpretation, and adaptation
A Human-in-the-Loop (HitL) knowledge model adaptation mechanism where LLM proposes modifications and human user approves before implementation
An automated repair proposal generation method for unsatisfiable planning cases using LLM-based analysis and suggestion
A natural-language interface system for interacting with formal planning solvers in industrial automation contexts
idea_ch: 一种将基于能力的形式化SMT规划与LLM自然语言层相结合的混合辅助系统，用于工业流程序列规划
一种路由代理工作流架构，中央路由器将任务分派给多个专门代理，分别负责能力基础化、符号规划、结果解释和规划自适应
一种人机协同知识模型自适应机制，LLM提出修改建议，经用户审批后实施
一种基于LLM的不可满足规划案例自动修复方案生成方法
一种面向工业自动化形式化规划求解器的自然语言交互接口系统

title: DREAM-R: Multimodal Speculative Reasoning with RL-Based Refined Drafting, Precise Verification, and Fully Parallel Execution
summary: Speculative reasoning has recently been proposed as a means to accelerate reasoning-intensive generation in large multimodal models, but its effectiveness is often constrained by misalignment between speculative drafts and target-verified reasoning. In this work, we introduce DREAM-R, a framework that substantially improves the performance of speculative reasoning. At its core, DREAM-R employs Speculative Alignment Policy Optimization (SAPO), a reinforcement-learning objective that trains draft models to generate reasoning steps that are both faithful to target trajectories and concise. We further propose a Threshold-based Verification Mechanism (TBVM) that uses a ratio-based criterion to provide stable and interpretable acceptance of speculative steps only when positive evidence clearly dominates, thereby preventing error propagation. Building on these components, we develop a Fully Parallel Speculative Reasoning (FPSR) framework that parallelizes draft generation, target-side reasoning, and verification across multi-step reasoning, enabling early stopping and clean fallback. Experiments on reasoning-heavy benchmarks demonstrate up to speedup while preserving target-model accuracy, yielding substantial efficiency gains without compromising reasoning quality.

AI.tldr: DREAM-R是一个通过强化学习优化推测对齐、阈值验证机制和全并行推测推理来加速大型多模态模型推理的框架，在保持精度的同时实现显著加速。
AI.motivation: 现有的推测推理方法中，推测草稿与目标验证推理之间存在对齐不足，导致效率受限。需要一种方法既能加速推理密集型生成，又能保证推理质量不下降。
AI.method: (1) 推测对齐策略优化(SAPO)：使用强化学习目标训练草稿模型生成忠实于目标轨迹且简洁的推理步骤；(2) 基于阈值的验证机制(TBVM)：采用比率标准进行稳定可解释的接受决策；(3) 全并行推测推理(FPSR)：将草稿生成、目标推理和验证并行化，支持早停和回退。
AI.result: 在推理密集型基准测试上实现了显著加速（高达数倍），同时保持目标模型的准确性，在不影响推理质量的前提下大幅提升效率。
AI.conclusion: DREAM-R通过强化学习对齐、阈值验证和全并行化设计，有效解决了推测推理中的对齐问题，为多模态大模型的推理加速提供了高效解决方案。
idea_en: Speculative Alignment Policy Optimization (SAPO): A reinforcement learning objective that trains draft models to generate reasoning steps faithful to target trajectories while being concise.

Threshold-based Verification Mechanism (TBVM): A ratio-based criterion for stable and interpretable acceptance of speculative steps only when positive evidence clearly dominates, preventing error propagation.

Fully Parallel Speculative Reasoning (FPSR): A framework that parallelizes draft generation, target-side reasoning, and verification across multi-step reasoning with early stopping and clean fallback.
Speculative reasoning acceleration method combining reinforcement learning alignment with threshold-based verification for large multimodal models.
idea_ch: 推测对齐策略优化(SAPO)：一种强化学习目标函数，训练草稿模型生成既忠实于目标轨迹又简洁的推理步骤
基于阈值的验证机制(TBVM)：采用比率标准进行稳定可解释的推测步骤接受决策，仅在正面证据明显占优时接受，防止错误传播
全并行推测推理(FPSR)：将草稿生成、目标推理和验证在多步推理中并行化，支持早停和优雅回退的框架
结合强化学习对齐与阈值验证的大规模多模态模型推测推理加速方法

title: VeriTrip: A Verifiable Benchmark for Travel Planning Agents over Unstructured Web Corpora
summary: Existing benchmarks have laid the foundation for travel planning agents by establishing API-centric paradigms. However, as the capabilities of Autonomous Agents continue to advance, their evaluation must evolve beyond simple tool execution toward handling the inherent complexities of the open web. Current benchmarks bypass core cognitive hurdles: they fail to account for information noise, ignore multi-source factual contradictions, and overlook the necessity of grounding visual perception into logical planning. We introduce VeriTrip, a verifiable benchmark designed to meet the increasing demands for agent robustness and reliability. VeriTrip shifts the evaluation focus to evidence-grounded reasoning over unstructured multimodal web corpora. It establishes a Multimodal Retrieval Base (MRB) derived from real-world sources, forcing agents to autonomously orchestrate queries across heterogeneous data. A synchronized Verifiable Knowledge Base (VKB) enables a cell-wise verification protocol that precisely quantifies factual reliability, distinguishing systematic reasoning failures from parametric hallucinations. Our evaluations across leading MLLMs reveal a critical \textit{retrieval-reasoning trade-off}: the cognitive load of autonomous retrieval significantly erodes instruction retention. VeriTrip provides the rigorous foundation necessary for the next generation of planning agents capable of operating in unconstrained, multimodal environments.

AI.tldr: VeriTrip是一个用于评估自主旅行规划智能体的可验证基准，通过多模态检索库和可验证知识库，将评估从简单的工具执行转向基于证据的推理，揭示了检索-推理权衡问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基准过于依赖API中心的范式，未能评估智能体在开放网络中处理信息噪声、多源事实矛盾以及将视觉感知融入逻辑规划的核心认知能力。
AI.method: 构建多模态检索库（MRB）和可验证知识库（VKB），采用cell-wise验证协议精确量化事实可靠性，区分系统性推理失败与参数幻觉。
AI.result: 揭示了检索-推理权衡：自主检索的认知负荷显著削弱了指令保持能力。
AI.conclusion: VeriTrip为下一代能够在无约束多模态环境中运行的规划智能体提供了严格的评估基础。
idea_en: A verifiable benchmark system for travel planning agents that uses a Multimodal Retrieval Base (MRB) derived from real-world unstructured web data to evaluate evidence-grounded reasoning.
A synchronized Verifiable Knowledge Base (VKB) with cell-wise verification protocol that quantifies factual reliability by distinguishing systematic reasoning failures from parametric hallucinations.
A method for evaluating the retrieval-reasoning trade-off in autonomous agents, measuring how cognitive load from autonomous retrieval affects instruction retention.
A cross-modal fact-checking mechanism that forces agents to independently orchestrate queries across heterogeneous multimodal data sources (text, images, etc.) to resolve factual contradictions.
An agent evaluation framework that shifts from API-centric tool execution to open-web multimodal planning, requiring autonomous navigation of information noise and multi-source contradictions.
idea_ch: 一种基于多模态检索库（MRB）的旅行规划智能体可验证基准系统，利用真实世界非结构化网络数据评估基于证据的推理能力。
一种同步可验证知识库（VKB）及其单元级验证协议，通过区分系统性推理失败与参数幻觉来精确量化事实可靠性。
一种评估自主智能体检索-推理权衡的方法，测量自主检索带来的认知负荷如何影响指令保持能力。
一种跨模态事实核查机制，强制智能体自主在异构多模态数据源（文本、图像等）间编排查询以解决事实矛盾。
一种从API中心工具执行转向开放网络多模态规划的智能体评估框架，要求自主应对信息噪声和多源矛盾。

title: TRACER: Turn-level Regret Matching with Inner Reinforcement Credit for Cooperative Multi-LLM Reasoning
summary: Large language models increasingly rely on either reinforcement learning or multi-agent prompting to improve reasoning, yet these two paradigms remain difficult to combine. Directly applying single-agent reinforcement learning to multi-turn multi-agent systems faces following dilemmas: i) Sparse rewards, role-level free-riding and excessive training overhead. ii) Agents only imitate to collaborate. iii) Fixed collaboration protocol falls into oscillating local optimum. We introduce TRACER, a turn-level reinforcement framework for cooperative multi-LLM reasoning. TRACER separates collaborative decision making into a controller-regret layer, where controllers learn whether the agents should speak or skip the current round through regret matching, and a generation-credit layer, which optimizes proposer and reviewer utterances with role-specific GSPO rewards. This design i) assigns credit at the level of both action modes and generated utterances, thus avoiding free-riding and sparse rewards. We only expand the choices made by the controllers, thus greatly reducing computational cost of training. Moreover, ii) agents acquire collaborative capability as they learn when to utter and what to speak. Finally, iii) by designing binary actions ingeniously, we extend classical game theory established for finite action spaces to deep learning, thus achieving mathematically rigorous convergence. We train all local RL-style methods on the GSM8K training split and evaluate on held-out GSM8K, MATH500, and GPQA-Diamond to measure in-domain accuracy, cross-benchmark generalization, inference cost, and correction-preservation behavior. The resulting framework provides a compact and reproducible testbed for studying learned collaboration policies beyond fixed debate, voting, or aggregation protocols. Code is available at https://github.com/Shark-Forest/TRACER.

AI.tldr: TRACER是一个面向多LLM协作推理的回合级强化学习框架，通过控制器-遗憾层（学习发言/跳过）和生成-信用层（优化提议/评审话语）分离协作决策，解决稀疏奖励、搭便车和训练开销问题，并实现数学上可证明的收敛。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习与多智能体提示难以结合，单智能体RL直接应用于多轮多智能体系统面临三大困境：稀疏奖励与角色级搭便车、智能体仅模仿协作而非真正学习、固定协作协议陷入振荡局部最优。
AI.method: TRACER将协作决策分解为两层：控制器-遗憾层通过遗憾匹配学习智能体是否应发言或跳过当前轮次；生成-信用层使用角色特定的GSPO奖励优化提议者和评审者的 utterances。通过将控制器动作设计为二进制动作，将有限动作空间的博弈论扩展到深度学习，实现数学收敛保证。
AI.result: 在GSM8K训练集上训练，在GSM8K、MATH500和GPQA-Diamond上评估，测量了领域内准确率、跨基准泛化、推理成本和纠正保持行为。
AI.conclusion: TRACER提供了一种紧凑可复现的测试平台，用于研究超越固定辩论、投票或聚合协议的学习型协作策略。
idea_en: A turn-level reinforcement learning framework for multi-LLM cooperative reasoning with a controller-regret layer that learns when each agent should speak or skip via regret matching

A dual-layer architecture separating collaborative decision-making into a controller-regret layer (action mode selection) and a generation-credit layer (utterance optimization with role-specific GSPO rewards)
Extension of classical game theory from finite action spaces to deep learning via ingenious binary action design, achieving mathematically rigorous convergence guarantees
Role-specific GSPO (Generation-Specific Policy Optimization) reward mechanism that independently optimizes proposer and reviewer utterances to avoid free-riding
Credit assignment at both action mode level and generated utterance level, solving sparse reward and free-riding problems in multi-agent RL
Computationally efficient training method that only expands controller choice space, greatly reducing training overhead compared to full multi-agent RL
idea_ch: 一种面向多LLM协作推理的回合级强化学习框架，通过控制器-遗憾层利用遗憾匹配学习每个智能体何时发言或跳过
一种双层架构，将协作决策分解为控制器-遗憾层（动作模式选择）和生成-信用层（角色特定GSPO奖励优化话语），分工明确
通过巧妙的二进制动作设计，将经典博弈论从有限动作空间扩展到深度学习领域，实现数学上严谨的收敛保证
角色特定GSPO（生成特定策略优化）奖励机制，独立优化提议者和评审者的话语生成，避免角色级搭便车
在动作模式级别和生成话语级别同时进行信用分配的方法，解决多智能体强化学习中的稀疏奖励和搭便车问题
一种仅扩展控制器选择空间的计算高效训练方法，相比完整多智能体RL大幅降低训练开销

title: The Importance of Being Statistically Earnest: A Critical Re-evaluation of GSM-Symbolic
comment: 38 pages, 11 figures. Submitted to ACL ARR / EMNLP 2026
summary: The GSM-Symbolic benchmark (Mirzadeh et al., 2025) reported consistent performance drops across 25 Large Language Models (LLMs) when tested on template-generated variants of GSM8K problems, concluding that the models lack genuine reasoning capabilities. We argue that this conclusion rests on shaky statistical ground. Re-evaluating 20 open-weight models using Generalised Linear Mixed Models with per-question random effects, we find that only half exhibit statistically significant performance changes under the original prompt format. Moreover, we identify a previously unacknowledged factor: the main GSM-Symbolic dataset contains a systematically shifted distribution of larger integers in problem texts relative to GSM-Base (K-S statistic = 0.12, p < 0.001), contradicting the original authors' claims. Controlling for this large number effect accounts for significance in roughly half the remaining cases. Among models with statistically significant performance deltas, we identify distinct, model-specific failure profiles - including fragility of variable binding, arithmetic limitations, and dual-task interference - underscoring that blanket claims about LLM reasoning are both statistically premature and mechanistically misleading.

AI.tldr: 本文反驳了GSM-Symbolic基准测试中LLM推理能力缺失的结论。通过更严格的统计方法（广义线性混合模型）重新评估20个开源模型，发现仅半数模型存在显著性能变化。同时发现GSM-Symbolic数据集存在整数分布偏移问题，控制该因素后剩余显著案例再减半。真正表现出性能下降的模型呈现出多样化的失败模式（如变量绑定脆弱性、算术限制、双任务干扰），表明对LLM推理的笼统判断在统计学上不成熟且在机制上具有误导性。
AI.motivation: 挑战GSM-Symbolic基准测试（Mirzadeh et al., 2025）得出的"LLM缺乏真正推理能力"这一广泛引用的结论，指出其统计基础薄弱，并揭示未考虑的数据分布偏移问题。
AI.method: 采用广义线性混合模型（GLMM）配合每问题随机效应，对20个开源模型进行重新统计分析；同时使用K-S检验检测GSM-Symbolic与GSM-Base数据集之间的整数分布差异，并进行控制变量的对比实验。
AI.result: 仅半数模型在原始提示格式下表现出统计学显著的性能变化；GSM-Symbolic数据集中较大整数分布显著偏移（K-S统计量=0.12, p<0.001）；控制大数效应后，剩余显著案例再减少约一半；真正显著下降的模型呈现出模型特定的、多样化的失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 对LLM推理能力的笼统结论（无论是肯定还是否定）在统计学上为时过早，在机制解释上具有误导性。应关注模型特定的失败模式而非一概而论。
idea_en: A statistical framework (Generalised Linear Mixed Model with per-question random effects) for rigorously evaluating LLM performance differences across benchmark variants, enabling more reliable detection of genuine reasoning deficits vs. spurious artifacts.

A methodology for detecting and controlling distributional shifts in numerical values within benchmark datasets (e.g., integer size distribution using K-S test) to prevent confounding effects on LLM performance evaluation.

A taxonomy of model-specific failure profiles for LLM mathematical reasoning: fragile variable binding, arithmetic limitations, and dual-task interference, enabling targeted diagnosis and improvement of reasoning capabilities.
idea_ch: 基于广义线性混合模型（GLMM）配合每问题随机效应的LLM性能差异统计检验方法，可更可靠地检测真正的推理缺陷与虚假伪影之间的区别
一种检测并控制基准测试数据集中数值分布偏移的方法（如使用K-S检验检测整数大小分布差异），防止数据分布偏移对LLM性能评估造成混淆效应
LLM数学推理的模型特定失败模式分类：变量绑定脆弱性、算术能力限制、双任务干扰——实现针对性的推理能力诊断与改进

title: Beyond Binary Moral Judgment: Modeling Ethical Pluralism in AI
summary: Critical decision-making in socially consequential spaces is increasingly involving AI systems at varying capacities. Yet, despite the ubiquity of autonomous systems, most approaches to handling autonomous moral decision-making resort to scalar or binary judgments. These methods are insufficient for acceptable moral reasoning, as they provide little explanation, leaving out imperative contextual and theoretical information that must be included to support accountability. For this, we propose a framework to model moral reasoning as a distribution over normative ethical theories or ethical pluralism. We introduce a normative ethics simplex that integrates these theories. A benchmark of 450 cases across 15 fine-grained subtheories was also prepared for the purposes of stacked ensemble learning. These cases describe ethical dilemmas in natural language and have associated extracted contextual features. The implementation of the simplex was achieved via a two-stream normative-semantic architecture. This is followed by the fusion of normative information and a sequential, stacking ensemble to learn the best fit of the three broad theories: consequentialism, virtue ethics, and deontology, and the 15 subcategories. Our experiments demonstrate that the integration of contextual and normative priors with the semantic embeddings significantly improves the performance of the classification, displaying an accuracy of 88.89%. We conducted ablation studies to show that structured ethical representations contribute beyond analogical reasoning, and the chosen stacking architecture gives the best results due to the gradual learning of granularity. Ethical pluralism is also analyzed through entropy, confidence, and visualization. Thus, modeling ethical pluralism as a probabilistic normative distribution supports human-like moral reasoning, ethical disagreement analysis, and future alignment in AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种将道德推理建模为规范伦理理论概率分布的框架（伦理多元主义），通过两流规范-语义架构和堆叠集成学习，在450个伦理困境案例上实现了88.89%的分类准确率，支持更人性化的AI道德推理。
AI.motivation: 现有AI道德决策方法多采用标量或二元判断，缺乏解释性和上下文信息，无法支撑可问责的道德推理。需要一种能够融合多种伦理理论并保留结构信息的框架。
AI.method: 构建规范伦理单纯形（normative ethics simplex），包含15个细粒度子理论；设计两流规范-语义架构（two-stream normative-semantic architecture），融合上下文特征与语义嵌入；采用顺序堆叠集成学习（sequential stacking ensemble）逐步学习从粗粒度到细粒度的伦理分类。
AI.result: 集成上下文和规范先验与语义嵌入后，分类准确率达88.89%；消融实验表明结构化伦理表示超越类比推理，堆叠架构因渐进式粒度学习效果最佳；通过熵、置信度和可视化分析了伦理多元主义。
AI.conclusion: 将伦理多元主义建模为概率规范分布，支持类人的道德推理、伦理分歧分析以及未来AI系统的对齐。
idea_en: A two-stream normative-semantic architecture that fuses contextual features with normative ethical theory embeddings for moral reasoning classification.
A normative ethics simplex representation that models ethical pluralism as a probabilistic distribution over 15 fine-grained ethical subtheories.
A sequential stacking ensemble learning method that progressively learns ethical classifications from coarse to fine granularity.
A benchmark dataset of 450 ethical dilemma cases with natural language descriptions and extracted contextual features across 15 subtheories.
A method for analyzing ethical pluralism through entropy, confidence, and visualization metrics in autonomous decision-making systems.
idea_ch: 一种两流规范-语义架构，融合上下文特征与规范伦理理论嵌入，用于道德推理分类。
一种规范伦理单纯形表示方法，将伦理多元主义建模为15个细粒度伦理子理论的概率分布。
一种顺序堆叠集成学习方法，从粗粒度到细粒度渐进式学习伦理分类。
一个包含450个伦理困境案例的基准数据集，配有自然语言描述和跨15个子理论的上下文特征提取。
一种通过熵、置信度和可视化指标分析自主决策系统中伦理多元主义的方法。

title: Thinking as Compression: Your Reasoning Model is Secretly a Context Compressor
summary: Context compression aims to shorten long context inputs with minimal information loss for LLM inference acceleration. While existing methods have shown promise, they typically rely on complex compression modules or compression-specific training, leaving the intrinsic capabilities of LLMs underexplored. In contrast, this work reveals that a thinking model itself can naturally compress long contexts by organizing task-relevant information. We thus derive Thinking as Compression (TaC), a new compression paradigm that treats thinking itself as compressed context. Without relying on specific dedicated compressor, TaC directly prompts the thinking model to generate thinking traces as the shortened context, already outperforming most representative compression methods. Further, given that raw thinking output may struggle with budget control and shortcut behaviors, we introduce Thinking as Compression Constrained (TaC-C), leveraging a simple reward-driven optimization framework to elicit intrinsic thinking as compact and controllable compressed context. Experiments across four long-context QA benchmarks demonstrate that TaC-C consistently outperforms existing baselines. At 4x and 8x compression ratios, it surpasses the strongest competitor by 17.4% and 23.4% in average F1, and by 15.7% and 21.7% in average Exact Match Score (EM), respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"思维即压缩"(TaC)新范式，利用思考模型自身能力通过生成思维轨迹来压缩长上下文，无需专用压缩模块或压缩训练。进一步提出TaC-C，通过奖励驱动优化框架实现可控压缩，在4倍和8倍压缩比下分别超越最强基线17.4%和23.4%的F1分数。
AI.motivation: 现有长上下文压缩方法依赖复杂的压缩模块或针对压缩任务的专门训练，忽视了LLM本身固有的压缩能力，成本和效率不理想。
AI.method: TaC: 直接提示思考模型生成思维轨迹作为压缩后的上下文。TaC-C: 引入简单奖励驱动优化框架，对思维输出进行约束控制，实现紧凑且可控的上下文压缩。
AI.result: 在四个长上下文QA基准上，TaC-C在4x压缩比下平均F1提升17.4%，EM提升15.7%；在8x压缩比下平均F1提升23.4%，EM提升21.7%。
AI.conclusion: 思考模型自身具备自然的上下文压缩能力，通过适当优化可替代复杂专用压缩方法，为LLM推理加速提供了新路径。
idea_en: A method for long context compression that utilizes a thinking model's self-generated thinking traces as compressed context, without requiring dedicated compression modules or compression-specific training.
A reward-driven optimization framework (TaC-C) that constrains the thinking model's output to achieve controllable and compact long context compression with specified compression ratios.
A prompting technique that directly elicits intrinsic compression capabilities from thinking models by instructing them to organize task-relevant information into thinking traces.
A compression paradigm that treats the thinking process itself as the compressed representation of long contexts, enabling natural information distillation.
A budget-controlled compression method that combines thinking-based compression with reward optimization to prevent shortcut behaviors and ensure reliable compression.
idea_ch: 一种利用思考模型自身生成的思维轨迹作为压缩上下文的长上下文压缩方法，无需专用压缩模块或压缩训练。
一种基于奖励驱动的优化框架(TaC-C)，通过对思考模型输出进行约束，实现可控且紧凑的长上下文压缩，支持指定压缩比率。
一种提示工程技术，通过引导思考模型将任务相关信息组织成思维轨迹，直接激发其内在的上下文压缩能力。
一种将思考过程本身视为长上下文压缩表示的压缩范式，实现自然的信息蒸馏与保留。
一种预算可控的压缩方法，结合基于思维的压缩与奖励优化，防止捷径行为并确保压缩可靠性。

title: OpenURMA: A Clean-Room Open Implementation of the Unified Bus Protocol
summary:
Modern datacenter RDMA is bottlenecked at the network interface, not the wire. A NIC running RoCE or InfiniBand holds per-connection state for every (application, remote-endpoint) pair - hundreds of megabytes at 1024-application fanout - and pays a four-traversal PCIe round trip on a 64-byte operation, inflating latency an order of magnitude beyond the wire. Both follow from the Queue Pair over PCIe abstraction RDMA inherits from InfiniBand.
  Huawei's Unified Bus (UB), a public 2025 specification, changes the abstraction: it decouples per-application endpoint state from per-host transport state so connection context grows additively, exposes ordering as opt-in, and reaches remote memory through native CPU load/store to an on-chip-bus controller. UB ships in Huawei's closed Ascend 950 silicon.
  OpenURMA is the first clean-room open implementation of UB's transport and transaction layers, realised at three tiers - synthesisable RTL on Alveo U50, a cycle-level two-node SystemC simulator, and a gem5 full-system scaffold - each with a matched OpenRoCE (RoCEv2 RC) baseline. The contribution is the implementation, harness, and controlled comparison closed silicon does not admit. On the canonical 64-byte remote fetch - LOAD on UB-spec Sec.8.3, READ on RoCEv2 RC - UB's load/store path delivers ~500 ns end-to-end, 4.37x below the matched baseline (2186 ns), sustains 2.80x higher throughput, and fits in ~14% of a U50's LUTs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了OpenURMA，是华为UB传输层的首个开源实现。通过将RDMA的队列对抽象改为基于片上总线的本地load/store原语，在FPGA上实现了~500ns的端到端延迟，比RoCEv2快4.37倍，吞吐量高2.80倍。
AI.motivation: 现代数据中心RDMA在NIC处成为瓶颈而非线缆。RoCE/InfiniBand的NIC为每个(应用,远端端点)对维护连接状态，在1024应用扇出时需要数百MB，且64字节操作需要四次PCIe往返，延迟比线路高一个数量级。这些问题源于RDMA从InfiniBand继承的"队列对(Queue Pair) over PCIe"抽象。
AI.method: OpenURMA是华为UB规范传输层和事务层的首个净室开源实现，采用三级实现：Alveo U50上的可综合RTL、双节点SystemC周期级模拟器、gem5全系统框架。每级都有匹配的OpenRoCE(RoCEv2 RC)基线进行对比。
AI.result: 在64字节远程fetch操作上(UB的LOAD vs RoCEv2 RC的READ)，UB的load/store路径实现约500ns端到端延迟，比匹配基线(2186ns)低4.37倍，吞吐量高2.80倍，仅占用U50约14%的LUT资源。
AI.conclusion: UB通过去耦合每应用端点状态与每主机传输状态、将排序作为可选、通过片上总线控制器原生CPU load/store访问远程内存，从根本上改变了RDMA抽象，消除了PCIe瓶颈和连接状态膨胀问题。
idea_en: Decoupling per-application endpoint state from per-host transport state in RDMA, reducing connection context from multiplicative to additive growth (US Patent).
Replacing Queue Pair over PCIe abstraction with native CPU load/store instructions to an on-chip-bus controller for remote memory access, eliminating PCIe round trips.
Opt-in ordering mechanism for RDMA operations, allowing applications to selectively enable or disable ordering constraints based on workload requirements.
Synthesisable RTL implementation of UB transport and transaction layers on FPGA (Alveo U50) enabling clean-room open implementation of proprietary RDMA alternative.
Cycle-level two-node SystemC simulator and gem5 full-system scaffold for UB protocol validation and performance characterization.
idea_ch: 一种去耦合RDMA中每应用端点状态与每主机传输状态的方法，将连接上下文从乘法增长变为加法增长。
用原生CPU load/store指令到片上总线控制器替代队列对(Queue Pair) over PCIe抽象，消除PCIe往返开销的远程内存访问机制。
RDMA操作的可选排序(opt-in ordering)机制，允许应用根据工作负载需求选择性启用或禁用排序约束。
在FPGA(Alveo U50)上实现UB传输层和事务层的可综合RTL开源实现方案。
用于UB协议验证和性能表征的周期级双节点SystemC模拟器与gem5全系统框架。

title: LiveBrowseComp: Are Search Agents Searching, or Just Verifying What They Already Know?
summary: Are LLM-based search agents genuinely searching, or using the web to verify what they already know? We study this question on BrowseComp with three diagnostics. Our analysis reveals Intrinsic Knowledge Dependence (IKD): even with tool access, agents often rely on intrinsic knowledge -- information encoded in the model before retrieval -- rather than on external evidence. Agents answer up to 44.5% of BrowseComp questions without tools, generate more than half of their search queries from internally produced hypotheses rather than retrieved leads, and perform worse than closed-book baselines when answer-supporting evidence is removed. These results suggest that static search benchmarks can reward memory-backed verification rather than evidence-driven discovery, conflating what agents already know with what they can find. We then introduce LiveBrowseComp, a deep-search benchmark designed to evaluate agents beyond intrinsic coverage. It contains 335 human-authored questions whose answers depend on facts published within the 90 days preceding benchmark construction, drawn from six updated sources and filtered to exclude globally salient events. On LiveBrowseComp, all evaluated agents fall below 2% closed-book accuracy, search-augmented scores drop by 25-40 points relative to BrowseComp, and prior model rankings no longer reliably predict performance. LiveBrowseComp is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Forival/LiveBrowseComp.

AI.tldr: 论文发现基于LLM的搜索代理存在“内在知识依赖”（IKD）问题：即使有工具访问，代理也倾向于依赖模型内部知识而非外部证据。为此作者提出LiveBrowseComp基准，包含335个基于90天内新发布事实的问题，有效评估代理的真实搜索能力。
AI.motivation: 当前搜索基准测试（如BrowseComp）无法区分代理是真正搜索还是依赖内在知识回答问题，导致对搜索代理能力的评估存在偏差。
AI.method: 通过三种诊断方法分析内在知识依赖（IKD）：无工具测试、搜索查询来源分析、移除支持证据后的性能测试。并构建LiveBrowseComp基准，包含基于90天内更新来源的新事实问题，排除全球显著事件。
AI.result: 代理在无工具下回答44.5%的问题；一半以上搜索查询来自内部假设而非检索线索；移除支持证据后性能低于闭卷基线。LiveBrowseComp上闭卷准确率低于2%，搜索增强得分比BrowseComp下降25-40点，原有排名不再可靠。
AI.conclusion: 静态搜索基准会奖励记忆验证而非证据驱动的发现，LiveBrowseComp能更有效评估代理超越内在知识覆盖的真实搜索能力。
idea_en: A method for diagnosing Intrinsic Knowledge Dependence (IKD) in LLM-based search agents by measuring performance without tool access, analyzing query source origins, and testing with answer-supporting evidence removal.

A benchmark construction methodology (LiveBrowseComp) for evaluating search agents beyond intrinsic knowledge coverage, using questions based on facts published within a recent 90-day window from updated sources with global salience filtering.
A system for generating deep-search evaluation benchmarks that dynamically update based on recent factual publications to prevent knowledge memorization in LLM-based agents.
idea_ch: 一种基于LLM的搜索代理内在知识依赖（IKD）诊断方法，通过无工具访问测试、查询来源分析和支持证据移除测试来评估代理的真实搜索依赖性。
一种超越内在知识覆盖的搜索代理评估基准构建方法（LiveBrowseComp），基于90天内新发布事实构建问题，并过滤全球显著事件以防止记忆偏差。
一种动态更新的深度搜索评估基准生成系统，基于多来源的最新事实出版物自动构建问题，有效防止大模型代理的知识记忆效应。

title: Multi-Adapter Representation Interventions via Energy Calibration
summary: Representation intervention has emerged as a promising paradigm for aligning large language models toward desired behaviors without modifying model weights. Existing methods typically apply a fixed intervention uniformly across all inputs. However, we find that the appropriate intervention direction and strength vary substantially across samples, and such indiscriminate intervention leads to degradation of general capabilities on benign inputs. To address these challenges, we propose Multi-Adapter Representation Interventions via Energy Calibration (MARI). Specifically, we introduce a competitive multi-adapter mechanism in which specialized experts capture non-linear correction patterns and adaptively determine the appropriate intervention direction and strength for different samples. Furthermore, we design an energy-based gating module that leverages internal propagation dynamics to distinguish inputs that are applicable for intervention. Extensive experiments across diverse model families and parameter scales demonstrate that MARI achieves state-of-the-art alignment performance. Our method significantly improves performance on TruthfulQA, BBQ, and safety benchmarks, while maintaining and even improving general capabilities on tasks such as MMLU and ARC. Our code is available at https://github.com/V1centNevwake/MARI.

AI.tldr: MARI提出了一种基于能量校准的多适配器表示干预方法，通过竞争式多专家机制和能量门控模块，实现对不同样本自适应调整干预方向和强度，在保持通用能力的同时显著提升对齐性能。
AI.motivation: 现有表示干预方法对所有输入使用固定的干预方向和强度，但不同样本的最佳干预方向和强度差异很大，这种无差别干预会导致良性输入上的通用能力下降。
AI.method: 1) 竞争式多适配器机制：多个专家捕捉非线性校正模式，自适应确定不同样本的干预方向和强度。2) 基于能量的门控模块：利用内部传播动力学区分适合干预的输入。
AI.result: 在TruthfulQA、BBQ和安全基准上取得最先进的对齐性能，同时在MMLU和ARC等任务上保持甚至提升通用能力。
AI.conclusion: MARI通过自适应干预策略有效解决了固定干预带来的通用能力下降问题，实现了对齐性能和通用能力的双赢。
idea_en: A competitive multi-adapter representation intervention mechanism that uses specialized experts to capture non-linear correction patterns and adaptively determine intervention direction and strength for different input samples.
An energy-based gating module that leverages internal propagation dynamics of large language models to distinguish inputs that are suitable for intervention from those that are not.
Energy calibration method for representation intervention that dynamically adjusts intervention intensity based on sample-specific characteristics to prevent degradation of general capabilities.
idea_ch: 一种竞争式多适配器表示干预机制，通过多个专业专家捕捉非线性校正模式，自适应地为不同输入样本确定合适的干预方向和强度。
一种基于能量的门控模块，利用大语言模型内部传播动力学来区分适合进行干预的输入和不适合进行干预的输入。
一种能量校准的表示干预方法，基于样本特定特征动态调整干预强度，防止通用能力退化。

title: AlphaTransit: Learning to Design City-scale Transit Routes
summary: Designing a transit network requires many sequential route extension decisions, but their quality is often visible only after the full network is assembled. This delayed-feedback challenge lies at the heart of the Transit Route Network Design Problem (TRNDP), where route interactions can be deceptive: an extension that appears useful locally can create transfer bottlenecks, produce redundant overlap, or reduce overall throughput. To guide route construction under delayed simulator feedback, we introduce AlphaTransit, a search-based planning framework for cityscale bus network design. AlphaTransit couples Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) with a neural policy-value network: the policy proposes route extensions, the value estimates downstream design quality, and search uses these predictions to refine each decision. This provides decision-time lookahead during route construction without running simulator rollouts inside the search tree. We evaluate AlphaTransit on a new Bloomington TRNDP benchmark with realistic road topology and censusderived demand, under mixed and full transit demand settings. In the Bloomington network, AlphaTransit attains the highest service rate in both demand settings, reaching 54.6% and 82.1%, respectively. Relative to reinforcement learning without search, these correspond to 9.9% and 11.4% service rate gains; relative to MCTS without learned guidance, they correspond to 2.5% and 11.2% gains. These results suggest that coupling learned guidance with MCTS is more effective than using either approach alone for transit network design. Our code and data are publicly available in https://github.com/poudel-bibek/AlphaTransit.

AI.tldr: AlphaTransit提出了一种结合蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）与神经策略-价值网络的公交网络设计框架，用于解决公交线路规划中的延迟反馈问题，在Bloomington基准测试中取得了最高服务率（54.6%和82.1%），相较纯强化学习和纯MCTS均有显著提升。
AI.motivation: 公交网络设计（TRNDP）中，路线扩展决策的质量往往需要等到完整网络构建后才能评估，存在严重的延迟反馈问题。局部看似有用的扩展可能造成换乘瓶颈、线路重叠或整体运力下降，传统方法难以有效处理这种路线间的复杂交互。
AI.method: AlphaTransit将MCTS与神经策略-价值网络耦合：策略网络负责提出路线扩展方案，价值网络评估下游设计质量，搜索过程利用这些预测来优化每一步决策。该方法在搜索树内部无需运行模拟器，实现了构建过程中的决策时间前瞻（decision-time lookahead）。
AI.result: 在Bloomington公交网络基准测试中，AlphaTransit在混合和全公交需求设置下分别达到54.6%和82.1%的服务率。相比纯强化学习提升9.9%和11.4%，相比无学习引导的MCTS提升2.5%和11.2%。
AI.conclusion: 将学习引导与MCTS相结合比单独使用任一方法在公交网络设计中更有效，证明了神经引导搜索在复杂序列决策问题中的优势。
idea_en: A transit route network design method that couples Monte Carlo Tree Search with a neural policy-value network, where the policy network proposes route extensions and the value network estimates downstream design quality, enabling decision-time lookahead without running simulator rollouts inside the search tree.

A search-based planning framework for city-scale bus network design that addresses delayed-feedback challenges by using learned predictions to refine each route extension decision during construction.

A method for transit route construction that uses neural-guided MCTS to predict downstream network quality from partial route states, avoiding the need for complete simulator evaluation during intermediate search steps.
idea_ch: 一种将蒙特卡洛树搜索与神经策略-价值网络耦合的公交线路网络设计方法，策略网络提出线路扩展方案，价值网络评估下游设计质量，在不启动搜索树内模拟器的情况下实现决策时间前瞻。
一种面向城市规模的公交网络搜索规划框架，通过利用学习预测来优化构建过程中每一步线路扩展决策，从而解决延迟反馈问题。
一种使用神经引导MCTS从部分线路状态预测下游网络质量的公交线路构建方法，避免在中间搜索步骤中进行完整的模拟器评估。

title: Utility-Aware Multimodal Contrastive Learning for Product Image Generation
summary: Product images strongly influence consumer decision-making in online marketplaces. Empowered by multimodal contrastive learning, generative AI can output images that closely align with text prompts. Yet existing generative AI models do not directly optimize marketplace performance. This is a critical gap, since semantic alignment alone does not guarantee that an image will sell. To address this limitation, we propose a \textit{utility-aware multimodal contrastive learning} framework that incorporates consumer demand into a novel Utility-Aware InfoNCE loss. Optimizing this utility-aware objective guides generation toward images that are both semantically coherent and demand-enhancing. This effect arises directly from a shift in the learned image-text representation space toward demand-driven visual cues, which we also validate through the theoretical bound of the proposed objective. In downstream applications on Amazon and Airbnb, product images generated and edited by our method outperform state-of-the-art models in increasing demand and preserving fidelity, while maintaining text-image consistency. Notably, our utility-aware framework preserves inverse U-shaped demand patterns for attributes such as aesthetics and uniqueness, improving demand-based performance while preserving fidelity and semantic consistency. Human-subject experiments further validate its commercial effectiveness. As generative AI technology continues to evolve, our utility-aware component can be flexibly embedded into emerging generative models to improve direct commercial use.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种效用感知的多模态对比学习框架，通过Utility-Aware InfoNCE损失函数将消费者需求融入图像生成过程，使生成的产品图像不仅语义对齐，而且能提升市场需求。在Amazon和Airbnb数据集上的实验表明，该方法在提升需求、保持图像 fidelity 和文本-图像一致性方面优于现有模型。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式AI模型能够生成与文本提示对齐的图像，但并未直接优化市场绩效——语义对齐并不保证图像能促进销售，存在关键空白。
AI.method: 提出Utility-Aware InfoNCE损失函数，将消费者需求信号融入多模态对比学习框架，引导图像生成同时优化语义一致性和需求提升效果，通过改变学习到的图像-文本表示空间，使其偏向需求驱动的视觉线索。
AI.result: 在Amazon和Airbnb数据集上，该方法在提升需求、保持图像 fidelity 和文本-图像一致性方面均优于现有模型；保留了属性的倒U型需求模式；人工实验验证了商业有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该效用感知框架可灵活嵌入新兴生成模型，提升生成式AI在商业场景中的直接效用，弥合了语义对齐与市场绩效之间的鸿沟。
idea_en: Utility-aware multimodal contrastive learning framework integrating consumer demand signals into image generation via Utility-Aware InfoNCE loss
Method for shifting image-text representation space toward demand-driven visual cues to improve commercial performance of generated images
Utility-Aware InfoNCE loss function that jointly optimizes semantic alignment and demand enhancement in contrastive learning
System for generating demand-optimized product images for e-commerce platforms while preserving fidelity and text-image consistency
Flexible utility-aware module that can be embedded into existing generative AI models to improve marketplace performance
idea_ch: 一种效用感知的多模态对比学习框架，通过Utility-Aware InfoNCE损失函数将消费者需求信号融入图像生成过程
将图像-文本表示空间向需求驱动视觉线索偏移的方法，用于提升生成图像的商业表现
Utility-Aware InfoNCE损失函数，在对比学习中联合优化语义对齐与需求提升
为电商平台生成需求优化的产品图像的系统，同时保持图像 fidelity 和文本-图像一致性
可灵活嵌入现有生成式AI模型的效用感知模块，用于提升市场表现

title: CORE: Contrastive Reflection Enables Rapid Improvements in Reasoning
summary: Language models can use verifiable rewards to improve at a wide variety of reasoning tasks. However, both parametric (e.g. RLVR) and non-parametric (e.g. prompt optimization) approaches to doing so typically require hundreds of training samples and thousands of model rollouts, making them expensive in the best case and intractable in the worst. To address this challenge, we introduce Contrastive Reflection (CORE), a non-parametric learning algorithm that compares past reasoning traces to generate insights: short natural-language descriptions of reasoning strategies and constraints that capture differences between successful and unsuccessful problem attempts. Across four reasoning tasks, we demonstrate that CORE enables more rapid improvement than both parametric (GRPO) and non-parametric (GEPA, episodic RAG, and MemRL) methods, while using fewer rollouts. Under fixed rollout budgets with as few as five training samples, we then show that CORE also achieves comparable or greater performance gains than each baseline. Finally, we highlight how CORE is also substantially more context-efficient than non-parametric baselines, requiring fewer prompt tokens while storing learned knowledge as compact, interpretable natural-language insights. Our results therefore suggest that distilling contrasts between successful and unsuccessful reasoning traces into abstract and useful insights can provide a more efficient and interpretable route to model self-improvement than weight updates, prompt optimization, or direct reuse of stored reasoning traces.

AI.tldr: CORE是一种非参数学习算法，通过对比成功与失败的推理轨迹生成自然语言"洞察"，以更高效、更可解释的方式提升语言模型的推理能力，在少量样本和更少推理次数的条件下优于GRPO等基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于可验证奖励的推理优化方法（无论是参数化方法如RLVR，还是非参数化方法如提示优化）通常需要数百个训练样本和数千次模型rollout，成本高昂甚至不可行。亟需一种更高效的方法来利用可验证奖励改进模型推理。
AI.method: CORE (Contrastive Reflection) 算法通过对比同一问题上的成功与失败推理轨迹，提取差异并生成自然语言形式的"洞察"——描述推理策略和约束的简短文本。这些洞察作为知识存储在提示中，指导后续推理。整个过程无需参数更新，仅需少量样本和rollout。
AI.result: 在四个推理任务上，CORE比GRPO（参数化）、GEPA、episodic RAG和MemRL（非参数化）等方法实现了更快的性能提升，且使用更少的rollout。在固定rollout预算下，仅用5个训练样本即可达到或超过基线方法的性能增益。同时，CORE在上下文效率方面也显著优于非参数化基线，需更少的提示token，且知识以紧凑、可解释的自然语言洞察存储。
AI.conclusion: 将成功与失败推理轨迹之间的对比提炼为抽象、有用的自然语言洞察，比权重更新、提示优化或直接复用推理轨迹提供了一条更高效、更可解释的模型自我改进路径。
idea_en: A contrastive reflection algorithm that generates natural-language 'insights' by comparing successful and failed reasoning traces, capturing abstract reasoning strategies and constraints.

A non-parametric learning method for language model self-improvement that stores learned knowledge as compact, interpretable natural-language insights rather than weight updates or prompt optimization.
A context-efficient knowledge representation technique for reasoning tasks that uses fewer prompt tokens by storing distilled contrastive insights instead of full reasoning traces.
A few-shot reasoning improvement system that achieves comparable or better performance gains than parametric methods (e.g., GRPO) with as few as five training samples and limited rollouts.
An automated insight generation method that abstracts differences between successful and unsuccessful problem-solving attempts into reusable reasoning strategies and constraints.
idea_ch: 一种对比反思算法，通过比较成功和失败的推理轨迹生成自然语言'洞察'，捕捉抽象推理策略和约束条件。
一种非参数化的语言模型自我改进学习方法，将学到的知识以紧凑、可解释的自然语言洞察形式存储，而非权重更新或提示优化。
一种用于推理任务的上下文高效知识表示技术，通过存储提炼后的对比洞察而非完整推理轨迹，使用更少的提示token。
一种少样本推理改进系统，在仅使用五个训练样本和有限rollout的条件下，达到或超过GRPO等参数化方法的性能增益。
一种自动化洞察生成方法，将成功与不成功问题求解尝试之间的差异抽象为可复用的推理策略和约束条件。

title: CubePart: An Open-Vocabulary Part-Controllable 3D Generator
summary: Interactive 3D assets used in games and simulation are typically decomposed into specific semantic parts to support animation, physics, and scripted behaviors, yet most generative 3D models produce either monolithic meshes or arbitrary part decompositions that cannot be aligned with application-specific requirements. We present CubePart, a generative framework for open-vocabulary, part-controllable 3D mesh generation that exposes part structure as an explicit inference-time control signal. Given a global text prompt and a user-defined parts schema expressed as an open-ended list of part names, our method generates a set of meshes - one per schema element - that assemble into a coherent object while respecting the specified semantic structure. To enable this capability, we introduce a scalable data pipeline to construct a large open-vocabulary, part-labeled 3D dataset, along with a two-stage generative architecture that separates global shape synthesis from part-level decoding. We demonstrate that the resulting assets can be directly integrated into game engines and driven by animation and behavior scripts without manual post-processing. Project Page: https://cubepart.github.io/

AI.tldr: CubePart提出了一种开放词汇、部件可控的3D网格生成框架，能够根据全局文本提示和用户定义的部件名称列表，生成由多个部件网格组成的连贯3D物体，每个部件对应一个语义部分，可直接用于游戏引擎和动画脚本。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式3D模型要么生成单一整体网格，要么产生任意部件分解，无法对齐游戏和仿真中按特定语义部件分解的需求（如支持动画、物理和脚本行为）。
AI.method: 1）构建大规模开放词汇、部件标注的3D数据集的可扩展数据流水线；2）两阶段生成架构：全局形状合成 + 部件级别解码；3）用户通过全局文本提示和开放式的部件名称列表控制输出结构。
AI.result: 生成的资产可直接集成到游戏引擎中，由动画和行为脚本驱动，无需手动后处理。
AI.conclusion: CubePart实现了开放词汇、部件可控的3D网格生成，将部件结构作为显式的推理时控制信号，满足应用程序特定的语义分解需求。
idea_en: A two-stage generative architecture for 3D mesh generation that separates global shape synthesis from part-level decoding, enabling part-controllable output.
A scalable data pipeline for constructing large-scale, open-vocabulary, part-labeled 3D datasets from heterogeneous sources.
A method for generating multiple coherent meshes (one per user-defined part) that assemble into a single 3D object while respecting specified semantic structure.
Inference-time part structure control using an open-ended list of part names as explicit control signals for 3D generation.
A framework that produces directly game-engine-ready 3D assets with part-level decomposition compatible with animation, physics, and scripted behaviors, eliminating manual post-processing.
idea_ch: 一种将全局形状合成与部件级解码分离的两阶段3D网格生成架构，实现部件可控的输出。
一种可扩展的数据流水线，用于从异构数据源构建大规模、开放词汇、带部件标注的3D数据集。
一种生成多个相干网格（每个用户定义部件对应一个）并组合成完整3D物体的方法，同时保持指定的语义结构。
使用开放式的部件名称列表作为显式控制信号，在推理时控制3D生成的部件结构。
一种生成可直接用于游戏引擎的3D资产框架，其部件级分解兼容动画、物理和脚本行为，无需人工后处理。

title: SwarmHarness: Skill-Based Task Routing via Decentralized Incentive-Aligned AI Agent Networks
summary: Vast quantities of compute (GPU cycles on personal workstations, idle inference servers, and edge devices between jobs) go unused because no incentive-aligned protocol exists for their owners to share them safely and profitably. Existing approaches either require a trusted central coordinator (cloud marketplaces), demand heavy blockchain infrastructure (Golem, BrokerChain), or lack an incentive layer entirely (BOINC, Petals). We propose SwarmHarness, a decentralised protocol in which HarnessAPI skill nodes self-organise into a compute swarm without any central authority. SwarmHarness has three interlocking components: a SwarmRegistry built on a Distributed Hash Table (DHT) for peer discovery and capability advertisement; a SwarmRouter that dispatches tasks to nodes using a utility function over capability, load, latency, and trust; and SwarmCredit, an incentive mechanism that attributes compute-credit rewards to contributing nodes via a Shapley-value approximation. Nodes earn credits by serving tasks and spend credits to submit them; idle nodes that never contribute drain credits and lose routing priority, creating a self-regulating participation economy. As nodes specialise toward high-reward skills and routing signals act as digital pheromones, the network exhibits emergent collective intelligence analogous to biological swarms. Beyond compute sharing, SwarmHarness is a foundational primitive for autonomous distributed AI agent networks in which agents hire compute, route subtasks, and settle credits without human intermediation.

AI.tldr: SwarmHarness是一个无需中心化权威的去中心化计算资源共享协议，通过DHT节点发现、效用函数任务路由和Shapley值信用激励机制，让闲置GPU资源所有者能够安全盈利地共享算力，并展示出类似生物群体的涌现集体智能。
AI.motivation: 大量计算资源（个人工作站GPU、闲置推理服务器、边缘设备）因缺乏激励对齐的协议而未被利用，现有方案要么依赖可信中心协调者（云市场）、需要繁重的区块链基础设施（Golem, BrokerChain），要么完全缺乏激励层（BOINC, Petals）。
AI.method: 提出了SwarmHarness协议，包含三个核心组件：1) SwarmRegistry——基于分布式哈希表(DHT)的节点发现和能力公告；2) SwarmRouter——通过基于能力、负载、延迟和信任的效用函数将任务分派给节点；3) SwarmCredit——基于Shapley值近似的计算积分激励机制，节点通过服务任务赚取积分、提交任务消耗积分，空闲节点积分耗尽后失去路由优先级。
AI.result: 节点会向高奖励技能专业化，路由信号像数字信息素一样引导任务分配，网络展现出类似生物群体的涌现集体智能。同时形成了自我调节的参与经济体系。
AI.conclusion: SwarmHarness不仅是计算资源共享协议，更是自主分布式AI智能体网络的基础原语，使智能体能够无需人工中介地雇佣算力、路由子任务和结算信用。
idea_en: A decentralized compute resource sharing protocol (SwarmHarness) with three interlocking components: DHT-based peer discovery registry, utility-function-based task router, and Shapley-value-approximation credit incentive mechanism
Self-regulating participation economy where idle nodes drain credits and lose routing priority, creating natural incentive alignment without central authority
Digital pheromone-inspired routing signals that guide task allocation and enable emergent collective intelligence in compute networks
SwarmHarness as a foundational primitive for autonomous distributed AI agent networks enabling agents to hire compute, route subtasks, and settle credits without human intermediation
idea_ch: 一种基于分布式哈希表(DHT)的去中心化节点发现与能力公告机制(SwarmRegistry)，无需中心权威即可实现计算节点的自组织
基于效用函数的任务路由方法(SwarmRouter)，综合节点能力、负载、延迟和信任等多维指标进行智能任务分派
基于Shapley值近似的计算积分激励机制(SwarmCredit)，公平量化并奖励各节点的计算贡献
自调节参与经济系统：空闲节点积分持续消耗并失去路由优先级，无需中心化协调即可激励参与
数字信息素路由信号机制：路由信号像信息素一样引导计算任务流向高奖励专业化的节点，实现涌现式集体智能
去中心化AI智能体网络的基础原语：使AI智能体能够自主雇佣算力、路由子任务和结算信用积分，无需人工中介

title: CaMBRAIN: Real-time, Continuous EEG Inference with Causal State Space Models
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) is a critical, non-invasive method to monitor electrical brain activity.
