EEGs can span anywhere from a couple seconds to multiple hours, posing a major hurdle for existing deep learning methods due to two major factors: (1) existing EEG models are predominantly built upon the attention mechanism, incurring quadratic scaling as the sequence length increases, and (2) raw EEG signals must be processed in a sliding-window fashion due to fixed-length input requirements, preventing global understanding of the entire signal. To this extent, we propose CaMBRAIN - the first Causal, Mamba-based state space model (SSM) capable of real-time inference of EEG signals, arguing that bidirectional approaches are needlessly expensive given the causal, unidirectional nature of EEG. However, training such a model is non-trivial, as crucial EEG events can be extremely brief - within fractions of a second - yet separated by long intervals spanning minutes. Current EEG methods use self-supervised objectives that optimize for signal reconstruction, but these are not well suited for streaming SSMs; they fail to explicitly train the hidden state to retain the salient long-range context needed for streaming inference. We therefore introduce a multi-stage self-supervised training pipeline specifically tailored to encourage long-range memory retention and strong performance on EEG signals, while preserving the linear-time complexity of state space models. CaMBRAIN achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) results across 3 different EEG datasets with >10x higher throughput than existing models, enabling the first model capable of long-range, continuous inference of variable-length EEG signals.

AI.tldr: 提出CaMBRAIN——首个基于因果Mamba的状态空间模型，用于EEG信号的实时推理，配合多阶段自监督训练流水线实现长程记忆保持，在3个EEG数据集上达到SOTA，吞吐量提升10倍以上。
AI.motivation: 现有EEG深度学习方法存在两大瓶颈：(1)基于注意力机制，序列长度增加时计算量呈二次方增长；(2)需滑窗处理固定长度输入，无法全局理解整段信号。需要一种既能实时推理又能处理长序列的EEG模型。
AI.method: 提出CaMBRAIN模型：(1)采用因果Mamba状态空间模型(SSM)，利用EEG信号的因果单向性，避免双向计算的冗余开销；(2)设计多阶段自监督训练流水线，专门针对流式SSM优化，训练隐藏状态保留关键长程上下文，同时保持线性时间复杂度。
AI.result: 在3个不同EEG数据集上达到SOTA结果，吞吐量比现有模型提升10倍以上，成为首个能够对变长EEG信号进行长程连续推理的模型。
AI.conclusion: CaMBRAIN证明了因果SSM在处理长序列EEG信号上的优越性，多阶段自监督训练策略有效解决了流式推理中的长程记忆问题，为实时EEG分析提供了一种高效、可扩展的解决方案。
idea_en: Causal Mamba-based state space model for real-time EEG inference with linear-time complexity
Multi-stage self-supervised training pipeline designed to enhance long-range memory retention in streaming state space models
Method for continuous inference of variable-length EEG signals without sliding-window segmentation
Causal unidirectional processing architecture for EEG that avoids redundant bidirectional computations
Training framework that explicitly optimizes hidden state retention of long-range context for streaming EEG analysis
idea_ch: 基于因果Mamba的状态空间模型用于EEG实时推理，实现线性时间复杂度
专门针对流式状态空间模型设计的多阶段自监督训练流水线，增强长程记忆保持能力
无需滑窗分割即可对变长EEG信号进行连续推理的方法
利用EEG信号因果单向性避免冗余双向计算的单向处理架构
显式优化隐藏状态以保留长程上下文的EEG流式分析训练框架

title: Calibrating Conservatism for Scalable Oversight
summary: Agentic AI systems capable of autonomous planning and extended environmental interaction pose a fundamental control problem: how can humans maintain meaningful oversight of systems that may exceed their own capabilities? Existing approaches to scalable oversight rely on complex assumptions, remain largely heuristic, or lack practical methods for sequential settings with statistical guarantees. We introduce Calibrated Collective Oversight (CCO), which aggregates diverse auxiliary scoring functions into a penalty measuring deviation from a conservative baseline. Inspired by Attainable Utility Preservation, CCO enables collective conservatism: actions face a penalty proportional to overseer concern, so high-utility actions are still selected when overseers find them unobjectionable and overridden only when concern accumulates. CCO calibrates this conservatism online using Conformal Decision Theory, ensuring that undesirable outcomes remain below a user-specified target threshold with finite-time bounds and no distributional assumptions. On a modified version of SWE-bench, weaker overseers successfully constrain an adversarially misaligned stronger agent; on MACHIAVELLI, CCO substantially reduces ethical violations while preserving reward. In both settings, empirical violation rates closely match the specified targets, as predicted by the theory.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为校准集体监督（CCO）的方法，通过聚合多样化的辅助评分函数并利用保形决策理论在线校准，实现对自主AI系统的可扩展监督，在保证有限时间界和无分布假设的条件下，将不良结果控制在用户指定阈值以下。
AI.motivation: 自主AI系统在规划和与环境交互时可能超越人类能力，现有监督方法要么依赖复杂假设，要么缺乏带统计保证的序列决策方法，亟需一种可扩展、有理论保证的监督机制。
AI.method: CCO聚合多种辅助评分函数形成惩罚项，衡量与保守基线的偏差；基于可达到效用保留（Attainable Utility Preservation）思想实现集体保守主义，行动面临与监督者关注度成正比的惩罚；利用保形决策理论（Conformal Decision Theory）在线校准保守程度，在无分布假设下确保不良结果低于用户指定阈值并满足有限时间界。
AI.result: 在修改版SWE-bench上，较弱的监督者成功约束了对抗性恶意对齐的更强智能体；在MACHIAVELLI上，CCO显著减少伦理违规同时保留奖励。实证违规率与理论预测的目标值高度吻合。
AI.conclusion: CCO提供了一种具有统计保证的可扩展监督方法，有效解决了人类对超能力AI系统的控制问题，实验验证了其理论预测的准确性。
idea_en: A method for aggregating diverse auxiliary scoring functions into a calibrated penalty for autonomous AI agents, enabling collective conservatism where actions are penalized proportionally to overseer concern.
Online calibration of conservatism using Conformal Decision Theory, providing finite-time statistical guarantees without distributional assumptions for sequential decision-making oversight.
A scalable oversight mechanism where weaker overseers can constrain adversarially misaligned stronger AI agents through calibrated collective scoring aggregation.
A technique for maintaining user-specified target thresholds for undesirable outcomes in autonomous AI systems through real-time penalty adjustment based on aggregated overseer signals.
idea_ch: 一种将多样化的辅助评分函数聚合为校准惩罚项的方法，用于自主AI智能体的集体保守主义监督，行动面临的惩罚与监督者关注度成正比
基于保形决策理论（Conformal Decision Theory）的保守性在线校准方法，在无分布假设下为序列决策监督提供有限时间统计保证
一种弱监督者通过校准的集体评分聚合来约束对抗性恶意对齐的强AI智能体的可扩展监督机制
